text.KJV: The book of the generation of Jesus Christ, the son of David, the son of Abraham.
text.ASV: The book of the generation of Jesus Christ, the son of David, the son of Abraham.
text.WEB: The book of the genealogy of Jesus Christ, the son of David, the son of Abraham.

text.KJV: Abraham begat Isaac; and Isaac begat Jacob; and Jacob begat Judas and his brethren;
text.ASV: Abraham begat Isaac; and Isaac begat Jacob; and Jacob begat Judah and his brethren;
text.WEB: Abraham became the father of Isaac. Isaac became the father of Jacob. Jacob became the father of Judah and his brothers.

text.KJV: And Judas begat Phares and Zara of Thamar; and Phares begat Esrom; and Esrom begat Aram;
text.ASV: and Judah begat Perez and Zerah of Tamar; and Perez begat Hezron; and Hezron begat Ram;
text.WEB: Judah became the father of Perez and Zerah by Tamar. Perez became the father of Hezron. Hezron became the father of Ram.

text.KJV: And Aram begat Aminadab; and Aminadab begat Naasson; and Naasson begat Salmon;
text.ASV: and Ram begat Amminadab; and Amminadab begat Nahshon; and Nahshon begat Salmon;
text.WEB: Ram became the father of Amminadab. Amminadab became the father of Nahshon. Nahshon became the father of Salmon.

text.KJV: And Salmon begat Booz of Rachab; and Booz begat Obed of Ruth; and Obed begat Jesse;
text.ASV: and Salmon begat Boaz of Rahab; and Boaz begat Obed of Ruth; and Obed begat Jesse;
text.WEB: Salmon became the father of Boaz by Rahab. Boaz became the father of Obed by Ruth. Obed became the father of Jesse.

text.KJV: And Jesse begat David the king; and David the king begat Solomon of her that had been the wife of Urias;
text.ASV: and Jesse begat David the king. And David begat Solomon of her `that had been the wife' of Uriah;
text.WEB: Jesse became the father of King David. David became the father of Solomon by her who had been Uriah’s wife.

text.KJV: And Solomon begat Roboam; and Roboam begat Abia; and Abia begat Asa;
text.ASV: and Solomon begat Rehoboam; and Rehoboam begat Abijah; and Abijah begat Asa;
text.WEB: Solomon became the father of Rehoboam. Rehoboam became the father of Abijah. Abijah became the father of Asa.

text.KJV: And Asa begat Josaphat; and Josaphat begat Joram; and Joram begat Ozias;
text.ASV: and Asa begat Jehoshaphat; and Jehoshaphat begat Joram; and Joram begat Uzziah;
text.WEB: Asa became the father of Jehoshaphat. Jehoshaphat became the father of Joram. Joram became the father of Uzziah.

text.KJV: And Ozias begat Joatham; and Joatham begat Achaz; and Achaz begat Ezekias;
text.ASV: and Uzziah begat Jotham; and Jotham begat Ahaz; and Ahaz begat Hezekiah;
text.WEB: Uzziah became the father of Jotham. Jotham became the father of Ahaz. Ahaz became the father of Hezekiah.

text.KJV: And Ezekias begat Manasses; and Manasses begat Amon; and Amon begat Josias;
text.ASV: and Hezekiah begat Manasseh; and Manasseh begat Amon; and Amon begat Josiah;
text.WEB: Hezekiah became the father of Manasseh. Manasseh became the father of Amon. Amon became the father of Josiah.

text.KJV: And Josias begat Jechonias and his brethren, about the time they were carried away to Babylon:
text.ASV: and Josiah begat Jechoniah and his brethren, at the time of the carrying away to Babylon.
text.WEB: Josiah became the father of Jechoniah and his brothers, at the time of the exile to Babylon.

text.KJV: And after they were brought to Babylon, Jechonias begat Salathiel; and Salathiel begat Zorobabel;
text.ASV: And after the carrying away to Babylon, Jechoniah begat Shealtiel; and Shealtiel begat Zerubbabel;
text.WEB: After the exile to Babylon, Jechoniah became the father of Shealtiel. Shealtiel became the father of Zerubbabel.

text.KJV: And Zorobabel begat Abiud; and Abiud begat Eliakim; and Eliakim begat Azor;
text.ASV: and Zerubbabel begat Abiud; and Abiud begat Eliakim; and Eliakim begat Azor;
text.WEB: Zerubbabel became the father of Abiud. Abiud became the father of Eliakim. Eliakim became the father of Azor.

text.KJV: And Azor begat Sadoc; and Sadoc begat Achim; and Achim begat Eliud;
text.ASV: and Azor begat Sadoc; and Sadoc begat Achim; and Achim begat Eliud;
text.WEB: Azor became the father of Zadok. Zadok became the father of Achim. Achim became the father of Eliud.

text.KJV: And Eliud begat Eleazar; and Eleazar begat Matthan; and Matthan begat Jacob;
text.ASV: and Eliud begat Eleazar; and Eleazar begat Matthan; and Matthan begat Jacob;
text.WEB: Eliud became the father of Eleazar. Eleazar became the father of Matthan. Matthan became the father of Jacob.

text.KJV: And Jacob begat Joseph the husband of Mary, of whom was born Jesus, who is called Christ.
text.ASV: and Jacob begat Joseph the husband of Mary, of whom was born Jesus, who is called Christ.
text.WEB: Jacob became the father of Joseph, the husband of Mary, from whom was born Jesus, who is called Christ.

text.KJV: So all the generations from Abraham to David are fourteen generations; and from David until the carrying away into Babylon are fourteen generations; and from the carrying away into Babylon unto Christ are fourteen generations.
text.ASV: So all the generations from Abraham unto David are fourteen generations; and from David unto the carrying away to Babylon fourteen generations; and from the carrying away to Babylon unto the Christ fourteen generations.
text.WEB: So all the generations from Abraham to David are fourteen generations; from David to the exile to Babylon fourteen generations; and from the carrying away to Babylon to the Christ, fourteen generations.

text.KJV: Now the birth of Jesus Christ was on this wise: When as his mother Mary was espoused to Joseph, before they came together, she was found with child of the Holy Ghost.
text.ASV: Now the birth of Jesus Christ was on this wise: When his mother Mary had been betrothed to Joseph, before they came together she was found with child of the Holy Spirit.
text.WEB: Now the birth of Jesus Christ was like this: After his mother, Mary, was engaged to Joseph, before they came together, she was found pregnant by the Holy Spirit.

text.KJV: Then Joseph her husband, being a just man, and not willing to make her a publick example, was minded to put her away privily.
text.ASV: And Joseph her husband, being a righteous man, and not willing to make her a public example, was minded to put her away privily.
text.WEB: Joseph, her husband, being a righteous man, and not willing to make her a public example, intended to put her away secretly.

text.KJV: But while he thought on these things, behold, the angel of the LORD appeared unto him in a dream, saying, Joseph, thou son of David, fear not to take unto thee Mary thy wife: for that which is conceived in her is of the Holy Ghost.
text.ASV: But when he thought on these things, behold, an angel of the Lord appeared unto him in a dream, saying, Joseph, thou son of David, fear not to take unto thee Mary thy wife: for that which is conceived in her is of the Holy Spirit.
text.WEB: But when he thought about these things, behold, an angel of the Lord appeared to him in a dream, saying, “Joseph, son of David, don’t be afraid to take to yourself Mary, your wife, for that which is conceived in her is of the Holy Spirit.

text.KJV: And she shall bring forth a son, and thou shalt call his name JESUS: for he shall save his people from their sins.
text.ASV: And she shall bring forth a son; and thou shalt call his name JESUS; for it is he that shall save his people from their sins.
text.WEB: She shall give birth to a son. You shall call his name Jesus, for it is he who shall save his people from their sins.”

text.KJV: Now all this was done, that it might be fulfilled which was spoken of the Lord by the prophet, saying,
text.ASV: Now all this is come to pass, that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the Lord through the prophet, saying,
text.WEB: Now all this has happened, that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the Lord through the prophet, saying,

text.KJV: Behold, a virgin shall be with child, and shall bring forth a son, and they shall call his name Emmanuel, which being interpreted is, God with us.
text.ASV: Behold, the virgin shall be with child, and shall bring forth a son, And they shall call his name Immanuel; which is, being interpreted, God with us.
text.WEB: “Behold, the virgin shall be with child, and shall give birth to a son. They shall call his name Immanuel”; which is, being interpreted, “God with us.”

text.KJV: Then Joseph being raised from sleep did as the angel of the Lord had bidden him, and took unto him his wife:
text.ASV: And Joseph arose from his sleep, and did as the angel of the Lord commanded him, and took unto him his wife;
text.WEB: Joseph arose from his sleep, and did as the angel of the Lord commanded him, and took his wife to himself;

text.KJV: And knew her not till she had brought forth her firstborn son: and he called his name JESUS.
text.ASV: and knew her not till she had brought forth a son: and he called his name JESUS.
text.WEB: and didn’t know her sexually until she had given birth to her firstborn son. He named him Jesus.

text.KJV: Now when Jesus was born in Bethlehem of Judaea in the days of Herod the king, behold, there came wise men from the east to Jerusalem,
text.ASV: Now when Jesus was born in Bethlehem of Judaea in the days of Herod the king, behold, Wise-men from the east came to Jerusalem, saying,
text.WEB: Now when Jesus was born in Bethlehem of Judea in the days of King Herod, behold, wise men from the east came to Jerusalem, saying,

text.KJV: Saying, Where is he that is born King of the Jews? for we have seen his star in the east, and are come to worship him.
text.ASV: Where is he that is born King of the Jews? for we saw his star in the east, and are come to worship him.
text.WEB: “Where is he who is born King of the Jews? For we saw his star in the east, and have come to worship him.”

text.KJV: When Herod the king had heard these things, he was troubled, and all Jerusalem with him.
text.ASV: And when Herod the king heard it, he was troubled, and all Jerusalem with him.
text.WEB: When King Herod heard it, he was troubled, and all Jerusalem with him.

text.KJV: And when he had gathered all the chief priests and scribes of the people together, he demanded of them where Christ should be born.
text.ASV: And gathering together all the chief priests and scribes of the people, he inquired of them where the Christ should be born.
text.WEB: Gathering together all the chief priests and scribes of the people, he asked them where the Christ would be born.

text.KJV: And they said unto him, In Bethlehem of Judaea: for thus it is written by the prophet,
text.ASV: And they said unto him, In Bethlehem of Judaea: for thus it is written through the prophet,
text.WEB: They said to him, “In Bethlehem of Judea, for this is written through the prophet,

text.KJV: And thou Bethlehem, in the land of Juda, art not the least among the princes of Juda: for out of thee shall come a Governor, that shall rule my people Israel.
text.ASV: And thou Bethlehem, land of Judah, Art in no wise least among the princes of Judah: For out of thee shall come forth a governor, Who shall be shepherd of my people Israel.
text.WEB: ‘You Bethlehem, land of Judah, are in no way least among the princes of Judah: for out of you shall come a governor, who shall shepherd my people, Israel.’”

text.KJV: Then Herod, when he had privily called the wise men, enquired of them diligently what time the star appeared.
text.ASV: Then Herod privily called the Wise-men, and learned of them exactly what time the star appeared.
text.WEB: Then Herod secretly called the wise men, and learned from them exactly what time the star appeared.

text.KJV: And he sent them to Bethlehem, and said, Go and search diligently for the young child; and when ye have found him, bring me word again, that I may come and worship him also.
text.ASV: And he sent them to Bethlehem, and said, Go and search out exactly concerning the young child; and when ye have found `him,' bring me word, that I also may come and worship him.
text.WEB: He sent them to Bethlehem, and said, “Go and search diligently for the young child. When you have found him, bring me word, so that I also may come and worship him.”

text.KJV: When they had heard the king, they departed; and, lo, the star, which they saw in the east, went before them, till it came and stood over where the young child was.
text.ASV: And they, having heard the king, went their way; and lo, the star, which they saw in the east, went before them, till it came and stood over where the young child was.
text.WEB: They, having heard the king, went their way; and behold, the star, which they saw in the east, went before them, until it came and stood over where the young child was.

text.KJV: When they saw the star, they rejoiced with exceeding great joy.
text.ASV: And when they saw the star, they rejoiced with exceeding great joy.
text.WEB: When they saw the star, they rejoiced with exceedingly great joy.

text.KJV: And when they were come into the house, they saw the young child with Mary his mother, and fell down, and worshipped him: and when they had opened their treasures, they presented unto him gifts; gold, and frankincense and myrrh.
text.ASV: And they came into the house and saw the young child with Mary his mother; and they fell down and worshipped him; and opening their treasures they offered unto him gifts, gold and frankincense and myrrh.
text.WEB: They came into the house and saw the young child with Mary, his mother, and they fell down and worshiped him. Opening their treasures, they offered to him gifts: gold, frankincense, and myrrh.

text.KJV: And being warned of God in a dream that they should not return to Herod, they departed into their own country another way.
text.ASV: And being warned `of God' in a dream that they should not return to Herod, they departed into their own country another way.
text.WEB: Being warned in a dream that they shouldn’t return to Herod, they went back to their own country another way.

text.KJV: And when they were departed, behold, the angel of the Lord appeareth to Joseph in a dream, saying, Arise, and take the young child and his mother, and flee into Egypt, and be thou there until I bring thee word: for Herod will seek the young child to destroy him.
text.ASV: Now when they were departed, behold, an angel of the Lord appeareth to Joseph in a dream, saying, Arise and take the young child and his mother, and flee into Egypt, and be thou there until I tell thee: for Herod will seek the young child to destroy him.
text.WEB: Now when they had departed, behold, an angel of the Lord appeared to Joseph in a dream, saying, “Arise and take the young child and his mother, and flee into Egypt, and stay there until I tell you, for Herod will seek the young child to destroy him.”

text.KJV: When he arose, he took the young child and his mother by night, and departed into Egypt:
text.ASV: And he arose and took the young child and his mother by night, and departed into Egypt;
text.WEB: He arose and took the young child and his mother by night, and departed into Egypt,

text.KJV: And was there until the death of Herod: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken of the Lord by the prophet, saying, Out of Egypt have I called my son.
text.ASV: and was there until the death of Herod: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the Lord through the prophet, saying, Out of Egypt did I call my son.
text.WEB: and was there until the death of Herod; that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the Lord through the prophet, saying, “Out of Egypt I called my son.”

text.KJV: Then Herod, when he saw that he was mocked of the wise men, was exceeding wroth, and sent forth, and slew all the children that were in Bethlehem, and in all the coasts thereof, from two years old and under, according to the time which he had diligently enquired of the wise men.
text.ASV: Then Herod, when he saw that he was mocked of the Wise-men, was exceeding wroth, and sent forth, and slew all the male children that were in Bethlehem, and in all the borders thereof, from two years old and under, according to the time which he had exactly learned of the Wise-men.
text.WEB: Then Herod, when he saw that he was mocked by the wise men, was exceedingly angry, and sent out, and killed all the male children who were in Bethlehem and in all the surrounding countryside, from two years old and under, according to the exact time which he had learned from the wise men.

text.KJV: Then was fulfilled that which was spoken by Jeremy the prophet, saying,
text.ASV: Then was fulfilled that which was spoken through Jeremiah the prophet, saying,
text.WEB: Then that which was spoken by Jeremiah the prophet was fulfilled, saying,

text.KJV: In Rama was there a voice heard, lamentation, and weeping, and great mourning, Rachel weeping for her children, and would not be comforted, because they are not.
text.ASV: A voice was heard in Ramah, Weeping and great mourning, Rachel weeping for her children; And she would not be comforted, because they are not.
text.WEB: “A voice was heard in Ramah, lamentation, weeping and great mourning, Rachel weeping for her children; she wouldn’t be comforted, because they are no more.”

text.KJV: But when Herod was dead, behold, an angel of the Lord appeareth in a dream to Joseph in Egypt,
text.ASV: But when Herod was dead, behold, an angel of the Lord appeareth in a dream to Joseph in Egypt, saying,
text.WEB: But when Herod was dead, behold, an angel of the Lord appeared in a dream to Joseph in Egypt, saying,

text.KJV: Saying, Arise, and take the young child and his mother, and go into the land of Israel: for they are dead which sought the young child's life.
text.ASV: Arise and take the young child and his mother, and go into the land of Israel: for they are dead that sought the young child's life.
text.WEB: “Arise and take the young child and his mother, and go into the land of Israel, for those who sought the young child’s life are dead.”

text.KJV: And he arose, and took the young child and his mother, and came into the land of Israel.
text.ASV: And he arose and took the young child and his mother, and came into the land of Israel.
text.WEB: He arose and took the young child and his mother, and came into the land of Israel.

text.KJV: But when he heard that Archelaus did reign in Judaea in the room of his father Herod, he was afraid to go thither: notwithstanding, being warned of God in a dream, he turned aside into the parts of Galilee:
text.ASV: But when he heard that Archelaus was reigning over Judaea in the room of his father Herod, he was afraid to go thither; and being warned `of God' in a dream, he withdrew into the parts of Galilee,
text.WEB: But when he heard that Archelaus was reigning over Judea in the place of his father, Herod, he was afraid to go there. Being warned in a dream, he withdrew into the region of Galilee,

text.KJV: And he came and dwelt in a city called Nazareth: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophets, He shall be called a Nazarene.
text.ASV: and came and dwelt in a city called Nazareth; that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through the prophets, that he should be called a Nazarene.
text.WEB: and came and lived in a city called Nazareth; that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through the prophets: “He will be called a Nazarene.”

text.KJV: In those days came John the Baptist, preaching in the wilderness of Judaea,
text.ASV: And in those days cometh John the Baptist, preaching in the wilderness of Judaea, saying,
text.WEB: In those days, John the Baptizer came, preaching in the wilderness of Judea, saying,

text.KJV: And saying, Repent ye: for the kingdom of heaven is at hand.
text.ASV: Repent ye; for the kingdom of heaven is at hand.
text.WEB: “Repent, for the Kingdom of Heaven is at hand!”

text.KJV: For this is he that was spoken of by the prophet Esaias, saying, The voice of one crying in the wilderness, Prepare ye the way of the Lord, make his paths straight.
text.ASV: For this is he that was spoken of through Isaiah the prophet, saying, The voice of one crying in the wilderness, Make ye ready the way of the Lord, Make his paths straight.
text.WEB: For this is he who was spoken of by Isaiah the prophet, saying, “The voice of one crying in the wilderness, make ready the way of the Lord. Make his paths straight.”

text.KJV: And the same John had his raiment of camel's hair, and a leathern girdle about his loins; and his meat was locusts and wild honey.
text.ASV: Now John himself had his raiment of camel's hair, and a leathern girdle about his loins; and his food was locusts and wild honey.
text.WEB: Now John himself wore clothing made of camel’s hair, with a leather belt around his waist. His food was locusts and wild honey.

text.KJV: Then went out to him Jerusalem, and all Judaea, and all the region round about Jordan,
text.ASV: Then went out unto him Jerusalem, and all Judaea, and all the region round about the Jordan;
text.WEB: Then people from Jerusalem, all of Judea, and all the region around the Jordan went out to him.

text.KJV: And were baptized of him in Jordan, confessing their sins.
text.ASV: and they were baptized of him in the river Jordan, confessing their sins.
text.WEB: They were baptized by him in the Jordan, confessing their sins.

text.KJV: But when he saw many of the Pharisees and Sadducees come to his baptism, he said unto them, O generation of vipers, who hath warned you to flee from the wrath to come?
text.ASV: But when he saw many of the Pharisees and Sadducees coming to his baptism, he said unto them, Ye offspring of vipers, who warned you to flee from the wrath to come?
text.WEB: But when he saw many of the Pharisees and Sadducees coming for his baptism, he said to them, “You offspring of vipers, who warned you to flee from the wrath to come?

text.KJV: Bring forth therefore fruits meet for repentance:
text.ASV: Bring forth therefore fruit worthy of repentance:
text.WEB: Therefore produce fruit worthy of repentance!

text.KJV: And think not to say within yourselves, We have Abraham to our father: for I say unto you, that God is able of these stones to raise up children unto Abraham.
text.ASV: and think not to say within yourselves, We have Abraham to our father: for I say unto you, that God is able of these stones to raise up children unto Abraham.
text.WEB: Don’t think to yourselves, ‘We have Abraham for our father,’ for I tell you that God is able to raise up children to Abraham from these stones.

text.KJV: And now also the axe is laid unto the root of the trees: therefore every tree which bringeth not forth good fruit is hewn down, and cast into the fire.
text.ASV: And even now the axe lieth at the root of the trees: every tree therefore that bringeth not forth good fruit is hewn down, and cast into the fire.
text.WEB: “Even now the ax lies at the root of the trees. Therefore every tree that doesn’t produce good fruit is cut down, and cast into the fire.

text.KJV: I indeed baptize you with water unto repentance: but he that cometh after me is mightier than I, whose shoes I am not worthy to bear: he shall baptize you with the Holy Ghost, and with fire:
text.ASV: I indeed baptize you in water unto repentance: but he that cometh after me is mightier than I, whose shoes I am not worthy to bear: he shall baptize you in the Holy Spirit and `in' fire:
text.WEB: I indeed baptize you in water for repentance, but he who comes after me is mightier than I, whose shoes I am not worthy to carry. He will baptize you in the Holy Spirit.

text.KJV: Whose fan is in his hand, and he will throughly purge his floor, and gather his wheat into the garner; but he will burn up the chaff with unquenchable fire.
text.ASV: whose fan is in his hand, and he will thoroughly cleanse his threshing-floor; and he will gather his wheat into the garner, but the chaff he will burn up with unquenchable fire.
text.WEB: His winnowing fork is in his hand, and he will thoroughly cleanse his threshing floor. He will gather his wheat into the barn, but the chaff he will burn up with unquenchable fire.”

text.KJV: Then cometh Jesus from Galilee to Jordan unto John, to be baptized of him.
text.ASV: Then cometh Jesus from Galilee to the Jordan unto John, to be baptized of him.
text.WEB: Then Jesus came from Galilee to the Jordan to John, to be baptized by him.

text.KJV: But John forbad him, saying, I have need to be baptized of thee, and comest thou to me?
text.ASV: But John would have hindered him, saying, I have need to be baptized of thee, and comest thou to me?
text.WEB: But John would have hindered him, saying, “I need to be baptized by you, and you come to me?”

text.KJV: And Jesus answering said unto him, Suffer it to be so now: for thus it becometh us to fulfil all righteousness. Then he suffered him.
text.ASV: But Jesus answering said unto him, Suffer `it' now: for thus it becometh us to fulfil all righteousness. Then he suffereth him.
text.WEB: But Jesus, answering, said to him, “Allow it now, for this is the fitting way for us to fulfill all righteousness.” Then he allowed him.

text.KJV: And Jesus, when he was baptized, went up straightway out of the water: and, lo, the heavens were opened unto him, and he saw the Spirit of God descending like a dove, and lighting upon him:
text.ASV: And Jesus when he was baptized, went up straightway from the water: and lo, the heavens were opened unto him, and he saw the Spirit of God descending as a dove, and coming upon him;
text.WEB: Jesus, when he was baptized, went up directly from the water: and behold, the heavens were opened to him. He saw the Spirit of God descending as a dove, and coming on him.

text.KJV: And lo a voice from heaven, saying, This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.
text.ASV: and lo, a voice out of the heavens, saying, This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.
text.WEB: Behold, a voice out of the heavens said, “This is my beloved Son, with whom I am well pleased.”

text.KJV: Then was Jesus led up of the spirit into the wilderness to be tempted of the devil.
text.ASV: Then was Jesus led up of the Spirit into the wilderness to be tempted of the devil.
text.WEB: Then Jesus was led up by the Spirit into the wilderness to be tempted by the devil.

text.KJV: And when he had fasted forty days and forty nights, he was afterward an hungred.
text.ASV: And when he had fasted forty days and forty nights, he afterward hungered.
text.WEB: When he had fasted forty days and forty nights, he was hungry afterward.

text.KJV: And when the tempter came to him, he said, If thou be the Son of God, command that these stones be made bread.
text.ASV: And the tempter came and said unto him, If thou art the Son of God, command that these stones become bread.
text.WEB: The tempter came and said to him, “If you are the Son of God, command that these stones become bread.”

text.KJV: But he answered and said, It is written, Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that proceedeth out of the mouth of God.
text.ASV: But he answered and said, It is written, Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that proceedeth out of the mouth of God.
text.WEB: But he answered, “It is written, ‘Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that proceeds out of the mouth of God.’”

text.KJV: Then the devil taketh him up into the holy city, and setteth him on a pinnacle of the temple,
text.ASV: Then the devil taketh him into the holy city; and he set him on the pinnacle of the temple,
text.WEB: Then the devil took him into the holy city. He set him on the pinnacle of the temple,

text.KJV: And saith unto him, If thou be the Son of God, cast thyself down: for it is written, He shall give his angels charge concerning thee: and in their hands they shall bear thee up, lest at any time thou dash thy foot against a stone.
text.ASV: and saith unto him, If thou art the Son of God, cast thyself down: for it is written, He shall give his angels charge concerning thee: and, On their hands they shall bear thee up, Lest haply thou dash thy foot against a stone.
text.WEB: and said to him, “If you are the Son of God, throw yourself down, for it is written, ‘He will put his angels in charge of you.’ and, ‘On their hands they will bear you up, so that you don’t dash your foot against a stone.’”

text.KJV: Jesus said unto him, It is written again, Thou shalt not tempt the Lord thy God.
text.ASV: Jesus said unto him, Again it is written, Thou shalt not make trial of the Lord thy God.
text.WEB: Jesus said to him, “Again, it is written, ‘You shall not test the Lord, your God.’”

text.KJV: Again, the devil taketh him up into an exceeding high mountain, and sheweth him all the kingdoms of the world, and the glory of them;
text.ASV: Again, the devil taketh him unto an exceeding high mountain, and showeth him all the kingdoms of the world, and the glory of them;
text.WEB: Again, the devil took him to an exceedingly high mountain, and showed him all the kingdoms of the world, and their glory.

text.KJV: And saith unto him, All these things will I give thee, if thou wilt fall down and worship me.
text.ASV: and he said unto him, All these things will I give thee, if thou wilt fall down and worship me.
text.WEB: He said to him, “I will give you all of these things, if you will fall down and worship me.”

text.KJV: Then saith Jesus unto him, Get thee hence, Satan: for it is written, Thou shalt worship the Lord thy God, and him only shalt thou serve.
text.ASV: Then saith Jesus unto him, Get thee hence, Satan: for it is written, Thou shalt worship the Lord thy God, and him only shalt thou serve.
text.WEB: Then Jesus said to him, “Get behind me, Satan! For it is written, ‘You shall worship the Lord your God, and you shall serve him only.’”

text.KJV: Then the devil leaveth him, and, behold, angels came and ministered unto him.
text.ASV: Then the devil leaveth him; and behold, angels came and ministered unto him.
text.WEB: Then the devil left him, and behold, angels came and served him.

text.KJV: Now when Jesus had heard that John was cast into prison, he departed into Galilee;
text.ASV: Now when he heard that John was delivered up, he withdrew into Galilee;
text.WEB: Now when Jesus heard that John was delivered up, he withdrew into Galilee.

text.KJV: And leaving Nazareth, he came and dwelt in Capernaum, which is upon the sea coast, in the borders of Zabulon and Nephthalim:
text.ASV: and leaving Nazareth, he came and dwelt in Capernaum, which is by the sea, in the borders of Zebulun and Naphtali:
text.WEB: Leaving Nazareth, he came and lived in Capernaum, which is by the sea, in the region of Zebulun and Naphtali,

text.KJV: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by Esaias the prophet, saying,
text.ASV: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through Isaiah the prophet, saying,
text.WEB: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through Isaiah the prophet, saying,

text.KJV: The land of Zabulon, and the land of Nephthalim, by the way of the sea, beyond Jordan, Galilee of the Gentiles;
text.ASV: The land of Zebulun and the land of Naphtali, Toward the sea, beyond the Jordan, Galilee of the Gentiles,
text.WEB: “The land of Zebulun and the land of Naphtali, toward the sea, beyond the Jordan, Galilee of the Gentiles,

text.KJV: The people which sat in darkness saw great light; and to them which sat in the region and shadow of death light is sprung up.
text.ASV: The people that sat in darkness Saw a great light, And to them that sat in the region and shadow of death, To them did light spring up.
text.WEB: the people who sat in darkness saw a great light, to those who sat in the region and shadow of death, to them light has dawned.”

text.KJV: From that time Jesus began to preach, and to say, Repent: for the kingdom of heaven is at hand.
text.ASV: From that time began Jesus to preach, and to say, Repent ye; for the kingdom of heaven is at hand.
text.WEB: From that time, Jesus began to preach, and to say, “Repent! For the Kingdom of Heaven is at hand.”

text.KJV: And Jesus, walking by the sea of Galilee, saw two brethren, Simon called Peter, and Andrew his brother, casting a net into the sea: for they were fishers.
text.ASV: And walking by the sea of Galilee, he saw two brethren, Simon who is called Peter, and Andrew his brother, casting a net into the sea; for they were fishers.
text.WEB: Walking by the sea of Galilee, he saw two brothers: Simon, who is called Peter, and Andrew, his brother, casting a net into the sea; for they were fishermen.

text.KJV: And he saith unto them, Follow me, and I will make you fishers of men.
text.ASV: And he saith unto them, Come ye after me, and I will make you fishers of men.
text.WEB: He said to them, “Come after me, and I will make you fishers for men.”

text.KJV: And they straightway left their nets, and followed him.
text.ASV: And they straightway left the nets, and followed him.
text.WEB: They immediately left their nets and followed him.

text.KJV: And going on from thence, he saw other two brethren, James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother, in a ship with Zebedee their father, mending their nets; and he called them.
text.ASV: And going on from thence he saw two other brethren, James the `son' of Zebedee, and John his brother, in the boat with Zebedee their father, mending their nets; and he called them.
text.WEB: Going on from there, he saw two other brothers, James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother, in the boat with Zebedee their father, mending their nets. He called them.

text.KJV: And they immediately left the ship and their father, and followed him.
text.ASV: And they straightway left the boat and their father, and followed him.
text.WEB: They immediately left the boat and their father, and followed him.

text.KJV: And Jesus went about all Galilee, teaching in their synagogues, and preaching the gospel of the kingdom, and healing all manner of sickness and all manner of disease among the people.
text.ASV: And Jesus went about in all Galilee, teaching in their synagogues, and preaching the gospel of the kingdom, and healing all manner of disease and all manner of sickness among the people.
text.WEB: Jesus went about in all Galilee, teaching in their synagogues, preaching the Good News of the Kingdom, and healing every disease and every sickness among the people.

text.KJV: And his fame went throughout all Syria: and they brought unto him all sick people that were taken with divers diseases and torments, and those which were possessed with devils, and those which were lunatick, and those that had the palsy; and he healed them.
text.ASV: And the report of him went forth into all Syria: and they brought unto him all that were sick, holden with divers diseases and torments, possessed with demons, and epileptic, and palsied; and he healed them.
text.WEB: The report about him went out into all Syria. They brought to him all who were sick, afflicted with various diseases and torments, possessed with demons, epileptics, and paralytics; and he healed them.

text.KJV: And there followed him great multitudes of people from Galilee, and from Decapolis, and from Jerusalem, and from Judaea, and from beyond Jordan.
text.ASV: And there followed him great multitudes from Galilee and Decapolis and Jerusalem and Judaea and `from' beyond the Jordan.
text.WEB: Great multitudes from Galilee, Decapolis, Jerusalem, Judea and from beyond the Jordan followed him.

text.KJV: And seeing the multitudes, he went up into a mountain: and when he was set, his disciples came unto him:
text.ASV: And seeing the multitudes, he went up into the mountain: and when he had sat down, his disciples came unto him:
text.WEB: Seeing the multitudes, he went up onto the mountain. When he had sat down, his disciples came to him.

text.KJV: And he opened his mouth, and taught them, saying,
text.ASV: and he opened his mouth and taught them, saying,
text.WEB: He opened his mouth and taught them, saying,

text.KJV: Blessed are the poor in spirit: for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.
text.ASV: Blessed are the poor in spirit: for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.
text.WEB: “Blessed are the poor in spirit, for theirs is the Kingdom of Heaven.;

text.KJV: Blessed are they that mourn: for they shall be comforted.
text.ASV: Blessed are they that mourn: for they shall be comforted.
text.WEB: Blessed are those who mourn, for they shall be comforted.; ,

text.KJV: Blessed are the meek: for they shall inherit the earth.
text.ASV: Blessed are the meek: for they shall inherit the earth.
text.WEB: Blessed are the gentle, for they shall inherit the earth.

text.KJV: Blessed are they which do hunger and thirst after righteousness: for they shall be filled.
text.ASV: Blessed are they that hunger and thirst after righteousness: for they shall be filled.
text.WEB: Blessed are those who hunger and thirst after righteousness, for they shall be filled.

text.KJV: Blessed are the merciful: for they shall obtain mercy.
text.ASV: Blessed are the merciful: for they shall obtain mercy.
text.WEB: Blessed are the merciful, for they shall obtain mercy.

text.KJV: Blessed are the pure in heart: for they shall see God.
text.ASV: Blessed are the pure in heart: for they shall see God.
text.WEB: Blessed are the pure in heart, for they shall see God.

text.KJV: Blessed are the peacemakers: for they shall be called the children of God.
text.ASV: Blessed are the peacemakers: for they shall be called sons of God.
text.WEB: Blessed are the peacemakers, for they shall be called children of God.

text.KJV: Blessed are they which are persecuted for righteousness' sake: for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.
text.ASV: Blessed are they that have been persecuted for righteousness' sake: for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.
text.WEB: Blessed are those who have been persecuted for righteousness’ sake, for theirs is the Kingdom of Heaven.

text.KJV: Blessed are ye, when men shall revile you, and persecute you, and shall say all manner of evil against you falsely, for my sake.
text.ASV: Blessed are ye when `men' shall reproach you, and persecute you, and say all manner of evil against you falsely, for my sake.
text.WEB: “Blessed are you when people reproach you, persecute you, and say all kinds of evil against you falsely, for my sake.

text.KJV: Rejoice, and be exceeding glad: for great is your reward in heaven: for so persecuted they the prophets which were before you.
text.ASV: Rejoice, and be exceeding glad: for great is your reward in heaven: for so persecuted they the prophets that were before you.
text.WEB: Rejoice, and be exceedingly glad, for great is your reward in heaven. For that is how they persecuted the prophets who were before you.

text.KJV: Ye are the salt of the earth: but if the salt have lost his savour, wherewith shall it be salted? it is thenceforth good for nothing, but to be cast out, and to be trodden under foot of men.
text.ASV: Ye are the salt of the earth: but if the salt have lost its savor, wherewith shall it be salted? it is thenceforth good for nothing, but to be cast out and trodden under foot of men.
text.WEB: “You are the salt of the earth, but if the salt has lost its flavor, with what will it be salted? It is then good for nothing, but to be cast out and trodden under the feet of men.

text.KJV: Ye are the light of the world. A city that is set on an hill cannot be hid.
text.ASV: Ye are the light of the world. A city set on a hill cannot be hid.
text.WEB: You are the light of the world. A city located on a hill can’t be hidden.

text.KJV: Neither do men light a candle, and put it under a bushel, but on a candlestick; and it giveth light unto all that are in the house.
text.ASV: Neither do `men' light a lamp, and put it under the bushel, but on the stand; and it shineth unto all that are in the house.
text.WEB: Neither do you light a lamp, and put it under a measuring basket, but on a stand; and it shines to all who are in the house.

text.KJV: Let your light so shine before men, that they may see your good works, and glorify your Father which is in heaven.
text.ASV: Even so let your light shine before men; that they may see your good works, and glorify your Father who is in heaven.
text.WEB: Even so, let your light shine before men; that they may see your good works, and glorify your Father who is in heaven.

text.KJV: Think not that I am come to destroy the law, or the prophets: I am not come to destroy, but to fulfil.
text.ASV: Think not that I came to destroy the law or the prophets: I came not to destroy, but to fulfil.
text.WEB: “Don’t think that I came to destroy the law or the prophets. I didn’t come to destroy, but to fulfill.

text.KJV: For verily I say unto you, Till heaven and earth pass, one jot or one tittle shall in no wise pass from the law, till all be fulfilled.
text.ASV: For verily I say unto you, Till heaven and earth pass away, one jot or one tittle shall in no wise pass away from the law, till all things be accomplished.
text.WEB: For most certainly, I tell you, until heaven and earth pass away, not even one smallest letter or one tiny pen stroke shall in any way pass away from the law, until all things are accomplished.

text.KJV: Whosoever therefore shall break one of these least commandments, and shall teach men so, he shall be called the least in the kingdom of heaven: but whosoever shall do and teach them, the same shall be called great in the kingdom of heaven.
text.ASV: Whosoever therefore shall break one of these least commandments, and shall teach men so, shall be called least in the kingdom of heaven: but whosoever shall do and teach them, he shall be called great in the kingdom of heaven.
text.WEB: Whoever, therefore, shall break one of these least commandments, and teach others to do so, shall be called least in the Kingdom of Heaven; but whoever shall do and teach them shall be called great in the Kingdom of Heaven.

text.KJV: For I say unto you, That except your righteousness shall exceed the righteousness of the scribes and Pharisees, ye shall in no case enter into the kingdom of heaven.
text.ASV: For I say unto you, that except your righteousness shall exceed `the righteousness' of the scribes and Pharisees, ye shall in no wise enter into the kingdom of heaven.
text.WEB: For I tell you that unless your righteousness exceeds that of the scribes and Pharisees, there is no way you will enter into the Kingdom of Heaven.

text.KJV: Ye have heard that it was said of them of old time, Thou shalt not kill; and whosoever shall kill shall be in danger of the judgment:
text.ASV: Ye have heard that it was said to them of old time, Thou shalt not kill; and whosoever shall kill shall be in danger of the judgment:
text.WEB: “You have heard that it was said to the ancient ones, ‘You shall not murder;’ and ‘Whoever murders will be in danger of the judgment.’

text.KJV: But I say unto you, That whosoever is angry with his brother without a cause shall be in danger of the judgment: and whosoever shall say to his brother, Raca, shall be in danger of the council: but whosoever shall say, Thou fool, shall be in danger of hell fire.
text.ASV: but I say unto you, that every one who is angry with his brother shall be in danger of the judgment; and whosoever shall say to his brother, Raca, shall be in danger of the council; and whosoever shall say, Thou fool, shall be in danger of the hell of fire.
text.WEB: But I tell you, that everyone who is angry with his brother without a cause will be in danger of the judgment; and whoever says to his brother, ‘Raca!’ will be in danger of the council; and whoever says, ‘You fool!’ will be in danger of the fire of Gehenna.

text.KJV: Therefore if thou bring thy gift to the altar, and there rememberest that thy brother hath ought against thee;
text.ASV: If therefore thou art offering thy gift at the altar, and there rememberest that thy brother hath aught against thee,
text.WEB: “If therefore you are offering your gift at the altar, and there remember that your brother has anything against you,

text.KJV: Leave there thy gift before the altar, and go thy way; first be reconciled to thy brother, and then come and offer thy gift.
text.ASV: leave there thy gift before the altar, and go thy way, first be reconciled to thy brother, and then come and offer thy gift.
text.WEB: leave your gift there before the altar, and go your way. First be reconciled to your brother, and then come and offer your gift.

text.KJV: Agree with thine adversary quickly, whiles thou art in the way with him; lest at any time the adversary deliver thee to the judge, and the judge deliver thee to the officer, and thou be cast into prison.
text.ASV: Agree with thine adversary quickly, while thou art with him in the way; lest haply the adversary deliver thee to the judge, and the judge deliver thee to the officer, and thou be cast into prison.
text.WEB: Agree with your adversary quickly, while you are with him on the way; lest perhaps the prosecutor deliver you to the judge, and the judge deliver you to the officer, and you be cast into prison.

text.KJV: Verily I say unto thee, Thou shalt by no means come out thence, till thou hast paid the uttermost farthing.
text.ASV: Verily I say unto thee, thou shalt by no means come out thence, till thou have paid the last farthing.
text.WEB: Most certainly I tell you, you shall by no means get out of there, until you have paid the last penny.

text.KJV: Ye have heard that it was said by them of old time, Thou shalt not commit adultery:
text.ASV: Ye have heard that it was said, Thou shalt not commit adultery:
text.WEB: “You have heard that it was said, ‘You shall not commit adultery;’

text.KJV: But I say unto you, That whosoever looketh on a woman to lust after her hath committed adultery with her already in his heart.
text.ASV: but I say unto you, that every one that looketh on a woman to lust after her hath committed adultery with her already in his heart.
text.WEB: but I tell you that everyone who gazes at a woman to lust after her has committed adultery with her already in his heart.

text.KJV: And if thy right eye offend thee, pluck it out, and cast it from thee: for it is profitable for thee that one of thy members should perish, and not that thy whole body should be cast into hell.
text.ASV: And if thy right eye causeth thee to stumble, pluck it out, and cast it from thee: for it is profitable for thee that one of thy members should perish, and not thy whole body be cast into hell.
text.WEB: If your right eye causes you to stumble, pluck it out and throw it away from you. For it is more profitable for you that one of your members should perish, than for your whole body to be cast into Gehenna.

text.KJV: And if thy right hand offend thee, cut it off, and cast it from thee: for it is profitable for thee that one of thy members should perish, and not that thy whole body should be cast into hell.
text.ASV: And if thy right hand causeth thee to stumble, cut it off, and cast it from thee: for it is profitable for thee that one of thy members should perish, and not thy whole body go into hell.
text.WEB: If your right hand causes you to stumble, cut it off, and throw it away from you. For it is more profitable for you that one of your members should perish, than for your whole body to be cast into Gehenna.

text.KJV: It hath been said, Whosoever shall put away his wife, let him give her a writing of divorcement:
text.ASV: It was said also, Whosoever shall put away his wife, let him give her a writing of divorcement:
text.WEB: “It was also said, ‘Whoever shall put away his wife, let him give her a writing of divorce,’

text.KJV: But I say unto you, That whosoever shall put away his wife, saving for the cause of fornication, causeth her to commit adultery: and whosoever shall marry her that is divorced committeth adultery.
text.ASV: but I say unto you, that every one that putteth away his wife, saving for the cause of fornication, maketh her an adulteress: and whosoever shall marry her when she is put away committeth adultery.
text.WEB: but I tell you that whoever puts away his wife, except for the cause of sexual immorality, makes her an adulteress; and whoever marries her when she is put away commits adultery.

text.KJV: Again, ye have heard that it hath been said by them of old time, Thou shalt not forswear thyself, but shalt perform unto the Lord thine oaths:
text.ASV: Again, ye have heard that it was said to them of old time, Thou shalt not forswear thyself, but shalt perform unto the Lord thine oaths:
text.WEB: “Again you have heard that it was said to them of old time, ‘You shall not make false vows, but shall perform to the Lord your vows,’

text.KJV: But I say unto you, Swear not at all; neither by heaven; for it is God's throne:
text.ASV: but I say unto you, swear not at all; neither by the heaven, for it is the throne of God;
text.WEB: but I tell you, don’t swear at all: neither by heaven, for it is the throne of God;

text.KJV: Nor by the earth; for it is his footstool: neither by Jerusalem; for it is the city of the great King.
text.ASV: nor by the earth, for it is the footstool of his feet; nor by Jerusalem, for it is the city of the great King.
text.WEB: nor by the earth, for it is the footstool of his feet; nor by Jerusalem, for it is the city of the great King.

text.KJV: Neither shalt thou swear by thy head, because thou canst not make one hair white or black.
text.ASV: Neither shalt thou swear by thy head, for thou canst not make one hair white or black.
text.WEB: Neither shall you swear by your head, for you can’t make one hair white or black.

text.KJV: But let your communication be, Yea, yea; Nay, nay: for whatsoever is more than these cometh of evil.
text.ASV: But let your speech be, Yea, yea; Nay, nay: and whatsoever is more than these is of the evil `one'.
text.WEB: But let your ‘Yes’ be ‘Yes’ and your ‘No’ be ‘No.’ Whatever is more than these is of the evil one.

text.KJV: Ye have heard that it hath been said, An eye for an eye, and a tooth for a tooth:
text.ASV: Ye have heard that it was said, An eye for an eye, and a tooth for a tooth:
text.WEB: “You have heard that it was said, ‘An eye for an eye, and a tooth for a tooth.’; ;

text.KJV: But I say unto you, That ye resist not evil: but whosoever shall smite thee on thy right cheek, turn to him the other also.
text.ASV: but I say unto you, resist not him that is evil: but whosoever smiteth thee on thy right cheek, turn to him the other also.
text.WEB: But I tell you, don’t resist him who is evil; but whoever strikes you on your right cheek, turn to him the other also.

text.KJV: And if any man will sue thee at the law, and take away thy coat, let him have thy cloak also.
text.ASV: And if any man would go to law with thee, and take away thy coat, let him have thy cloak also.
text.WEB: If anyone sues you to take away your coat, let him have your cloak also.

text.KJV: And whosoever shall compel thee to go a mile, go with him twain.
text.ASV: And whosoever shall compel thee to go one mile, go with him two.
text.WEB: Whoever compels you to go one mile, go with him two.

text.KJV: Give to him that asketh thee, and from him that would borrow of thee turn not thou away.
text.ASV: Give to him that asketh thee, and from him that would borrow of thee turn not thou away.
text.WEB: Give to him who asks you, and don’t turn away him who desires to borrow from you.

text.KJV: Ye have heard that it hath been said, Thou shalt love thy neighbour, and hate thine enemy.
text.ASV: Ye have heard that it was said, Thou shalt love thy neighbor, and hate thine enemy:
text.WEB: “You have heard that it was said, ‘You shall love your neighbor and hate your enemy.’

text.KJV: But I say unto you, Love your enemies, bless them that curse you, do good to them that hate you, and pray for them which despitefully use you, and persecute you;
text.ASV: but I say unto you, love your enemies, and pray for them that persecute you;
text.WEB: But I tell you, love your enemies, bless those who curse you, do good to those who hate you, and pray for those who mistreat you and persecute you,

text.KJV: That ye may be the children of your Father which is in heaven: for he maketh his sun to rise on the evil and on the good, and sendeth rain on the just and on the unjust.
text.ASV: that ye may be sons of your Father who is in heaven: for he maketh his sun to rise on the evil and the good, and sendeth rain on the just and the unjust.
text.WEB: that you may be children of your Father who is in heaven. For he makes his sun to rise on the evil and the good, and sends rain on the just and the unjust.

text.KJV: For if ye love them which love you, what reward have ye? do not even the publicans the same?
text.ASV: For if ye love them that love you, what reward have ye? do not even the publicans the same?
text.WEB: For if you love those who love you, what reward do you have? Don’t even the tax collectors do the same?

text.KJV: And if ye salute your brethren only, what do ye more than others? do not even the publicans so?
text.ASV: And if ye salute your brethren only, what do ye more `than others?' do not even the Gentiles the same?
text.WEB: If you only greet your friends, what more do you do than others? Don’t even the tax collectors do the same?

text.KJV: Be ye therefore perfect, even as your Father which is in heaven is perfect.
text.ASV: Ye therefore shall be perfect, as your heavenly Father is perfect.
text.WEB: Therefore you shall be perfect, just as your Father in heaven is perfect.

text.KJV: Take heed that ye do not your alms before men, to be seen of them: otherwise ye have no reward of your Father which is in heaven.
text.ASV: Take heed that ye do not your righteousness before men, to be seen of them: else ye have no reward with your Father who is in heaven.
text.WEB: “Be careful that you don’t do your charitable giving before men, to be seen by them, or else you have no reward from your Father who is in heaven.

text.KJV: Therefore when thou doest thine alms, do not sound a trumpet before thee, as the hypocrites do in the synagogues and in the streets, that they may have glory of men. Verily I say unto you, They have their reward.
text.ASV: When therefore thou doest alms, sound not a trumpet before thee, as the hypocrites do in the synagogues and in the streets, that they may have glory of men. Verily I say unto you, They have received their reward.
text.WEB: Therefore when you do merciful deeds, don’t sound a trumpet before yourself, as the hypocrites do in the synagogues and in the streets, that they may get glory from men. Most certainly I tell you, they have received their reward.

text.KJV: But when thou doest alms, let not thy left hand know what thy right hand doeth:
text.ASV: But when thou doest alms, let not thy left hand know what thy right hand doeth:
text.WEB: But when you do merciful deeds, don’t let your left hand know what your right hand does,

text.KJV: That thine alms may be in secret: and thy Father which seeth in secret himself shall reward thee openly.
text.ASV: that thine alms may be in secret: and thy Father who seeth in secret shall recompense thee.
text.WEB: so that your merciful deeds may be in secret, then your Father who sees in secret will reward you openly.

text.KJV: And when thou prayest, thou shalt not be as the hypocrites are: for they love to pray standing in the synagogues and in the corners of the streets, that they may be seen of men. Verily I say unto you, They have their reward.
text.ASV: And when ye pray, ye shall not be as the hypocrites: for they love to stand and pray in the synagogues and in the corners of the streets, that they may be seen of men. Verily I say unto you, They have received their reward.
text.WEB: “When you pray, you shall not be as the hypocrites, for they love to stand and pray in the synagogues and in the corners of the streets, that they may be seen by men. Most certainly, I tell you, they have received their reward.

text.KJV: But thou, when thou prayest, enter into thy closet, and when thou hast shut thy door, pray to thy Father which is in secret; and thy Father which seeth in secret shall reward thee openly.
text.ASV: But thou, when thou prayest, enter into thine inner chamber, and having shut thy door, pray to thy Father who is in secret, and thy Father who seeth in secret shall recompense thee.
text.WEB: But you, when you pray, enter into your inner room, and having shut your door, pray to your Father who is in secret, and your Father who sees in secret will reward you openly.

text.KJV: But when ye pray, use not vain repetitions, as the heathen do: for they think that they shall be heard for their much speaking.
text.ASV: And in praying use not vain repetitions, as the Gentiles do: for they think that they shall be heard for their much speaking.
text.WEB: In praying, don’t use vain repetitions, as the Gentiles do; for they think that they will be heard for their much speaking.

text.KJV: Be not ye therefore like unto them: for your Father knoweth what things ye have need of, before ye ask him.
text.ASV: Be not therefore like unto them: for your Father knoweth what things ye have need of, before ye ask him.
text.WEB: Therefore don’t be like them, for your Father knows what things you need, before you ask him.

text.KJV: After this manner therefore pray ye: Our Father which art in heaven, Hallowed be thy name.
text.ASV: After this manner therefore pray ye. Our Father who art in heaven, Hallowed be thy name.
text.WEB: Pray like this: ‘Our Father in heaven, may your name be kept holy.

text.KJV: Thy kingdom come, Thy will be done in earth, as it is in heaven.
text.ASV: Thy kingdom come. Thy will be done, as in heaven, so on earth.
text.WEB: Let your Kingdom come. Let your will be done, as in heaven, so on earth.

text.KJV: Give us this day our daily bread.
text.ASV: Give us this day our daily bread.
text.WEB: Give us today our daily bread.

text.KJV: And forgive us our debts, as we forgive our debtors.
text.ASV: And forgive us our debts, as we also have forgiven our debtors.
text.WEB: Forgive us our debts, as we also forgive our debtors.

text.KJV: And lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil: For thine is the kingdom, and the power, and the glory, for ever. Amen.
text.ASV: And bring us not into temptation, but deliver us from the evil `one.'
text.WEB: Bring us not into temptation, but deliver us from the evil one. For yours is the Kingdom, the power, and the glory forever. Amen.’

text.KJV: For if ye forgive men their trespasses, your heavenly Father will also forgive you:
text.ASV: For if ye forgive men their trespasses, your heavenly Father will also forgive you.
text.WEB: “For if you forgive men their trespasses, your heavenly Father will also forgive you.

text.KJV: But if ye forgive not men their trespasses, neither will your Father forgive your trespasses.
text.ASV: But if ye forgive not men their trespasses, neither will your Father forgive your trespasses.
text.WEB: But if you don’t forgive men their trespasses, neither will your Father forgive your trespasses.

text.KJV: Moreover when ye fast, be not, as the hypocrites, of a sad countenance: for they disfigure their faces, that they may appear unto men to fast. Verily I say unto you, They have their reward.
text.ASV: Moreover when ye fast, be not, as the hypocrites, of a sad countenance: for they disfigure their faces, that they may be seen of men to fast. Verily I say unto you, They have received their reward.
text.WEB: “Moreover when you fast, don’t be like the hypocrites, with sad faces. For they disfigure their faces, that they may be seen by men to be fasting. Most certainly I tell you, they have received their reward.

text.KJV: But thou, when thou fastest, anoint thine head, and wash thy face;
text.ASV: But thou, when thou fastest, anoint thy head, and wash thy face;
text.WEB: But you, when you fast, anoint your head, and wash your face;

text.KJV: That thou appear not unto men to fast, but unto thy Father which is in secret: and thy Father, which seeth in secret, shall reward thee openly.
text.ASV: that thou be not seen of men to fast, but of thy Father who is in secret: and thy Father, who seeth in secret, shall recompense thee.
text.WEB: so that you are not seen by men to be fasting, but by your Father who is in secret, and your Father, who sees in secret, will reward you.

text.KJV: Lay not up for yourselves treasures upon earth, where moth and rust doth corrupt, and where thieves break through and steal:
text.ASV: Lay not up for yourselves treasures upon the earth, where moth and rust consume, and where thieves break through and steal:
text.WEB: “Don’t lay up treasures for yourselves on the earth, where moth and rust consume, and where thieves break through and steal;

text.KJV: But lay up for yourselves treasures in heaven, where neither moth nor rust doth corrupt, and where thieves do not break through nor steal:
text.ASV: but lay up for yourselves treasures in heaven, where neither moth nor rust doth consume, and where thieves do not break through nor steal:
text.WEB: but lay up for yourselves treasures in heaven, where neither moth nor rust consume, and where thieves don’t break through and steal;

text.KJV: For where your treasure is, there will your heart be also.
text.ASV: for where thy treasure is, there will thy heart be also.
text.WEB: for where your treasure is, there your heart will be also.

text.KJV: The light of the body is the eye: if therefore thine eye be single, thy whole body shall be full of light.
text.ASV: The lamp of the body is the eye: if therefore thine eye be single, thy whole body shall be full of light.
text.WEB: “The lamp of the body is the eye. If therefore your eye is sound, your whole body will be full of light.

text.KJV: But if thine eye be evil, thy whole body shall be full of darkness. If therefore the light that is in thee be darkness, how great is that darkness!
text.ASV: But if thine eye be evil, thy whole body shall be full of darkness. If therefore the light that is in thee be darkness, how great is the darkness!
text.WEB: But if your eye is evil, your whole body will be full of darkness. If therefore the light that is in you is darkness, how great is the darkness!

text.KJV: No man can serve two masters: for either he will hate the one, and love the other; or else he will hold to the one, and despise the other. Ye cannot serve God and mammon.
text.ASV: No man can serve two masters; for either he will hate the one, and love the other; or else he will hold to one, and despise the other. Ye cannot serve God and mammon.
text.WEB: “No one can serve two masters, for either he will hate the one and love the other; or else he will be devoted to one and despise the other. You can’t serve both God and Mammon.

text.KJV: Therefore I say unto you, Take no thought for your life, what ye shall eat, or what ye shall drink; nor yet for your body, what ye shall put on. Is not the life more than meat, and the body than raiment?
text.ASV: Therefore I say unto you, be not anxious for your life, what ye shall eat, or what ye shall drink; nor yet for your body, what ye shall put on. Is not the life more than the food, and the body than the raiment?
text.WEB: Therefore I tell you, don’t be anxious for your life: what you will eat, or what you will drink; nor yet for your body, what you will wear. Isn’t life more than food, and the body more than clothing?

text.KJV: Behold the fowls of the air: for they sow not, neither do they reap, nor gather into barns; yet your heavenly Father feedeth them. Are ye not much better than they?
text.ASV: Behold the birds of the heaven, that they sow not, neither do they reap, nor gather into barns; and your heavenly Father feedeth them. Are not ye of much more value then they?
text.WEB: See the birds of the sky, that they don’t sow, neither do they reap, nor gather into barns. Your heavenly Father feeds them. Aren’t you of much more value than they?

text.KJV: Which of you by taking thought can add one cubit unto his stature?
text.ASV: And which of you by being anxious can add one cubit unto the measure of his life?
text.WEB: “Which of you, by being anxious, can add one moment to his lifespan?

text.KJV: And why take ye thought for raiment? Consider the lilies of the field, how they grow; they toil not, neither do they spin:
text.ASV: And why are ye anxious concerning raiment? Consider the lilies of the field, how they grow; they toil not, neither do they spin:
text.WEB: Why are you anxious about clothing? Consider the lilies of the field, how they grow. They don’t toil, neither do they spin,

text.KJV: And yet I say unto you, That even Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these.
text.ASV: yet I say unto you, that even Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these.
text.WEB: yet I tell you that even Solomon in all his glory was not dressed like one of these.

text.KJV: Wherefore, if God so clothe the grass of the field, which to day is, and to morrow is cast into the oven, shall he not much more clothe you, O ye of little faith?
text.ASV: But if God doth so clothe the grass of the field, which to-day is, and to-morrow is cast into the oven, `shall he' not much more `clothe' you, O ye of little faith?
text.WEB: But if God so clothes the grass of the field, which today exists, and tomorrow is thrown into the oven, won’t he much more clothe you, you of little faith?

text.KJV: Therefore take no thought, saying, What shall we eat? or, What shall we drink? or, Wherewithal shall we be clothed?
text.ASV: Be not therefore anxious, saying, What shall we eat? or, What shall we drink? or, Wherewithal shall we be clothed?
text.WEB: “Therefore don’t be anxious, saying, ‘What will we eat?’, ‘What will we drink?’ or, ‘With what will we be clothed?’

text.KJV: (For after all these things do the Gentiles seek:) for your heavenly Father knoweth that ye have need of all these things.
text.ASV: For after all these things do the Gentiles seek; for your heavenly Father knoweth that ye have need of all these things.
text.WEB: For the Gentiles seek after all these things; for your heavenly Father knows that you need all these things.

text.KJV: But seek ye first the kingdom of God, and his righteousness; and all these things shall be added unto you.
text.ASV: But seek ye first his kingdom, and his righteousness; and all these things shall be added unto you.
text.WEB: But seek first God’s Kingdom, and his righteousness; and all these things will be given to you as well.

text.KJV: Take therefore no thought for the morrow: for the morrow shall take thought for the things of itself. Sufficient unto the day is the evil thereof.
text.ASV: Be not therefore anxious for the morrow: for the morrow will be anxious for itself. Sufficient unto the day is the evil thereof.
text.WEB: Therefore don’t be anxious for tomorrow, for tomorrow will be anxious for itself. Each day’s own evil is sufficient.

text.KJV: Judge not, that ye be not judged.
text.ASV: Judge not, that ye be not judged.
text.WEB: “Don’t judge, so that you won’t be judged.

text.KJV: For with what judgment ye judge, ye shall be judged: and with what measure ye mete, it shall be measured to you again.
text.ASV: For with what judgment ye judge, ye shall be judged: and with what measure ye mete, it shall be measured unto you.
text.WEB: For with whatever judgment you judge, you will be judged; and with whatever measure you measure, it will be measured to you.

text.KJV: And why beholdest thou the mote that is in thy brother's eye, but considerest not the beam that is in thine own eye?
text.ASV: And why beholdest thou the mote that is in thy brother's eye, but considerest not the beam that is in thine own eye?
text.WEB: Why do you see the speck that is in your brother’s eye, but don’t consider the beam that is in your own eye?

text.KJV: Or how wilt thou say to thy brother, Let me pull out the mote out of thine eye; and, behold, a beam is in thine own eye?
text.ASV: Or how wilt thou say to thy brother, Let me cast out the mote out of thine eye; and lo, the beam is in thine own eye?
text.WEB: Or how will you tell your brother, ‘Let me remove the speck from your eye;’ and behold, the beam is in your own eye?

text.KJV: Thou hypocrite, first cast out the beam out of thine own eye; and then shalt thou see clearly to cast out the mote out of thy brother's eye.
text.ASV: Thou hypocrite, cast out first the beam out of thine own eye; and then shalt thou see clearly to cast out the mote out of thy brother's eye.
text.WEB: You hypocrite! First remove the beam out of your own eye, and then you can see clearly to remove the speck out of your brother’s eye.

text.KJV: Give not that which is holy unto the dogs, neither cast ye your pearls before swine, lest they trample them under their feet, and turn again and rend you.
text.ASV: Give not that which is holy unto the dogs, neither cast your pearls before the swine, lest haply they trample them under their feet, and turn and rend you.
text.WEB: “Don’t give that which is holy to the dogs, neither throw your pearls before the pigs, lest perhaps they trample them under their feet, and turn and tear you to pieces.

text.KJV: Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and ye shall find; knock, and it shall be opened unto you:
text.ASV: Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and ye shall find; knock, and it shall be opened unto you:
text.WEB: “Ask, and it will be given you. Seek, and you will find. Knock, and it will be opened for you.

text.KJV: For every one that asketh receiveth; and he that seeketh findeth; and to him that knocketh it shall be opened.
text.ASV: for every one that asketh receiveth; and he that seeketh findeth; and to him that knocketh it shall be opened.
text.WEB: For everyone who asks receives. He who seeks finds. To him who knocks it will be opened.

text.KJV: Or what man is there of you, whom if his son ask bread, will he give him a stone?
text.ASV: Or what man is there of you, who, if his son shall ask him for a loaf, will give him a stone;
text.WEB: Or who is there among you, who, if his son asks him for bread, will give him a stone?

text.KJV: Or if he ask a fish, will he give him a serpent?
text.ASV: or if he shall ask for a fish, will give him a serpent?
text.WEB: Or if he asks for a fish, who will give him a serpent?

text.KJV: If ye then, being evil, know how to give good gifts unto your children, how much more shall your Father which is in heaven give good things to them that ask him?
text.ASV: If ye then, being evil, know how to give good gifts unto your children, how much more shall your Father who is in heaven give good things to them that ask him?
text.WEB: If you then, being evil, know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your Father who is in heaven give good things to those who ask him!

text.KJV: Therefore all things whatsoever ye would that men should do to you, do ye even so to them: for this is the law and the prophets.
text.ASV: All things therefore whatsoever ye would that men should do unto you, even so do ye also unto them: for this is the law and the prophets.
text.WEB: Therefore whatever you desire for men to do to you, you shall also do to them; for this is the law and the prophets.

text.KJV: Enter ye in at the strait gate: for wide is the gate, and broad is the way, that leadeth to destruction, and many there be which go in thereat:
text.ASV: Enter ye in by the narrow gate: for wide is the gate, and broad is the way, that leadeth to destruction, and many are they that enter in thereby.
text.WEB: “Enter in by the narrow gate; for wide is the gate and broad is the way that leads to destruction, and many are those who enter in by it.

text.KJV: Because strait is the gate, and narrow is the way, which leadeth unto life, and few there be that find it.
text.ASV: For narrow is the gate, and straitened the way, that leadeth unto life, and few are they that find it.
text.WEB: How narrow is the gate, and restricted is the way that leads to life! Few are those who find it.

text.KJV: Beware of false prophets, which come to you in sheep's clothing, but inwardly they are ravening wolves.
text.ASV: Beware of false prophets, who come to you in sheep's clothing, but inwardly are ravening wolves.
text.WEB: “Beware of false prophets, who come to you in sheep’s clothing, but inwardly are ravening wolves.

text.KJV: Ye shall know them by their fruits. Do men gather grapes of thorns, or figs of thistles?
text.ASV: By their fruits ye shall know them. Do `men' gather grapes of thorns, or figs of thistles?
text.WEB: By their fruits you will know them. Do you gather grapes from thorns, or figs from thistles?

text.KJV: Even so every good tree bringeth forth good fruit; but a corrupt tree bringeth forth evil fruit.
text.ASV: Even so every good tree bringeth forth good fruit; but the corrupt tree bringeth forth evil fruit.
text.WEB: Even so, every good tree produces good fruit; but the corrupt tree produces evil fruit.

text.KJV: A good tree cannot bring forth evil fruit, neither can a corrupt tree bring forth good fruit.
text.ASV: A good tree cannot bring forth evil fruit, neither can a corrupt tree bring forth good fruit.
text.WEB: A good tree can’t produce evil fruit, neither can a corrupt tree produce good fruit.

text.KJV: Every tree that bringeth not forth good fruit is hewn down, and cast into the fire.
text.ASV: Every tree that bringeth not forth good fruit is hewn down, and cast into the fire.
text.WEB: Every tree that doesn’t grow good fruit is cut down, and thrown into the fire.

text.KJV: Wherefore by their fruits ye shall know them.
text.ASV: Therefore by their fruits ye shall know them.
text.WEB: Therefore by their fruits you will know them.

text.KJV: Not every one that saith unto me, Lord, Lord, shall enter into the kingdom of heaven; but he that doeth the will of my Father which is in heaven.
text.ASV: Not every one that saith unto me, Lord, Lord, shall enter into the kingdom of heaven; but he that doeth the will of my Father who is in heaven.
text.WEB: Not everyone who says to me, ‘Lord, Lord,’ will enter into the Kingdom of Heaven; but he who does the will of my Father who is in heaven.

text.KJV: Many will say to me in that day, Lord, Lord, have we not prophesied in thy name? and in thy name have cast out devils? and in thy name done many wonderful works?
text.ASV: Many will say to me in that day, Lord, Lord, did we not prophesy by thy name, and by thy name cast out demons, and by thy name do many mighty works?
text.WEB: Many will tell me in that day, ‘Lord, Lord, didn’t we prophesy in your name, in your name cast out demons, and in your name do many mighty works?’

text.KJV: And then will I profess unto them, I never knew you: depart from me, ye that work iniquity.
text.ASV: And then will I profess unto them, I never knew you: depart from me, ye that work iniquity.
text.WEB: Then I will tell them, ‘I never knew you. Depart from me, you who work iniquity.’

text.KJV: Therefore whosoever heareth these sayings of mine, and doeth them, I will liken him unto a wise man, which built his house upon a rock:
text.ASV: Every one therefore that heareth these words of mine, and doeth them, shall be likened unto a wise man, who built his house upon the rock:
text.WEB: “Everyone therefore who hears these words of mine, and does them, I will liken him to a wise man, who built his house on a rock.

text.KJV: And the rain descended, and the floods came, and the winds blew, and beat upon that house; and it fell not: for it was founded upon a rock.
text.ASV: and the rain descended, and the floods came, and the winds blew, and beat upon that house; and if fell not: for it was founded upon the rock.
text.WEB: The rain came down, the floods came, and the winds blew, and beat on that house; and it didn’t fall, for it was founded on the rock.

text.KJV: And every one that heareth these sayings of mine, and doeth them not, shall be likened unto a foolish man, which built his house upon the sand:
text.ASV: And every one that heareth these words of mine, and doeth them not, shall be likened unto a foolish man, who built his house upon the sand:
text.WEB: Everyone who hears these words of mine, and doesn’t do them will be like a foolish man, who built his house on the sand.

text.KJV: And the rain descended, and the floods came, and the winds blew, and beat upon that house; and it fell: and great was the fall of it.
text.ASV: and the rain descended, and the floods came, and the winds blew, and smote upon that house; and it fell: and great was the fall thereof.
text.WEB: The rain came down, the floods came, and the winds blew, and beat on that house; and it fell—and great was its fall.”

text.KJV: And it came to pass, when Jesus had ended these sayings, the people were astonished at his doctrine:
text.ASV: And it came to pass, when Jesus had finished these words, the multitudes were astonished at his teaching:
text.WEB: When Jesus had finished saying these things, the multitudes were astonished at his teaching,

text.KJV: For he taught them as one having authority, and not as the scribes.
text.ASV: for he taught them as `one' having authority, and not as their scribes.
text.WEB: for he taught them with authority, and not like the scribes.

text.KJV: When he was come down from the mountain, great multitudes followed him.
text.ASV: And when he was come down from the mountain, great multitudes followed him.
text.WEB: When he came down from the mountain, great multitudes followed him.

text.KJV: And, behold, there came a leper and worshipped him, saying, Lord, if thou wilt, thou canst make me clean.
text.ASV: And behold, there came to him a leper and worshipped him, saying, Lord, if thou wilt, thou canst make me clean.
text.WEB: Behold, a leper came to him and worshiped him, saying, “Lord, if you want to, you can make me clean.”

text.KJV: And Jesus put forth his hand, and touched him, saying, I will; be thou clean. And immediately his leprosy was cleansed.
text.ASV: And he stretched forth his hand, and touched him, saying, I will; be thou made clean. And straightway his leprosy was cleansed.
text.WEB: Jesus stretched out his hand, and touched him, saying, “I want to. Be made clean.” Immediately his leprosy was cleansed.

text.KJV: And Jesus saith unto him, See thou tell no man; but go thy way, shew thyself to the priest, and offer the gift that Moses commanded, for a testimony unto them.
text.ASV: And Jesus saith unto him, See thou tell no man; but go, show thyself to the priest, and offer the gift that Moses commanded, for a testimony unto them.
text.WEB: Jesus said to him, “See that you tell nobody, but go, show yourself to the priest, and offer the gift that Moses commanded, as a testimony to them.”

text.KJV: And when Jesus was entered into Capernaum, there came unto him a centurion, beseeching him,
text.ASV: And when he was entered into Capernaum, there came unto him a centurion, beseeching him,
text.WEB: When he came into Capernaum, a centurion came to him, asking him,

text.KJV: And saying, Lord, my servant lieth at home sick of the palsy, grievously tormented.
text.ASV: and saying, Lord, my servant lieth in the house sick of the palsy, grievously tormented.
text.WEB: and saying, “Lord, my servant lies in the house paralyzed, grievously tormented.”

text.KJV: And Jesus saith unto him, I will come and heal him.
text.ASV: And he saith unto him, I will come and heal him.
text.WEB: Jesus said to him, “I will come and heal him.”

text.KJV: The centurion answered and said, Lord, I am not worthy that thou shouldest come under my roof: but speak the word only, and my servant shall be healed.
