text.ASV: And the centurion answered and said, Lord, I am not worthy that thou shouldest come under my roof; but only say the word, and my servant shall be healed.
text.WEB: The centurion answered, “Lord, I’m not worthy for you to come under my roof. Just say the word, and my servant will be healed.

text.KJV: For I am a man under authority, having soldiers under me: and I say to this man, Go, and he goeth; and to another, Come, and he cometh; and to my servant, Do this, and he doeth it.
text.ASV: For I also am a man under authority, having under myself soldiers: and I say to this one, Go, and he goeth; and to another, Come, and he cometh; and to my servant, Do this, and he doeth it.
text.WEB: For I am also a man under authority, having under myself soldiers. I tell this one, ‘Go,’ and he goes; and tell another, ‘Come,’ and he comes; and tell my servant, ‘Do this,’ and he does it.”

text.KJV: When Jesus heard it, he marvelled, and said to them that followed, Verily I say unto you, I have not found so great faith, no, not in Israel.
text.ASV: And when Jesus heard it, he marvelled, and said to them that followed, Verily I say unto you, I have not found so great faith, no, not in Israel.
text.WEB: When Jesus heard it, he marveled, and said to those who followed, “Most certainly I tell you, I haven’t found so great a faith, not even in Israel.

text.KJV: And I say unto you, That many shall come from the east and west, and shall sit down with Abraham, and Isaac, and Jacob, in the kingdom of heaven.
text.ASV: And I say unto you, that many shall come from the east and the west, and shall sit down with Abraham, and Isaac, and Jacob, in the kingdom of heaven:
text.WEB: I tell you that many will come from the east and the west, and will sit down with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob in the Kingdom of Heaven,

text.KJV: But the children of the kingdom shall be cast out into outer darkness: there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
text.ASV: but the sons of the kingdom shall be cast forth into the outer darkness: there shall be the weeping and the gnashing of teeth.
text.WEB: but the children of the Kingdom will be thrown out into the outer darkness. There will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.”

text.KJV: And Jesus said unto the centurion, Go thy way; and as thou hast believed, so be it done unto thee. And his servant was healed in the selfsame hour.
text.ASV: And Jesus said unto the centurion, Go thy way; as thou hast believed, `so' be it done unto thee. And the servant was healed in that hour.
text.WEB: Jesus said to the centurion, “Go your way. Let it be done for you as you have believed.” His servant was healed in that hour.

text.KJV: And when Jesus was come into Peter's house, he saw his wife's mother laid, and sick of a fever.
text.ASV: And when Jesus was come into Peter's house, he saw his wife's mother lying sick of a fever.
text.WEB: When Jesus came into Peter’s house, he saw his wife’s mother lying sick with a fever.

text.KJV: And he touched her hand, and the fever left her: and she arose, and ministered unto them.
text.ASV: And he touched her hand, and the fever left her; and she arose, and ministered unto him.
text.WEB: He touched her hand, and the fever left her. She got up and served him.

text.KJV: When the even was come, they brought unto him many that were possessed with devils: and he cast out the spirits with his word, and healed all that were sick:
text.ASV: And when even was come, they brought unto him many possessed with demons: and he cast out the spirits with a word, and healed all that were sick:
text.WEB: When evening came, they brought to him many possessed with demons. He cast out the spirits with a word, and healed all who were sick;

text.KJV: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by Esaias the prophet, saying, Himself took our infirmities, and bare our sicknesses.
text.ASV: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through Isaiah the prophet, saying: Himself took our infirmities, and bare our diseases.
text.WEB: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through Isaiah the prophet, saying, “He took our infirmities, and bore our diseases.”

text.KJV: Now when Jesus saw great multitudes about him, he gave commandment to depart unto the other side.
text.ASV: Now when Jesus saw great multitudes about him, he gave commandments to depart unto the other side.
text.WEB: Now when Jesus saw great multitudes around him, he gave the order to depart to the other side.

text.KJV: And a certain scribe came, and said unto him, Master, I will follow thee whithersoever thou goest.
text.ASV: And there came a scribe, and said unto him, Teacher, I will follow thee whithersoever thou goest.
text.WEB: A scribe came, and said to him, “Teacher, I will follow you wherever you go.”

text.KJV: And Jesus saith unto him, The foxes have holes, and the birds of the air have nests; but the Son of man hath not where to lay his head.
text.ASV: And Jesus saith unto him, The foxes have holes, and the birds of the heaven `have' nests; but the Son of man hath not where to lay his head.
text.WEB: Jesus said to him, “The foxes have holes, and the birds of the sky have nests, but the Son of Man has nowhere to lay his head.”

text.KJV: And another of his disciples said unto him, Lord, suffer me first to go and bury my father.
text.ASV: And another of the disciples said unto him, Lord, suffer me first to go and bury my father.
text.WEB: Another of his disciples said to him, “Lord, allow me first to go and bury my father.”

text.KJV: But Jesus said unto him, Follow me; and let the dead bury their dead.
text.ASV: But Jesus saith unto him, Follow me; and leave the dead to bury their own dead.
text.WEB: But Jesus said to him, “Follow me, and leave the dead to bury their own dead.”

text.KJV: And when he was entered into a ship, his disciples followed him.
text.ASV: And when he was entered into a boat, his disciples followed him.
text.WEB: When he got into a boat, his disciples followed him.

text.KJV: And, behold, there arose a great tempest in the sea, insomuch that the ship was covered with the waves: but he was asleep.
text.ASV: And behold, there arose a great tempest in the sea, insomuch that the boat was covered with the waves: but he was asleep.
text.WEB: Behold, a violent storm came up on the sea, so much that the boat was covered with the waves, but he was asleep.

text.KJV: And his disciples came to him, and awoke him, saying, Lord, save us: we perish.
text.ASV: And they came to him, and awoke him, saying, Save, Lord; we perish.
text.WEB: They came to him, and woke him up, saying, “Save us, Lord! We are dying!”

text.KJV: And he saith unto them, Why are ye fearful, O ye of little faith? Then he arose, and rebuked the winds and the sea; and there was a great calm.
text.ASV: And he saith unto them, Why are ye fearful, O ye of little faith? Then he arose, and rebuked the winds and the sea; and there was a great calm.
text.WEB: He said to them, “Why are you fearful, O you of little faith?” Then he got up, rebuked the wind and the sea, and there was a great calm.

text.KJV: But the men marvelled, saying, What manner of man is this, that even the winds and the sea obey him!
text.ASV: And the men marvelled, saying, What manner of man is this, that even the winds and the sea obey him?
text.WEB: The men marveled, saying, “What kind of man is this, that even the wind and the sea obey him?”

text.KJV: And when he was come to the other side into the country of the Gergesenes, there met him two possessed with devils, coming out of the tombs, exceeding fierce, so that no man might pass by that way.
text.ASV: And when he was come to the other side into the country of the Gadarenes, there met him two possessed with demons, coming forth out of the tombs, exceeding fierce, so that no man could pass by that way.
text.WEB: When he came to the other side, into the country of the Gergesenes, two people possessed by demons met him there, coming out of the tombs, exceedingly fierce, so that nobody could pass that way.

text.KJV: And, behold, they cried out, saying, What have we to do with thee, Jesus, thou Son of God? art thou come hither to torment us before the time?
text.ASV: And behold, they cried out, saying, What have we to do with thee, thou Son of God? art thou come hither to torment us before the time?
text.WEB: Behold, they cried out, saying, “What do we have to do with you, Jesus, Son of God? Have you come here to torment us before the time?”

text.KJV: And there was a good way off from them an herd of many swine feeding.
text.ASV: Now there was afar off from them a herd of many swine feeding.
text.WEB: Now there was a herd of many pigs feeding far away from them.

text.KJV: So the devils besought him, saying, If thou cast us out, suffer us to go away into the herd of swine.
text.ASV: And the demons besought him, saying, If thou cast us out, send us away into the herd of swine.
text.WEB: The demons begged him, saying, “If you cast us out, permit us to go away into the herd of pigs.”

text.KJV: And he said unto them, Go. And when they were come out, they went into the herd of swine: and, behold, the whole herd of swine ran violently down a steep place into the sea, and perished in the waters.
text.ASV: And he said unto them, Go. And they came out, and went into the swine: and behold, the whole herd rushed down the steep into the sea, and perished in the waters.
text.WEB: He said to them, “Go!” They came out, and went into the herd of pigs: and behold, the whole herd of pigs rushed down the cliff into the sea, and died in the water.

text.KJV: And they that kept them fled, and went their ways into the city, and told every thing, and what was befallen to the possessed of the devils.
text.ASV: And they that fed them fled, and went away into the city, and told everything, and what was befallen to them that were possessed with demons.
text.WEB: Those who fed them fled, and went away into the city, and told everything, including what happened to those who were possessed with demons.

text.KJV: And, behold, the whole city came out to meet Jesus: and when they saw him, they besought him that he would depart out of their coasts.
text.ASV: And behold, all the city came out to meet Jesus: and when they saw him, they besought `him' that he would depart from their borders.
text.WEB: Behold, all the city came out to meet Jesus. When they saw him, they begged that he would depart from their borders.

text.KJV: And he entered into a ship, and passed over, and came into his own city.
text.ASV: And he entered into a boat, and crossed over, and came into his own city.
text.WEB: He entered into a boat, and crossed over, and came into his own city.

text.KJV: And, behold, they brought to him a man sick of the palsy, lying on a bed: and Jesus seeing their faith said unto the sick of the palsy; Son, be of good cheer; thy sins be forgiven thee.
text.ASV: And behold, they brought to him a man sick of the palsy, lying on a bed: and Jesus seeing their faith said unto the sick of the palsy, Son, be of good cheer; thy sins are forgiven.
text.WEB: Behold, they brought to him a man who was paralyzed, lying on a bed. Jesus, seeing their faith, said to the paralytic, “Son, cheer up! Your sins are forgiven you.”

text.KJV: And, behold, certain of the scribes said within themselves, This man blasphemeth.
text.ASV: And behold, certain of the scribes said within themselves, This man blasphemeth.
text.WEB: Behold, some of the scribes said to themselves, “This man blasphemes.”

text.KJV: And Jesus knowing their thoughts said, Wherefore think ye evil in your hearts?
text.ASV: And Jesus knowing their thoughts said, Wherefore think ye evil in your hearts?
text.WEB: Jesus, knowing their thoughts, said, “Why do you think evil in your hearts?

text.KJV: For whether is easier, to say, Thy sins be forgiven thee; or to say, Arise, and walk?
text.ASV: For which is easier, to say, Thy sins are forgiven; or to say, Arise, and walk?
text.WEB: For which is easier, to say, ‘Your sins are forgiven;’ or to say, ‘Get up, and walk?’

text.KJV: But that ye may know that the Son of man hath power on earth to forgive sins, (then saith he to the sick of the palsy,) Arise, take up thy bed, and go unto thine house.
text.ASV: But that ye may know that the Son of man hath authority on earth to forgive sins (then saith he to the sick of the palsy), Arise, and take up thy bed, and go up unto thy house.
text.WEB: But that you may know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins-” (then he said to the paralytic), “Get up, and take up your mat, and go to your house.”

text.KJV: And he arose, and departed to his house.
text.ASV: And he arose, and departed to his house.
text.WEB: He arose and departed to his house.

text.KJV: But when the multitudes saw it, they marvelled, and glorified God, which had given such power unto men.
text.ASV: But when the multitudes saw it, they were afraid, and glorified God, who had given such authority unto men.
text.WEB: But when the multitudes saw it, they marveled and glorified God, who had given such authority to men.

text.KJV: And as Jesus passed forth from thence, he saw a man, named Matthew, sitting at the receipt of custom: and he saith unto him, Follow me. And he arose, and followed him.
text.ASV: And as Jesus passed by from thence, he saw a man, called Matthew, sitting at the place of toll: and he saith unto him, Follow me. And he arose, and followed him.
text.WEB: As Jesus passed by from there, he saw a man called Matthew sitting at the tax collection office. He said to him, “Follow me.” He got up and followed him.

text.KJV: And it came to pass, as Jesus sat at meat in the house, behold, many publicans and sinners came and sat down with him and his disciples.
text.ASV: And it came to pass, as he sat at meat in the house, behold, many publicans and sinners came and sat down with Jesus and his disciples.
text.WEB: As he sat in the house, behold, many tax collectors and sinners came and sat down with Jesus and his disciples.

text.KJV: And when the Pharisees saw it, they said unto his disciples, Why eateth your Master with publicans and sinners?
text.ASV: And when the Pharisees saw it, they said unto his disciples, Why eateth your Teacher with the publicans and sinners?
text.WEB: When the Pharisees saw it, they said to his disciples, “Why does your teacher eat with tax collectors and sinners?”

text.KJV: But when Jesus heard that, he said unto them, They that be whole need not a physician, but they that are sick.
text.ASV: But when he heard it, he said, They that are whole have no need of a physician, but they that are sick.
text.WEB: When Jesus heard it, he said to them, “Those who are healthy have no need for a physician, but those who are sick do.

text.KJV: But go ye and learn what that meaneth, I will have mercy, and not sacrifice: for I am not come to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.
text.ASV: But go ye and learn what `this' meaneth, I desire mercy, and not sacrifice, for I came not to call the righteous, but sinners.
text.WEB: But you go and learn what this means: ‘I desire mercy, and not sacrifice,’ for I came not to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.”

text.KJV: Then came to him the disciples of John, saying, Why do we and the Pharisees fast oft, but thy disciples fast not?
text.ASV: Then come to him the disciples of John, saying, Why do we and the Pharisees fast oft, but thy disciples fast not?
text.WEB: Then John’s disciples came to him, saying, “Why do we and the Pharisees fast often, but your disciples don’t fast?”

text.KJV: And Jesus said unto them, Can the children of the bridechamber mourn, as long as the bridegroom is with them? but the days will come, when the bridegroom shall be taken from them, and then shall they fast.
text.ASV: And Jesus said unto them, Can the sons of the bridechamber mourn, as long as the bridegroom is with them? but the days will come, when the bridegroom shall be taken away from them, and then will they fast.
text.WEB: Jesus said to them, “Can the friends of the bridegroom mourn, as long as the bridegroom is with them? But the days will come when the bridegroom will be taken away from them, and then they will fast.

text.KJV: No man putteth a piece of new cloth unto an old garment, for that which is put in to fill it up taketh from the garment, and the rent is made worse.
text.ASV: And no man putteth a piece of undressed cloth upon an old garment; for that which should fill it up taketh from the garment, and a worse rent is made.
text.WEB: No one puts a piece of unshrunk cloth on an old garment; for the patch would tear away from the garment, and a worse hole is made.

text.KJV: Neither do men put new wine into old bottles: else the bottles break, and the wine runneth out, and the bottles perish: but they put new wine into new bottles, and both are preserved.
text.ASV: Neither do `men' put new wine into old wine-skins: else the skins burst, and the wine is spilled, and the skins perish: but they put new wine into fresh wine-skins, and both are preserved.
text.WEB: Neither do people put new wine into old wine skins, or else the skins would burst, and the wine be spilled, and the skins ruined. No, they put new wine into fresh wine skins, and both are preserved.”

text.KJV: While he spake these things unto them, behold, there came a certain ruler, and worshipped him, saying, My daughter is even now dead: but come and lay thy hand upon her, and she shall live.
text.ASV: While he spake these things unto them, behold, there came a ruler, and worshipped him, saying, My daughter is even now dead: but come and lay thy hand upon her, and she shall live.
text.WEB: While he told these things to them, behold, a ruler came and worshiped him, saying, “My daughter has just died, but come and lay your hand on her, and she will live.”

text.KJV: And Jesus arose, and followed him, and so did his disciples.
text.ASV: And Jesus arose, and followed him, and `so did' his disciples.
text.WEB: Jesus got up and followed him, as did his disciples.

text.KJV: And, behold, a woman, which was diseased with an issue of blood twelve years, came behind him, and touched the hem of his garment:
text.ASV: And behold, a woman, who had an issue of blood twelve years, came behind him, and touched the border of his garment:
text.WEB: Behold, a woman who had an issue of blood for twelve years came behind him, and touched the fringe of his garment;

text.KJV: For she said within herself, If I may but touch his garment, I shall be whole.
text.ASV: for she said within herself, If I do but touch his garment, I shall be made whole.
text.WEB: for she said within herself, “If I just touch his garment, I will be made well.”

text.KJV: But Jesus turned him about, and when he saw her, he said, Daughter, be of good comfort; thy faith hath made thee whole. And the woman was made whole from that hour.
text.ASV: But Jesus turning and seeing her said, Daughter, be of good cheer; thy faith hath made thee whole. And the woman was made whole from that hour.
text.WEB: But Jesus, turning around and seeing her, said, “Daughter, cheer up! Your faith has made you well.” And the woman was made well from that hour.

text.KJV: And when Jesus came into the ruler's house, and saw the minstrels and the people making a noise,
text.ASV: And when Jesus came into the ruler's house, and saw the flute-players, and the crowd making a tumult,
text.WEB: When Jesus came into the ruler’s house, and saw the flute players, and the crowd in noisy disorder,

text.KJV: He said unto them, Give place: for the maid is not dead, but sleepeth. And they laughed him to scorn.
text.ASV: he said, Give place: for the damsel is not dead, but sleepeth. And they laughed him to scorn.
text.WEB: he said to them, “Make room, because the girl isn’t dead, but sleeping.” They were ridiculing him.

text.KJV: But when the people were put forth, he went in, and took her by the hand, and the maid arose.
text.ASV: But when the crowd was put forth, he entered in, and took her by the hand; and the damsel arose.
text.WEB: But when the crowd was put out, he entered in, took her by the hand, and the girl arose.

text.KJV: And the fame hereof went abroad into all that land.
text.ASV: And the fame hereof went forth into all that land.
text.WEB: The report of this went out into all that land.

text.KJV: And when Jesus departed thence, two blind men followed him, crying, and saying, Thou son of David, have mercy on us.
text.ASV: And as Jesus passed by from thence, two blind men followed him, crying out, and saying, Have mercy on us, thou son of David.
text.WEB: As Jesus passed by from there, two blind men followed him, calling out and saying, “Have mercy on us, son of David!”

text.KJV: And when he was come into the house, the blind men came to him: and Jesus saith unto them, Believe ye that I am able to do this? They said unto him, Yea, Lord.
text.ASV: And when he was come into the house, the blind men came to him: and Jesus saith unto them, Believe ye that I am able to do this? They say unto him, Yea, Lord.
text.WEB: When he had come into the house, the blind men came to him. Jesus said to them, “Do you believe that I am able to do this?” They told him, “Yes, Lord.”

text.KJV: Then touched he their eyes, saying, According to your faith be it unto you.
text.ASV: Then touched he their eyes, saying, According to your faith be it done unto you.
text.WEB: Then he touched their eyes, saying, “According to your faith be it done to you.”

text.KJV: And their eyes were opened; and Jesus straitly charged them, saying, See that no man know it.
text.ASV: And their eyes were opened. And Jesus strictly charged them, saying, See that no man know it.
text.WEB: Their eyes were opened. Jesus strictly commanded them, saying, “See that no one knows about this.”

text.KJV: But they, when they were departed, spread abroad his fame in all that country.
text.ASV: But they went forth, and spread abroad his fame in all that land.
text.WEB: But they went out and spread abroad his fame in all that land.

text.KJV: As they went out, behold, they brought to him a dumb man possessed with a devil.
text.ASV: And as they went forth, behold, there was brought to him a dumb man possessed with a demon.
text.WEB: As they went out, behold, a mute man who was demon possessed was brought to him.

text.KJV: And when the devil was cast out, the dumb spake: and the multitudes marvelled, saying, It was never so seen in Israel.
text.ASV: And when the demon was cast out, the dumb man spake: and the multitudes marvelled, saying, It was never so seen in Israel.
text.WEB: When the demon was cast out, the mute man spoke. The multitudes marveled, saying, “Nothing like this has ever been seen in Israel!”

text.KJV: But the Pharisees said, He casteth out devils through the prince of the devils.
text.ASV: But the Pharisees said, By the prince of the demons casteth he out demons.
text.WEB: But the Pharisees said, “By the prince of the demons, he casts out demons.”

text.KJV: And Jesus went about all the cities and villages, teaching in their synagogues, and preaching the gospel of the kingdom, and healing every sickness and every disease among the people.
text.ASV: And Jesus went about all the cities and the villages, teaching in their synagogues, and preaching the gospel of the kingdom, and healing all manner of disease and all manner of sickness.
text.WEB: Jesus went about all the cities and the villages, teaching in their synagogues, and preaching the Good News of the Kingdom, and healing every disease and every sickness among the people.

text.KJV: But when he saw the multitudes, he was moved with compassion on them, because they fainted, and were scattered abroad, as sheep having no shepherd.
text.ASV: But when he saw the multitudes, he was moved with compassion for them, because they were distressed and scattered, as sheep not having a shepherd.
text.WEB: But when he saw the multitudes, he was moved with compassion for them, because they were harassed and scattered, like sheep without a shepherd.

text.KJV: Then saith he unto his disciples, The harvest truly is plenteous, but the labourers are few;
text.ASV: Then saith he unto his disciples, The harvest indeed is plenteous, but the laborers are few.
text.WEB: Then he said to his disciples, “The harvest indeed is plentiful, but the laborers are few.

text.KJV: Pray ye therefore the Lord of the harvest, that he will send forth labourers into his harvest.
text.ASV: Pray ye therefore the Lord of the harvest, that he send forth laborers into his harvest.
text.WEB: Pray therefore that the Lord of the harvest will send out laborers into his harvest.”

text.KJV: And when he had called unto him his twelve disciples, he gave them power against unclean spirits, to cast them out, and to heal all manner of sickness and all manner of disease.
text.ASV: And he called unto him his twelve disciples, and gave them authority over unclean spirits, to cast them out, and to heal all manner of disease and all manner of sickness.
text.WEB: He called to himself his twelve disciples, and gave them authority over unclean spirits, to cast them out, and to heal every disease and every sickness.

text.KJV: Now the names of the twelve apostles are these; The first, Simon, who is called Peter, and Andrew his brother; James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother;
text.ASV: Now the names of the twelve apostles are these: The first, Simon, who is called Peter, and Andrew his brother; James the `son' of Zebedee, and John his brother;
text.WEB: Now the names of the twelve apostles are these. The first, Simon, who is called Peter; Andrew, his brother; James the son of Zebedee; John, his brother;

text.KJV: Philip, and Bartholomew; Thomas, and Matthew the publican; James the son of Alphaeus, and Lebbaeus, whose surname was Thaddaeus;
text.ASV: Philip, and Bartholomew; Thomas, and Matthew the publican; James the `son' of Alphaeus, and Thaddaeus;
text.WEB: Philip; Bartholomew; Thomas; Matthew the tax collector; James the son of Alphaeus; Lebbaeus, who was also called Thaddaeus;

text.KJV: Simon the Canaanite, and Judas Iscariot, who also betrayed him.
text.ASV: Simon the Cananaean, and Judas Iscariot, who also betrayed him.
text.WEB: Simon the Canaanite; and Judas Iscariot, who also betrayed him.

text.KJV: These twelve Jesus sent forth, and commanded them, saying, Go not into the way of the Gentiles, and into any city of the Samaritans enter ye not:
text.ASV: These twelve Jesus sent forth, and charged them, saying, Go not into `any' way of the Gentiles, and enter not into any city of the Samaritans:
text.WEB: Jesus sent these twelve out, and commanded them, saying, “Don’t go among the Gentiles, and don’t enter into any city of the Samaritans.

text.KJV: But go rather to the lost sheep of the house of Israel.
text.ASV: but go rather to the lost sheep of the house of Israel.
text.WEB: Rather, go to the lost sheep of the house of Israel.

text.KJV: And as ye go, preach, saying, The kingdom of heaven is at hand.
text.ASV: And as ye go, preach, saying, The kingdom of heaven is at hand.
text.WEB: As you go, preach, saying, ‘The Kingdom of Heaven is at hand!’

text.KJV: Heal the sick, cleanse the lepers, raise the dead, cast out devils: freely ye have received, freely give.
text.ASV: Heal the sick, raise the dead, cleanse the lepers, cast out demons: freely ye received, freely give.
text.WEB: Heal the sick, cleanse the lepers, and cast out demons. Freely you received, so freely give.

text.KJV: Provide neither gold, nor silver, nor brass in your purses,
text.ASV: Get you no gold, nor silver, nor brass in your purses;
text.WEB: Don’t take any gold, silver, or brass in your money belts.

text.KJV: Nor scrip for your journey, neither two coats, neither shoes, nor yet staves: for the workman is worthy of his meat.
text.ASV: no wallet for `your' journey, neither two coats, nor shoes, nor staff: for the laborer is worthy of his food.
text.WEB: Take no bag for your journey, neither two coats, nor shoes, nor staff: for the laborer is worthy of his food.

text.KJV: And into whatsoever city or town ye shall enter, enquire who in it is worthy; and there abide till ye go thence.
text.ASV: And into whatsoever city or village ye shall enter, search out who in it is worthy; and there abide till ye go forth.
text.WEB: Into whatever city or village you enter, find out who in it is worthy; and stay there until you go on.

text.KJV: And when ye come into an house, salute it.
text.ASV: And as ye enter into the house, salute it.
text.WEB: As you enter into the household, greet it.

text.KJV: And if the house be worthy, let your peace come upon it: but if it be not worthy, let your peace return to you.
text.ASV: And if the house be worthy, let your peace come upon it: but if it be not worthy, let your peace return to you.
text.WEB: If the household is worthy, let your peace come on it, but if it isn’t worthy, let your peace return to you.

text.KJV: And whosoever shall not receive you, nor hear your words, when ye depart out of that house or city, shake off the dust of your feet.
text.ASV: And whosoever shall not receive you, nor hear your words, as ye go forth out of that house or that city, shake off the dust of your feet.
text.WEB: Whoever doesn’t receive you, nor hear your words, as you go out of that house or that city, shake the dust off your feet.

text.KJV: Verily I say unto you, It shall be more tolerable for the land of Sodom and Gomorrha in the day of judgment, than for that city.
text.ASV: Verily I say unto you, It shall be more tolerable for the land of Sodom and Gomorrah in the day of judgment, than for that city.
text.WEB: Most certainly I tell you, it will be more tolerable for the land of Sodom and Gomorrah in the day of judgment than for that city.

text.KJV: Behold, I send you forth as sheep in the midst of wolves: be ye therefore wise as serpents, and harmless as doves.
text.ASV: Behold, I send you forth as sheep in the midst of wolves: be ye therefore wise as serpents, and harmless as doves.
text.WEB: “Behold, I send you out as sheep among wolves. Therefore be wise as serpents, and harmless as doves.

text.KJV: But beware of men: for they will deliver you up to the councils, and they will scourge you in their synagogues;
text.ASV: But beware of men: for they will deliver you up to councils, and in theirs synagogues they will scourge you;
text.WEB: But beware of men: for they will deliver you up to councils, and in their synagogues they will scourge you.

text.KJV: And ye shall be brought before governors and kings for my sake, for a testimony against them and the Gentiles.
text.ASV: yea and before governors and kings shall ye be brought for my sake, for a testimony to them and to the Gentiles.
text.WEB: Yes, and you will be brought before governors and kings for my sake, for a testimony to them and to the nations.

text.KJV: But when they deliver you up, take no thought how or what ye shall speak: for it shall be given you in that same hour what ye shall speak.
text.ASV: But when they deliver you up, be not anxious how or what ye shall speak: for it shall be given you in that hour what ye shall speak.
text.WEB: But when they deliver you up, don’t be anxious how or what you will say, for it will be given you in that hour what you will say.

text.KJV: For it is not ye that speak, but the Spirit of your Father which speaketh in you.
text.ASV: For it is not ye that speak, but the Spirit of your Father that speaketh in you.
text.WEB: For it is not you who speak, but the Spirit of your Father who speaks in you.

text.KJV: And the brother shall deliver up the brother to death, and the father the child: and the children shall rise up against their parents, and cause them to be put to death.
text.ASV: And brother shall deliver up brother to death, and the father his child: and children shall rise up against parents, and cause them to be put to death.
text.WEB: “Brother will deliver up brother to death, and the father his child. Children will rise up against parents, and cause them to be put to death.

text.KJV: And ye shall be hated of all men for my name's sake: but he that endureth to the end shall be saved.
text.ASV: And ye shall be hated of all men for my name's sake: but he that endureth to the end, the same shall be saved.
text.WEB: You will be hated by all men for my name’s sake, but he who endures to the end will be saved.

text.KJV: But when they persecute you in this city, flee ye into another: for verily I say unto you, Ye shall not have gone over the cities of Israel, till the Son of man be come.
text.ASV: But when they persecute you in this city, flee into the next: for verily I say unto you, Ye shall not have gone through the cities of Israel, till the Son of man be come.
text.WEB: But when they persecute you in this city, flee into the next, for most certainly I tell you, you will not have gone through the cities of Israel, until the Son of Man has come.

text.KJV: The disciple is not above his master, nor the servant above his lord.
text.ASV: A disciple is not above his teacher, nor a servant above his lord.
text.WEB: “A disciple is not above his teacher, nor a servant above his lord.

text.KJV: It is enough for the disciple that he be as his master, and the servant as his lord. If they have called the master of the house Beelzebub, how much more shall they call them of his household?
text.ASV: It is enough for the disciple that he be as his teacher, and the servant as his lord. If they have called the master of the house Beelzebub, how much more them of his household!
text.WEB: It is enough for the disciple that he be like his teacher, and the servant like his lord. If they have called the master of the house Beelzebul, how much more those of his household!

text.KJV: Fear them not therefore: for there is nothing covered, that shall not be revealed; and hid, that shall not be known.
text.ASV: Fear them not therefore: for there is nothing covered, that shall not be revealed; and hid, that shall not be known.
text.WEB: Therefore don’t be afraid of them, for there is nothing covered that will not be revealed; and hidden that will not be known.

text.KJV: What I tell you in darkness, that speak ye in light: and what ye hear in the ear, that preach ye upon the housetops.
text.ASV: What I tell you in the darkness, speak ye in the light; and what ye hear in the ear, proclaim upon the house-tops.
text.WEB: What I tell you in the darkness, speak in the light; and what you hear whispered in the ear, proclaim on the housetops.

text.KJV: And fear not them which kill the body, but are not able to kill the soul: but rather fear him which is able to destroy both soul and body in hell.
text.ASV: And be not afraid of them that kill the body, but are not able to kill the soul: but rather fear him who is able to destroy both soul and body in hell.
text.WEB: Don’t be afraid of those who kill the body, but are not able to kill the soul. Rather, fear him who is able to destroy both soul and body in Gehenna.

text.KJV: Are not two sparrows sold for a farthing? and one of them shall not fall on the ground without your Father.
text.ASV: Are not two sparrows sold for a penny? and not one of them shall fall on the ground without your Father:
text.WEB: “Aren’t two sparrows sold for an assarion coin? Not one of them falls on the ground apart from your Father’s will,

text.KJV: But the very hairs of your head are all numbered.
text.ASV: but the very hairs of your head are all numbered.
text.WEB: but the very hairs of your head are all numbered.

text.KJV: Fear ye not therefore, ye are of more value than many sparrows.
text.ASV: Fear not therefore: ye are of more value than many sparrows.
text.WEB: Therefore don’t be afraid. You are of more value than many sparrows.

text.KJV: Whosoever therefore shall confess me before men, him will I confess also before my Father which is in heaven.
text.ASV: Every one therefore who shall confess me before men, him will I also confess before my Father who is in heaven.
text.WEB: Everyone therefore who confesses me before men, him I will also confess before my Father who is in heaven.

text.KJV: But whosoever shall deny me before men, him will I also deny before my Father which is in heaven.
text.ASV: But whosoever shall deny me before men, him will I also deny before my Father who is in heaven.
text.WEB: But whoever denies me before men, him I will also deny before my Father who is in heaven.

text.KJV: Think not that I am come to send peace on earth: I came not to send peace, but a sword.
text.ASV: Think not that I came to send peace on the earth: I came not to send peace, but a sword.
text.WEB: “Don’t think that I came to send peace on the earth. I didn’t come to send peace, but a sword.

text.KJV: For I am come to set a man at variance against his father, and the daughter against her mother, and the daughter in law against her mother in law.
text.ASV: For I came to set a man at variance against his father, and the daughter against her mother, and the daughter in law against her mother in law:
text.WEB: For I came to set a man at odds against his father, and a daughter against her mother, and a daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law.

text.KJV: And a man's foes shall be they of his own household.
text.ASV: and a man's foes `shall be' they of his own household.
text.WEB: A man’s foes will be those of his own household.

text.KJV: He that loveth father or mother more than me is not worthy of me: and he that loveth son or daughter more than me is not worthy of me.
text.ASV: He that loveth father or mother more than me is not worthy of me; and he that loveth son or daughter more than me is not worthy of me.
text.WEB: He who loves father or mother more than me is not worthy of me; and he who loves son or daughter more than me isn’t worthy of me.

text.KJV: And he that taketh not his cross, and followeth after me, is not worthy of me.
text.ASV: And he that doth not take his cross and follow after me, is not worthy of me.
text.WEB: He who doesn’t take his cross and follow after me, isn’t worthy of me.

text.KJV: He that findeth his life shall lose it: and he that loseth his life for my sake shall find it.
text.ASV: He that findeth his life shall lose it; and he that loseth his life for my sake shall find it.
text.WEB: He who seeks his life will lose it; and he who loses his life for my sake will find it.

text.KJV: He that receiveth you receiveth me, and he that receiveth me receiveth him that sent me.
text.ASV: He that receiveth you receiveth me, and he that receiveth me receiveth him that sent me.
text.WEB: He who receives you receives me, and he who receives me receives him who sent me.

text.KJV: He that receiveth a prophet in the name of a prophet shall receive a prophet's reward; and he that receiveth a righteous man in the name of a righteous man shall receive a righteous man's reward.
text.ASV: He that receiveth a prophet in the name of a prophet shall receive a prophet's reward: and he that receiveth a righteous man in the name of a righteous man shall receive a righteous man's reward.
text.WEB: He who receives a prophet in the name of a prophet will receive a prophet’s reward. He who receives a righteous man in the name of a righteous man will receive a righteous man’s reward.

text.KJV: And whosoever shall give to drink unto one of these little ones a cup of cold water only in the name of a disciple, verily I say unto you, he shall in no wise lose his reward.
text.ASV: And whosoever shall give to drink unto one of these little ones a cup of cold water only, in the name of a disciple, verily I say unto you he shall in no wise lose his reward.
text.WEB: Whoever gives one of these little ones just a cup of cold water to drink in the name of a disciple, most certainly I tell you he will in no way lose his reward.”

text.KJV: And it came to pass, when Jesus had made an end of commanding his twelve disciples, he departed thence to teach and to preach in their cities.
text.ASV: And it came to pass when Jesus had finished commanding his twelve disciples, he departed thence to teach and preach in their cities.
text.WEB: When Jesus had finished directing his twelve disciples, he departed from there to teach and preach in their cities.

text.KJV: Now when John had heard in the prison the works of Christ, he sent two of his disciples,
text.ASV: Now when John heard in the prison the works of the Christ, he sent by his disciples
text.WEB: Now when John heard in the prison the works of Christ, he sent two of his disciples

text.KJV: And said unto him, Art thou he that should come, or do we look for another?
text.ASV: and said unto him, Art thou he that cometh, or look we for another?
text.WEB: and said to him, “Are you he who comes, or should we look for another?”

text.KJV: Jesus answered and said unto them, Go and shew John again those things which ye do hear and see:
text.ASV: And Jesus answered and said unto them, Go and tell John the things which ye hear and see:
text.WEB: Jesus answered them, “Go and tell John the things which you hear and see:

text.KJV: The blind receive their sight, and the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, and the deaf hear, the dead are raised up, and the poor have the gospel preached to them.
text.ASV: the blind receive their sight, and the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, and the deaf hear, and the dead are raised up, and the poor have good tidings preached to them.
text.WEB: the blind receive their sight, the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, the deaf hear, the dead are raised up, and the poor have good news preached to them.

text.KJV: And blessed is he, whosoever shall not be offended in me.
text.ASV: And blessed is he, whosoever shall find no occasion of stumbling in me.
text.WEB: Blessed is he who finds no occasion for stumbling in me.”

text.KJV: And as they departed, Jesus began to say unto the multitudes concerning John, What went ye out into the wilderness to see? A reed shaken with the wind?
text.ASV: And as these went their way, Jesus began to say unto the multitudes concerning John, What went ye out into the wilderness to behold? a reed shaken with the wind?
text.WEB: As these went their way, Jesus began to say to the multitudes concerning John, “What did you go out into the wilderness to see? A reed shaken by the wind?

text.KJV: But what went ye out for to see? A man clothed in soft raiment? behold, they that wear soft clothing are in kings' houses.
text.ASV: But what went ye out to see? a man clothed in soft `raiment'? Behold, they that wear soft `raiment' are in king's houses.
text.WEB: But what did you go out to see? A man in soft clothing? Behold, those who wear soft clothing are in kings’ houses.

text.KJV: But what went ye out for to see? A prophet? yea, I say unto you, and more than a prophet.
text.ASV: But wherefore went ye out? to see a prophet? Yea, I say unto you, and much more than a prophet.
text.WEB: But why did you go out? To see a prophet? Yes, I tell you, and much more than a prophet.

text.KJV: For this is he, of whom it is written, Behold, I send my messenger before thy face, which shall prepare thy way before thee.
text.ASV: This is he, of whom it is written, Behold, I send my messenger before thy face, Who shall prepare thy way before thee.
text.WEB: For this is he, of whom it is written, ‘Behold, I send my messenger before your face, who will prepare your way before you.’

text.KJV: Verily I say unto you, Among them that are born of women there hath not risen a greater than John the Baptist: notwithstanding he that is least in the kingdom of heaven is greater than he.
text.ASV: Verily I say unto you, Among them that are born of women there hath not arisen a greater than John the Baptist: yet he that is but little in the kingdom of heaven is greater than he.
text.WEB: Most certainly I tell you, among those who are born of women there has not arisen anyone greater than John the Baptizer; yet he who is least in the Kingdom of Heaven is greater than he.

text.KJV: And from the days of John the Baptist until now the kingdom of heaven suffereth violence, and the violent take it by force.
text.ASV: And from the days of John the Baptist until now the kingdom of heaven suffereth violence, and men of violence take it by force.
text.WEB: From the days of John the Baptizer until now, the Kingdom of Heaven suffers violence, and the violent take it by force.

text.KJV: For all the prophets and the law prophesied until John.
text.ASV: For all the prophets and the law prophesied until John.
text.WEB: For all the prophets and the law prophesied until John.

text.KJV: And if ye will receive it, this is Elias, which was for to come.
text.ASV: And if ye are willing to receive `it,' this is Elijah, that is to come.
text.WEB: If you are willing to receive it, this is Elijah, who is to come.

text.KJV: He that hath ears to hear, let him hear.
text.ASV: He that hath ears to hear, let him hear.
text.WEB: He who has ears to hear, let him hear.

text.KJV: But whereunto shall I liken this generation? It is like unto children sitting in the markets, and calling unto their fellows,
text.ASV: But whereunto shall I liken this generation? It is like unto children sitting in the marketplaces, who call unto their fellows
text.WEB: “But to what shall I compare this generation? It is like children sitting in the marketplaces, who call to their companions

text.KJV: And saying, We have piped unto you, and ye have not danced; we have mourned unto you, and ye have not lamented.
text.ASV: and say, We piped unto you, and ye did not dance; we wailed, and ye did not mourn.
text.WEB: and say, ‘We played the flute for you, and you didn’t dance. We mourned for you, and you didn’t lament.’

text.KJV: For John came neither eating nor drinking, and they say, He hath a devil.
text.ASV: For John came neither eating nor drinking, and they say, He hath a demon.
text.WEB: For John came neither eating nor drinking, and they say, ‘He has a demon.’

text.KJV: The Son of man came eating and drinking, and they say, Behold a man gluttonous, and a winebibber, a friend of publicans and sinners. But wisdom is justified of her children.
text.ASV: The Son of man came eating and drinking, and they say, Behold, a gluttonous man and a winebibber, a friend of publicans and sinners! And wisdom is justified by her works.
text.WEB: The Son of Man came eating and drinking, and they say, ‘Behold, a gluttonous man and a drunkard, a friend of tax collectors and sinners!’ But wisdom is justified by her children.”

text.KJV: Then began he to upbraid the cities wherein most of his mighty works were done, because they repented not:
text.ASV: Then began he to upbraid the cities wherein most of his mighty works were done, because they repented not.
text.WEB: Then he began to denounce the cities in which most of his mighty works had been done, because they didn’t repent.

text.KJV: Woe unto thee, Chorazin! woe unto thee, Bethsaida! for if the mighty works, which were done in you, had been done in Tyre and Sidon, they would have repented long ago in sackcloth and ashes.
text.ASV: Woe unto thee, Chorazin! woe unto thee, Bethsaida! for if the mighty works had been done in Tyre and Sidon which were done in you, they would have repented long ago in sackcloth and ashes.
text.WEB: “Woe to you, Chorazin! Woe to you, Bethsaida! For if the mighty works had been done in Tyre and Sidon which were done in you, they would have repented long ago in sackcloth and ashes.

text.KJV: But I say unto you, It shall be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon at the day of judgment, than for you.
text.ASV: But I say unto you, it shall be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon in the day of judgment than for you.
text.WEB: But I tell you, it will be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon on the day of judgment than for you.

text.KJV: And thou, Capernaum, which art exalted unto heaven, shalt be brought down to hell: for if the mighty works, which have been done in thee, had been done in Sodom, it would have remained until this day.
text.ASV: And thou, Capernaum, shalt thou be exalted unto heaven? thou shalt go down unto Hades: for if the mighty works had been done in Sodom which were done in thee, it would have remained until this day.
text.WEB: You, Capernaum, who are exalted to heaven, you will go down to Hades. For if the mighty works had been done in Sodom which were done in you, it would have remained until today.

text.KJV: But I say unto you, That it shall be more tolerable for the land of Sodom in the day of judgment, than for thee.
text.ASV: But I say unto you that it shall be more tolerable for the land of Sodom in the day of judgment, than for thee.
text.WEB: But I tell you that it will be more tolerable for the land of Sodom, on the day of judgment, than for you.”

text.KJV: At that time Jesus answered and said, I thank thee, O Father, Lord of heaven and earth, because thou hast hid these things from the wise and prudent, and hast revealed them unto babes.
text.ASV: At that season Jesus answered and said, I thank thee, O Father, Lord of heaven and earth, that thou didst hide these things from the wise and understanding, and didst reveal them unto babes:
text.WEB: At that time, Jesus answered, “I thank you, Father, Lord of heaven and earth, that you hid these things from the wise and understanding, and revealed them to infants.

text.KJV: Even so, Father: for so it seemed good in thy sight.
text.ASV: yea, Father, for so it was well-pleasing in thy sight.
text.WEB: Yes, Father, for so it was well-pleasing in your sight.

text.KJV: All things are delivered unto me of my Father: and no man knoweth the Son, but the Father; neither knoweth any man the Father, save the Son, and he to whomsoever the Son will reveal him.
text.ASV: All things have been delivered unto me of my Father: and no one knoweth the Son, save the Father; neither doth any know the Father, save the Son, and he to whomsoever the Son willeth to reveal `him.'
text.WEB: All things have been delivered to me by my Father. No one knows the Son, except the Father; neither does anyone know the Father, except the Son, and he to whom the Son desires to reveal him.

text.KJV: Come unto me, all ye that labour and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest.
text.ASV: Come unto me, all ye that labor and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest.
text.WEB: “Come to me, all you who labor and are heavily burdened, and I will give you rest.

text.KJV: Take my yoke upon you, and learn of me; for I am meek and lowly in heart: and ye shall find rest unto your souls.
text.ASV: Take my yoke upon you, and learn of me; for I am meek and lowly in heart: and ye shall find rest unto your souls.
text.WEB: Take my yoke upon you, and learn from me, for I am gentle and humble in heart; and you will find rest for your souls.

text.KJV: For my yoke is easy, and my burden is light.
text.ASV: For my yoke is easy, and my burden is light.
text.WEB: For my yoke is easy, and my burden is light.”

text.KJV: At that time Jesus went on the sabbath day through the corn; and his disciples were an hungred, and began to pluck the ears of corn and to eat.
text.ASV: At that season Jesus went on the sabbath day through the grainfields; and his disciples were hungry and began to pluck ears and to eat.
text.WEB: At that time, Jesus went on the Sabbath day through the grain fields. His disciples were hungry and began to pluck heads of grain and to eat.

text.KJV: But when the Pharisees saw it, they said unto him, Behold, thy disciples do that which is not lawful to do upon the sabbath day.
text.ASV: But the Pharisees, when they saw it, said unto him, Behold, thy disciples do that which it is not lawful to do upon the sabbath.
text.WEB: But the Pharisees, when they saw it, said to him, “Behold, your disciples do what is not lawful to do on the Sabbath.”

text.KJV: But he said unto them, Have ye not read what David did, when he was an hungred, and they that were with him;
text.ASV: But he said unto them, Have ye not read what David did, when he was hungry, and they that were with him;
text.WEB: But he said to them, “Haven’t you read what David did, when he was hungry, and those who were with him;

text.KJV: How he entered into the house of God, and did eat the shewbread, which was not lawful for him to eat, neither for them which were with him, but only for the priests?
text.ASV: how he entered into the house of God, and ate the showbread, which it was not lawful for him to eat, neither for them that were with him, but only for the priests?
text.WEB: how he entered into God’s house, and ate the show bread, which was not lawful for him to eat, neither for those who were with him, but only for the priests?

text.KJV: Or have ye not read in the law, how that on the sabbath days the priests in the temple profane the sabbath, and are blameless?
text.ASV: Or have ye not read in the law, that on the sabbath day the priests in the temple profane the sabbath, and are guiltless?
text.WEB: Or have you not read in the law, that on the Sabbath day, the priests in the temple profane the Sabbath, and are guiltless?

text.KJV: But I say unto you, That in this place is one greater than the temple.
text.ASV: But I say unto you, that one greater than the temple is here.
text.WEB: But I tell you that one greater than the temple is here.

text.KJV: But if ye had known what this meaneth, I will have mercy, and not sacrifice, ye would not have condemned the guiltless.
text.ASV: But if ye had known what this meaneth, I desire mercy, and not sacrifice, ye would not have condemned the guiltless.
text.WEB: But if you had known what this means, ‘I desire mercy, and not sacrifice,’ you wouldn’t have condemned the guiltless.

text.KJV: For the Son of man is Lord even of the sabbath day.
text.ASV: For the Son of man is lord of the sabbath.
text.WEB: For the Son of Man is Lord of the Sabbath.”

text.KJV: And when he was departed thence, he went into their synagogue:
text.ASV: And he departed thence, and went into their synagogue:
text.WEB: He departed there, and went into their synagogue.

text.KJV: And, behold, there was a man which had his hand withered. And they asked him, saying, Is it lawful to heal on the sabbath days? that they might accuse him.
text.ASV: and behold, a man having a withered hand. And they asked him, saying, Is it lawful to heal on the sabbath day? that they might accuse him.
text.WEB: And behold there was a man with a withered hand. They asked him, “Is it lawful to heal on the Sabbath day?” that they might accuse him.

text.KJV: And he said unto them, What man shall there be among you, that shall have one sheep, and if it fall into a pit on the sabbath day, will he not lay hold on it, and lift it out?
text.ASV: And he said unto them, What man shall there be of you, that shall have one sheep, and if this fall into a pit on the sabbath day, will he not lay hold on it, and lift it out?
text.WEB: He said to them, “What man is there among you, who has one sheep, and if this one falls into a pit on the Sabbath day, won’t he grab on to it, and lift it out?

text.KJV: How much then is a man better than a sheep? Wherefore it is lawful to do well on the sabbath days.
text.ASV: How much then is a man of more value than a sheep! Wherefore it is lawful to do good on the sabbath day.
text.WEB: Of how much more value then is a man than a sheep! Therefore it is lawful to do good on the Sabbath day.”

text.KJV: Then saith he to the man, Stretch forth thine hand. And he stretched it forth; and it was restored whole, like as the other.
text.ASV: Then saith he to the man, Stretch forth thy hand. And he stretched it forth; and it was restored whole, as the other.
text.WEB: Then he told the man, “Stretch out your hand.” He stretched it out; and it was restored whole, just like the other.

text.KJV: Then the Pharisees went out, and held a council against him, how they might destroy him.
text.ASV: But the Pharisees went out, and took counsel against him, how they might destroy him.
text.WEB: But the Pharisees went out, and conspired against him, how they might destroy him.

text.KJV: But when Jesus knew it, he withdrew himself from thence: and great multitudes followed him, and he healed them all;
text.ASV: And Jesus perceiving `it' withdrew from thence: and many followed him; and he healed them all,
text.WEB: Jesus, perceiving that, withdrew from there. Great multitudes followed him; and he healed them all,

text.KJV: And charged them that they should not make him known:
text.ASV: and charged them that they should not make him known:
text.WEB: and commanded them that they should not make him known:

text.KJV: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by Esaias the prophet, saying,
text.ASV: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through Isaiah the prophet, saying,
text.WEB: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through Isaiah the prophet, saying,

text.KJV: Behold my servant, whom I have chosen; my beloved, in whom my soul is well pleased: I will put my spirit upon him, and he shall shew judgment to the Gentiles.
text.ASV: Behold, my servant whom I have chosen; My beloved in whom my soul is well pleased: I will put my Spirit upon him, And he shall declare judgment to the Gentiles.
text.WEB: “Behold, my servant whom I have chosen; my beloved in whom my soul is well pleased: I will put my Spirit on him. He will proclaim justice to the nations.

text.KJV: He shall not strive, nor cry; neither shall any man hear his voice in the streets.
text.ASV: He shall not strive, nor cry aloud; Neither shall any one hear his voice in the streets.
text.WEB: He will not strive, nor shout; neither will anyone hear his voice in the streets.

text.KJV: A bruised reed shall he not break, and smoking flax shall he not quench, till he send forth judgment unto victory.
text.ASV: A bruised reed shall he not break, And smoking flax shall he not quench, Till he send forth judgment unto victory.
text.WEB: He won’t break a bruised reed. He won’t quench a smoking flax, until he leads justice to victory.

text.KJV: And in his name shall the Gentiles trust.
text.ASV: And in his name shall the Gentiles hope.
text.WEB: In his name, the nations will hope.”

text.KJV: Then was brought unto him one possessed with a devil, blind, and dumb: and he healed him, insomuch that the blind and dumb both spake and saw.
text.ASV: Then was brought unto him one possessed with a demon, blind and dumb: and he healed him, insomuch that the dumb man spake and saw.
text.WEB: Then one possessed by a demon, blind and mute, was brought to him and he healed him, so that the blind and mute man both spoke and saw.

text.KJV: And all the people were amazed, and said, Is not this the son of David?
text.ASV: And all the multitudes were amazed, and said, Can this be the son of David?
text.WEB: All the multitudes were amazed, and said, “Can this be the son of David?”

text.KJV: But when the Pharisees heard it, they said, This fellow doth not cast out devils, but by Beelzebub the prince of the devils.
text.ASV: But when the Pharisees heard it, they said, This man doth not cast out demons, but by Beelzebub the prince of the demons.
text.WEB: But when the Pharisees heard it, they said, “This man does not cast out demons, except by Beelzebul, the prince of the demons.”

text.KJV: And Jesus knew their thoughts, and said unto them, Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation; and every city or house divided against itself shall not stand:
text.ASV: And knowing their thoughts he said unto them, Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation; and every city or house divided against itself shall not stand:
text.WEB: Knowing their thoughts, Jesus said to them, “Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation, and every city or house divided against itself will not stand.

text.KJV: And if Satan cast out Satan, he is divided against himself; how shall then his kingdom stand?
text.ASV: and if Satan casteth out Satan, he is divided against himself; how then shall his kingdom stand?
text.WEB: If Satan casts out Satan, he is divided against himself. How then will his kingdom stand?

text.KJV: And if I by Beelzebub cast out devils, by whom do your children cast them out? therefore they shall be your judges.
text.ASV: And if I by Beelzebub cast out demons, by whom do your sons cast them out? therefore shall they be your judges.
text.WEB: If I by Beelzebul cast out demons, by whom do your children cast them out? Therefore they will be your judges.

text.KJV: But if I cast out devils by the Spirit of God, then the kingdom of God is come unto you.
text.ASV: But if I by the Spirit of God cast out demons, then is the kingdom of God come upon you.
text.WEB: But if I by the Spirit of God cast out demons, then God’s Kingdom has come upon you.

text.KJV: Or else how can one enter into a strong man's house, and spoil his goods, except he first bind the strong man? and then he will spoil his house.
text.ASV: Or how can one enter into the house of the strong `man,' and spoil his goods, except he first bind the strong `man'? and then he will spoil his house.
text.WEB: Or how can one enter into the house of the strong man, and plunder his goods, unless he first bind the strong man? Then he will plunder his house.

text.KJV: He that is not with me is against me; and he that gathereth not with me scattereth abroad.
text.ASV: He that is not with me is against me, and he that gathereth not with me scattereth.
text.WEB: “He who is not with me is against me, and he who doesn’t gather with me, scatters.

text.KJV: Wherefore I say unto you, All manner of sin and blasphemy shall be forgiven unto men: but the blasphemy against the Holy Ghost shall not be forgiven unto men.
text.ASV: Therefore I say unto you, Every sin and blasphemy shall be forgiven unto men; but the blasphemy against the Spirit shall not be forgiven.
text.WEB: Therefore I tell you, every sin and blasphemy will be forgiven men, but the blasphemy against the Spirit will not be forgiven men.

text.KJV: And whosoever speaketh a word against the Son of man, it shall be forgiven him: but whosoever speaketh against the Holy Ghost, it shall not be forgiven him, neither in this world, neither in the world to come.
text.ASV: And whosoever shall speak a word against the Son of man, it shall be forgiven him; but whosoever shall speak against the Holy Spirit, it shall not be forgiven him, neither in this world, nor in that which is to come.
text.WEB: Whoever speaks a word against the Son of Man, it will be forgiven him; but whoever speaks against the Holy Spirit, it will not be forgiven him, neither in this age, nor in that which is to come.

text.KJV: Either make the tree good, and his fruit good; or else make the tree corrupt, and his fruit corrupt: for the tree is known by his fruit.
text.ASV: Either make the tree good, and its fruit good; or make the tree corrupt, and its fruit corrupt: for the tree is known by its fruit.
text.WEB: “Either make the tree good, and its fruit good, or make the tree corrupt, and its fruit corrupt; for the tree is known by its fruit.

text.KJV: O generation of vipers, how can ye, being evil, speak good things? for out of the abundance of the heart the mouth speaketh.
text.ASV: Ye offspring of vipers, how can ye, being evil, speak good things? for out of the abundance of the heart the mouth speaketh.
text.WEB: You offspring of vipers, how can you, being evil, speak good things? For out of the abundance of the heart, the mouth speaks.

text.KJV: A good man out of the good treasure of the heart bringeth forth good things: and an evil man out of the evil treasure bringeth forth evil things.
text.ASV: The good man out of his good treasure bringeth forth good things: and the evil man out of his evil treasure bringeth forth evil things.
text.WEB: The good man out of his good treasure brings out good things, and the evil man out of his evil treasure brings out evil things.

text.KJV: But I say unto you, That every idle word that men shall speak, they shall give account thereof in the day of judgment.
text.ASV: And I say unto you, that every idle word that men shall speak, they shall give account thereof in the day of judgment.
text.WEB: I tell you that every idle word that men speak, they will give account of it in the day of judgment.

text.KJV: For by thy words thou shalt be justified, and by thy words thou shalt be condemned.
text.ASV: For by thy words thou shalt be justified, and by thy words thou shalt be condemned.
text.WEB: For by your words you will be justified, and by your words you will be condemned.”

text.KJV: Then certain of the scribes and of the Pharisees answered, saying, Master, we would see a sign from thee.
text.ASV: Then certain of the scribes and Pharisees answered him, saying, Teacher, we would see a sign from thee.
text.WEB: Then certain of the scribes and Pharisees answered, “Teacher, we want to see a sign from you.”

text.KJV: But he answered and said unto them, An evil and adulterous generation seeketh after a sign; and there shall no sign be given to it, but the sign of the prophet Jonas:
text.ASV: But he answered and said unto them, An evil and adulterous generation seeketh after a sign; and there shall no sign be given it but the sign of Jonah the prophet:
text.WEB: But he answered them, “An evil and adulterous generation seeks after a sign, but no sign will be given to it but the sign of Jonah the prophet.

text.KJV: For as Jonas was three days and three nights in the whale's belly; so shall the Son of man be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth.
text.ASV: for as Jonah was three days and three nights in the belly of the whale; so shall the Son of man be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth.
text.WEB: For as Jonah was three days and three nights in the belly of the whale, so will the Son of Man be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth.

text.KJV: The men of Nineveh shall rise in judgment with this generation, and shall condemn it: because they repented at the preaching of Jonas; and, behold, a greater than Jonas is here.
text.ASV: The men of Nineveh shall stand up in the judgment with this generation, and shall condemn it: for they repented at the preaching of Jonah; and behold, a greater than Jonah is here.
text.WEB: The men of Nineveh will stand up in the judgment with this generation, and will condemn it, for they repented at the preaching of Jonah; and behold, someone greater than Jonah is here.

text.KJV: The queen of the south shall rise up in the judgment with this generation, and shall condemn it: for she came from the uttermost parts of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and, behold, a greater than Solomon is here.
text.ASV: The queen of the south shall rise up in the judgment with this generation, and shall condemn it: for she came from the ends of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and behold, a greater than Solomon is here.
text.WEB: The queen of the south will rise up in the judgment with this generation, and will condemn it, for she came from the ends of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and behold, someone greater than Solomon is here.

text.KJV: When the unclean spirit is gone out of a man, he walketh through dry places, seeking rest, and findeth none.
text.ASV: But the unclean spirit, when he is gone out of the man, passeth through waterless places, seeking rest, and findeth it not.
text.WEB: When an unclean spirit has gone out of a man, he passes through waterless places, seeking rest, and doesn’t find it.

text.KJV: Then he saith, I will return into my house from whence I came out; and when he is come, he findeth it empty, swept, and garnished.
text.ASV: Then he saith, I will return into my house whence I came out; and when he is come, he findeth it empty, swept, and garnished.
text.WEB: Then he says, ‘I will return into my house from which I came out,’ and when he has come back, he finds it empty, swept, and put in order.

text.KJV: Then goeth he, and taketh with himself seven other spirits more wicked than himself, and they enter in and dwell there: and the last state of that man is worse than the first. Even so shall it be also unto this wicked generation.
text.ASV: Then goeth he, and taketh with himself seven other spirits more evil than himself, and they enter in and dwell there: and the last state of that man becometh worse than the first. Even so shall it be also unto this evil generation.
text.WEB: Then he goes, and takes with himself seven other spirits more evil than he is, and they enter in and dwell there. The last state of that man becomes worse than the first. Even so will it be also to this evil generation.”

text.KJV: While he yet talked to the people, behold, his mother and his brethren stood without, desiring to speak with him.
text.ASV: While he was yet speaking to the multitudes, behold, his mother and his brethren stood without, seeking to speak to him.
text.WEB: While he was yet speaking to the multitudes, behold, his mother and his brothers stood outside, seeking to speak to him.

text.KJV: Then one said unto him, Behold, thy mother and thy brethren stand without, desiring to speak with thee.
text.ASV: And one said unto him, Behold, thy mother and thy brethren stand without, seeking to speak to thee.
text.WEB: One said to him, “Behold, your mother and your brothers stand outside, seeking to speak to you.”

text.KJV: But he answered and said unto him that told him, Who is my mother? and who are my brethren?
text.ASV: But he answered and said unto him that told him, Who is my mother? and who are my brethren?
text.WEB: But he answered him who spoke to him, “Who is my mother? Who are my brothers?”

text.KJV: And he stretched forth his hand toward his disciples, and said, Behold my mother and my brethren!
text.ASV: And he stretched forth his hand towards his disciples, and said, Behold, my mother and my brethren!
text.WEB: He stretched out his hand towards his disciples, and said, “Behold, my mother and my brothers!

text.KJV: For whosoever shall do the will of my Father which is in heaven, the same is my brother, and sister, and mother.
text.ASV: For whosoever shall do the will of my Father who is in heaven, he is my brother, and sister, and mother.
text.WEB: For whoever does the will of my Father who is in heaven, he is my brother, and sister, and mother.”

text.KJV: The same day went Jesus out of the house, and sat by the sea side.
text.ASV: On that day went Jesus out of the house, and sat by the sea side.
text.WEB: On that day Jesus went out of the house, and sat by the seaside.

text.KJV: And great multitudes were gathered together unto him, so that he went into a ship, and sat; and the whole multitude stood on the shore.
text.ASV: And there were gathered unto him great multitudes, so that he entered into a boat, and sat; and all the multitude stood on the beach.
text.WEB: Great multitudes gathered to him, so that he entered into a boat, and sat, and all the multitude stood on the beach.

text.KJV: And he spake many things unto them in parables, saying, Behold, a sower went forth to sow;
text.ASV: And he spake to them many things in parables, saying, Behold, the sower went forth to sow;
text.WEB: He spoke to them many things in parables, saying, “Behold, a farmer went out to sow.

text.KJV: And when he sowed, some seeds fell by the way side, and the fowls came and devoured them up:
text.ASV: and as he sowed, some `seeds' fell by the way side, and the birds came and devoured them:
text.WEB: As he sowed, some seeds fell by the roadside, and the birds came and devoured them.

text.KJV: Some fell upon stony places, where they had not much earth: and forthwith they sprung up, because they had no deepness of earth:
text.ASV: and others fell upon the rocky places, where they had not much earth: and straightway they sprang up, because they had no deepness of earth:
text.WEB: Others fell on rocky ground, where they didn’t have much soil, and immediately they sprang up, because they had no depth of earth.

text.KJV: And when the sun was up, they were scorched; and because they had no root, they withered away.
text.ASV: and when the sun was risen, they were scorched; and because they had no root, they withered away.
text.WEB: When the sun had risen, they were scorched. Because they had no root, they withered away.

text.KJV: And some fell among thorns; and the thorns sprung up, and choked them:
text.ASV: And others fell upon the thorns; and the thorns grew up and choked them:
text.WEB: Others fell among thorns. The thorns grew up and choked them.

text.KJV: But other fell into good ground, and brought forth fruit, some an hundredfold, some sixtyfold, some thirtyfold.
text.ASV: and others fell upon the good ground, and yielded fruit, some a hundredfold, some sixty, some thirty.
text.WEB: Others fell on good soil, and yielded fruit: some one hundred times as much, some sixty, and some thirty.

text.KJV: Who hath ears to hear, let him hear.
text.ASV: He that hath ears, let him hear.
text.WEB: He who has ears to hear, let him hear.”

text.KJV: And the disciples came, and said unto him, Why speakest thou unto them in parables?
text.ASV: And the disciples came, and said unto him, Why speakest thou unto them in parables?
text.WEB: The disciples came, and said to him, “Why do you speak to them in parables?”

text.KJV: He answered and said unto them, Because it is given unto you to know the mysteries of the kingdom of heaven, but to them it is not given.
text.ASV: And he answered and said unto them, Unto you it is given to know the mysteries of the kingdom of heaven, but to them it is not given.
text.WEB: He answered them, “To you it is given to know the mysteries of the Kingdom of Heaven, but it is not given to them.

text.KJV: For whosoever hath, to him shall be given, and he shall have more abundance: but whosoever hath not, from him shall be taken away even that he hath.
text.ASV: For whosoever hath, to him shall be given, and he shall have abundance: but whosoever hath not, from him shall be taken away even that which he hath.
text.WEB: For whoever has, to him will be given, and he will have abundance, but whoever doesn’t have, from him will be taken away even that which he has.

text.KJV: Therefore speak I to them in parables: because they seeing see not; and hearing they hear not, neither do they understand.
text.ASV: Therefore speak I to them in parables; because seeing they see not, and hearing they hear not, neither do they understand.
text.WEB: Therefore I speak to them in parables, because seeing they don’t see, and hearing, they don’t hear, neither do they understand.

text.KJV: And in them is fulfilled the prophecy of Esaias, which saith, By hearing ye shall hear, and shall not understand; and seeing ye shall see, and shall not perceive:
text.ASV: And unto them is fulfilled the prophecy of Isaiah, which saith, By hearing ye shall hear, and shall in no wise understand; And seeing ye shall see, and shall in no wise perceive:
text.WEB: In them the prophecy of Isaiah is fulfilled, which says, ‘By hearing you will hear, and will in no way understand; Seeing you will see, and will in no way perceive:

text.KJV: For this people's heart is waxed gross, and their ears are dull of hearing, and their eyes they have closed; lest at any time they should see with their eyes and hear with their ears, and should understand with their heart, and should be converted, and I should heal them.
text.ASV: For this people's heart is waxed gross, And their ears are dull of hearing, And their eyes they have closed; Lest haply they should perceive with their eyes, And hear with their ears, And understand with their heart, And should turn again, And I should heal them.
text.WEB: for this people’s heart has grown callous, their ears are dull of hearing, they have closed their eyes; or else perhaps they might perceive with their eyes, hear with their ears, understand with their heart, and would turn again; and I would heal them.’

text.KJV: But blessed are your eyes, for they see: and your ears, for they hear.
text.ASV: But blessed are your eyes, for they see; and your ears, for they hear.
text.WEB: “But blessed are your eyes, for they see; and your ears, for they hear.

text.KJV: For verily I say unto you, That many prophets and righteous men have desired to see those things which ye see, and have not seen them; and to hear those things which ye hear, and have not heard them.
text.ASV: For verily I say unto you, that many prophets and righteous men desired to see the things which ye see, and saw them not; and to hear the things which ye hear, and heard them not.
text.WEB: For most certainly I tell you that many prophets and righteous men desired to see the things which you see, and didn’t see them; and to hear the things which you hear, and didn’t hear them.

text.KJV: Hear ye therefore the parable of the sower.
text.ASV: Hear then ye the parable of the sower.
text.WEB: “Hear, then, the parable of the farmer.

text.KJV: When any one heareth the word of the kingdom, and understandeth it not, then cometh the wicked one, and catcheth away that which was sown in his heart. This is he which received seed by the way side.
text.ASV: When any one heareth the word of the kingdom, and understandeth it not, `then' cometh the evil `one', and snatcheth away that which hath been sown in his heart. This is he that was sown by the way side.
text.WEB: When anyone hears the word of the Kingdom, and doesn’t understand it, the evil one comes, and snatches away that which has been sown in his heart. This is what was sown by the roadside.

text.KJV: But he that received the seed into stony places, the same is he that heareth the word, and anon with joy receiveth it;
text.ASV: And he that was sown upon the rocky places, this is he that heareth the word, and straightway with joy receiveth it;
text.WEB: What was sown on the rocky places, this is he who hears the word, and immediately with joy receives it;

text.KJV: Yet hath he not root in himself, but dureth for a while: for when tribulation or persecution ariseth because of the word, by and by he is offended.
text.ASV: yet hath he not root in himself, but endureth for a while; and when tribulation or persecution ariseth because of the word, straightway he stumbleth.
text.WEB: yet he has no root in himself, but endures for a while. When oppression or persecution arises because of the word, immediately he stumbles.

text.KJV: He also that received seed among the thorns is he that heareth the word; and the care of this world, and the deceitfulness of riches, choke the word, and he becometh unfruitful.
text.ASV: And he that was sown among the thorns, this is he that heareth the word; and the care of the world, and the deceitfulness of riches, choke the word, and he becometh unfruitful.
text.WEB: What was sown among the thorns, this is he who hears the word, but the cares of this age and the deceitfulness of riches choke the word, and he becomes unfruitful.

text.KJV: But he that received seed into the good ground is he that heareth the word, and understandeth it; which also beareth fruit, and bringeth forth, some an hundredfold, some sixty, some thirty.
text.ASV: And he that was sown upon the good ground, this is he that heareth the word, and understandeth it; who verily beareth fruit, and bringeth forth, some a hundredfold, some sixty, some thirty.
text.WEB: What was sown on the good ground, this is he who hears the word, and understands it, who most certainly bears fruit, and produces, some one hundred times as much, some sixty, and some thirty.”
