text.KJV: Another parable put he forth unto them, saying, The kingdom of heaven is likened unto a man which sowed good seed in his field:
text.ASV: Another parable set he before them, saying, The kingdom of heaven is likened unto a man that sowed good seed in his field:
text.WEB: He set another parable before them, saying, “The Kingdom of Heaven is like a man who sowed good seed in his field,

text.KJV: But while men slept, his enemy came and sowed tares among the wheat, and went his way.
text.ASV: but while men slept, his enemy came and sowed tares also among the wheat, and went away.
text.WEB: but while people slept, his enemy came and sowed darnel weeds also among the wheat, and went away.

text.KJV: But when the blade was sprung up, and brought forth fruit, then appeared the tares also.
text.ASV: But when the blade sprang up and brought forth fruit, then appeared the tares also.
text.WEB: But when the blade sprang up and produced fruit, then the darnel weeds appeared also.

text.KJV: So the servants of the householder came and said unto him, Sir, didst not thou sow good seed in thy field? from whence then hath it tares?
text.ASV: And the servants of the householder came and said unto him, Sir, didst thou not sow good seed in thy field? whence then hath it tares?
text.WEB: The servants of the householder came and said to him, ‘Sir, didn’t you sow good seed in your field? Where did these darnel weeds come from?’

text.KJV: He said unto them, An enemy hath done this. The servants said unto him, Wilt thou then that we go and gather them up?
text.ASV: And he said unto them, An enemy hath done this. And the servants say unto him, Wilt thou then that we go and gather them up?
text.WEB: “He said to them, ‘An enemy has done this.’ “The servants asked him, ‘Do you want us to go and gather them up?’

text.KJV: But he said, Nay; lest while ye gather up the tares, ye root up also the wheat with them.
text.ASV: But he saith, Nay; lest haply while ye gather up the tares, ye root up the wheat with them.
text.WEB: “But he said, ‘No, lest perhaps while you gather up the darnel weeds, you root up the wheat with them.

text.KJV: Let both grow together until the harvest: and in the time of harvest I will say to the reapers, Gather ye together first the tares, and bind them in bundles to burn them: but gather the wheat into my barn.
text.ASV: Let both grow together until the harvest: and in the time of the harvest I will say to the reapers, Gather up first the tares, and bind them in bundles to burn them; but gather the wheat into my barn.
text.WEB: Let both grow together until the harvest, and in the harvest time I will tell the reapers, “First, gather up the darnel weeds, and bind them in bundles to burn them; but gather the wheat into my barn.”’”

text.KJV: Another parable put he forth unto them, saying, The kingdom of heaven is like to a grain of mustard seed, which a man took, and sowed in his field:
text.ASV: Another parable set he before them, saying, The kingdom of heaven is like unto a grain of mustard seed, which a man took, and sowed in his field:
text.WEB: He set another parable before them, saying, “The Kingdom of Heaven is like a grain of mustard seed, which a man took, and sowed in his field;

text.KJV: Which indeed is the least of all seeds: but when it is grown, it is the greatest among herbs, and becometh a tree, so that the birds of the air come and lodge in the branches thereof.
text.ASV: which indeed is less than all seeds; but when it is grown, it is greater than the herbs, and becometh a tree, so that the birds of the heaven come and lodge in the branches thereof.
text.WEB: which indeed is smaller than all seeds. But when it is grown, it is greater than the herbs, and becomes a tree, so that the birds of the air come and lodge in its branches.”

text.KJV: Another parable spake he unto them; The kingdom of heaven is like unto leaven, which a woman took, and hid in three measures of meal, till the whole was leavened.
text.ASV: Another parable spake he unto them; The kingdom of heaven is like unto leaven, which a woman took, and hid in three measures of meal, till it was all leavened.
text.WEB: He spoke another parable to them. “The Kingdom of Heaven is like yeast, which a woman took, and hid in three measures of meal, until it was all leavened.”

text.KJV: All these things spake Jesus unto the multitude in parables; and without a parable spake he not unto them:
text.ASV: All these things spake Jesus in parables unto the multitudes; and without a parable spake he nothing unto them:
text.WEB: Jesus spoke all these things in parables to the multitudes; and without a parable, he didn’t speak to them,

text.KJV: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophet, saying, I will open my mouth in parables; I will utter things which have been kept secret from the foundation of the world.
text.ASV: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through the prophet, saying, I will open my mouth in parables; I will utter things hidden from the foundation of the world.
text.WEB: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through the prophet, saying, “I will open my mouth in parables; I will utter things hidden from the foundation of the world.”

text.KJV: Then Jesus sent the multitude away, and went into the house: and his disciples came unto him, saying, Declare unto us the parable of the tares of the field.
text.ASV: Then he left the multitudes, and went into the house: and his disciples came unto him, saying, Explain unto us the parable of the tares of the field.
text.WEB: Then Jesus sent the multitudes away, and went into the house. His disciples came to him, saying, “Explain to us the parable of the darnel weeds of the field.”

text.KJV: He answered and said unto them, He that soweth the good seed is the Son of man;
text.ASV: And he answered and said, He that soweth the good seed is the Son of man;
text.WEB: He answered them, “He who sows the good seed is the Son of Man,

text.KJV: The field is the world; the good seed are the children of the kingdom; but the tares are the children of the wicked one;
text.ASV: and the field is the world; and the good seed, these are the sons of the kingdom; and the tares are the sons of the evil `one';
text.WEB: the field is the world; and the good seed, these are the children of the Kingdom; and the darnel weeds are the children of the evil one.

text.KJV: The enemy that sowed them is the devil; the harvest is the end of the world; and the reapers are the angels.
text.ASV: and the enemy that sowed them is the devil: and the harvest is the end of the world; and the reapers are angels.
text.WEB: The enemy who sowed them is the devil. The harvest is the end of the age, and the reapers are angels.

text.KJV: As therefore the tares are gathered and burned in the fire; so shall it be in the end of this world.
text.ASV: As therefore the tares are gathered up and burned with fire; so shall it be in the end of the world.
text.WEB: As therefore the darnel weeds are gathered up and burned with fire; so will it be at the end of this age.

text.KJV: The Son of man shall send forth his angels, and they shall gather out of his kingdom all things that offend, and them which do iniquity;
text.ASV: The Son of man shall send forth his angels, and they shall gather out of his kingdom all things that cause stumbling, and them that do iniquity,
text.WEB: The Son of Man will send out his angels, and they will gather out of his Kingdom all things that cause stumbling, and those who do iniquity,

text.KJV: And shall cast them into a furnace of fire: there shall be wailing and gnashing of teeth.
text.ASV: and shall cast them into the furnace of fire: there shall be the weeping and the gnashing of teeth.
text.WEB: and will cast them into the furnace of fire. There will be weeping and the gnashing of teeth.

text.KJV: Then shall the righteous shine forth as the sun in the kingdom of their Father. Who hath ears to hear, let him hear.
text.ASV: Then shall the righteous shine forth as the sun in the kingdom of their Father. He that hath ears, let him hear.
text.WEB: Then the righteous will shine like the sun in the Kingdom of their Father. He who has ears to hear, let him hear.

text.KJV: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto treasure hid in a field; the which when a man hath found, he hideth, and for joy thereof goeth and selleth all that he hath, and buyeth that field.
text.ASV: The kingdom of heaven is like unto a treasure hidden in the field; which a man found, and hid; and in his joy he goeth and selleth all that he hath, and buyeth that field.
text.WEB: “Again, the Kingdom of Heaven is like treasure hidden in the field, which a man found, and hid. In his joy, he goes and sells all that he has, and buys that field.

text.KJV: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto a merchant man, seeking goodly pearls:
text.ASV: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto a man that is a merchant seeking goodly pearls:
text.WEB: “Again, the Kingdom of Heaven is like a man who is a merchant seeking fine pearls,

text.KJV: Who, when he had found one pearl of great price, went and sold all that he had, and bought it.
text.ASV: and having found one pearl of great price, he went and sold all that he had, and bought it.
text.WEB: who having found one pearl of great price, he went and sold all that he had, and bought it.

text.KJV: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto a net, that was cast into the sea, and gathered of every kind:
text.ASV: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto a net, that was cast into the sea, and gathered of every kind:
text.WEB: “Again, the Kingdom of Heaven is like a dragnet, that was cast into the sea, and gathered some fish of every kind,

text.KJV: Which, when it was full, they drew to shore, and sat down, and gathered the good into vessels, but cast the bad away.
text.ASV: which, when it was filled, they drew up on the beach; and they sat down, and gathered the good into vessels, but the bad they cast away.
text.WEB: which, when it was filled, they drew up on the beach. They sat down, and gathered the good into containers, but the bad they threw away.

text.KJV: So shall it be at the end of the world: the angels shall come forth, and sever the wicked from among the just,
text.ASV: So shall it be in the end of the world: the angels shall come forth, and sever the wicked from among the righteous,
text.WEB: So will it be in the end of the world. The angels will come and separate the wicked from among the righteous,

text.KJV: And shall cast them into the furnace of fire: there shall be wailing and gnashing of teeth.
text.ASV: and shall cast them into the furnace of fire: there shall be the weeping and the gnashing of teeth.
text.WEB: and will cast them into the furnace of fire. There will be the weeping and the gnashing of teeth.”

text.KJV: Jesus saith unto them, Have ye understood all these things? They say unto him, Yea, Lord.
text.ASV: Have ye understood all these things? They say unto him, Yea.
text.WEB: Jesus said to them, “Have you understood all these things?” They answered him, “Yes, Lord.”

text.KJV: Then said he unto them, Therefore every scribe which is instructed unto the kingdom of heaven is like unto a man that is an householder, which bringeth forth out of his treasure things new and old.
text.ASV: And he said unto them, Therefore every scribe who hath been made a disciple to the kingdom of heaven is like unto a man that is a householder, who bringeth forth out of his treasure things new and old.
text.WEB: He said to them, “Therefore every scribe who has been made a disciple in the Kingdom of Heaven is like a man who is a householder, who brings out of his treasure new and old things.”

text.KJV: And it came to pass, that when Jesus had finished these parables, he departed thence.
text.ASV: And it came to pass, when Jesus had finished these parables, he departed thence.
text.WEB: When Jesus had finished these parables, he departed from there.

text.KJV: And when he was come into his own country, he taught them in their synagogue, insomuch that they were astonished, and said, Whence hath this man this wisdom, and these mighty works?
text.ASV: And coming into his own country he taught them in their synagogue, insomuch that they were astonished, and said, Whence hath this man this wisdom, and these mighty works?
text.WEB: Coming into his own country, he taught them in their synagogue, so that they were astonished, and said, “Where did this man get this wisdom, and these mighty works?

text.KJV: Is not this the carpenter's son? is not his mother called Mary? and his brethren, James, and Joses, and Simon, and Judas?
text.ASV: Is not this the carpenter's son? is not his mother called Mary? and his brethren, James, and Joseph, and Simon, and Judas?
text.WEB: Isn’t this the carpenter’s son? Isn’t his mother called Mary, and his brothers, James, Joses, Simon, and Judas?

text.KJV: And his sisters, are they not all with us? Whence then hath this man all these things?
text.ASV: And his sisters, are they not all with us? Whence then hath this man all these things?
text.WEB: Aren’t all of his sisters with us? Where then did this man get all of these things?”

text.KJV: And they were offended in him. But Jesus said unto them, A prophet is not without honour, save in his own country, and in his own house.
text.ASV: And they were offended in him. But Jesus said unto them, A prophet is not without honor, save in his own country, and in his own house.
text.WEB: They were offended by him. But Jesus said to them, “A prophet is not without honor, except in his own country, and in his own house.”

text.KJV: And he did not many mighty works there because of their unbelief.
text.ASV: And he did not many mighty works there because of their unbelief.
text.WEB: He didn’t do many mighty works there because of their unbelief.

text.KJV: At that time Herod the tetrarch heard of the fame of Jesus,
text.ASV: At that season Herod the tetrarch heard the report concerning Jesus,
text.WEB: At that time, Herod the tetrarch heard the report concerning Jesus,

text.KJV: And said unto his servants, This is John the Baptist; he is risen from the dead; and therefore mighty works do shew forth themselves in him.
text.ASV: and said unto his servants, This is John the Baptist; he is risen from the dead; and therefore do these powers work in him.
text.WEB: and said to his servants, “This is John the Baptizer. He is risen from the dead. That is why these powers work in him.”

text.KJV: For Herod had laid hold on John, and bound him, and put him in prison for Herodias' sake, his brother Philip's wife.
text.ASV: For Herod had laid hold on John, and bound him, and put him in prison for the sake of Herodias, his brother Philip's wife.
text.WEB: For Herod had laid hold of John, and bound him, and put him in prison for the sake of Herodias, his brother Philip’s wife.

text.KJV: For John said unto him, It is not lawful for thee to have her.
text.ASV: For John said unto him, It is not lawful for thee to have her.
text.WEB: For John said to him, “It is not lawful for you to have her.”

text.KJV: And when he would have put him to death, he feared the multitude, because they counted him as a prophet.
text.ASV: And when he would have put him to death, he feared the multitude, because they counted him as a prophet.
text.WEB: When he would have put him to death, he feared the multitude, because they counted him as a prophet.

text.KJV: But when Herod's birthday was kept, the daughter of Herodias danced before them, and pleased Herod.
text.ASV: But when Herod's birthday came, the daughter of Herodias danced in the midst, and pleased Herod.
text.WEB: But when Herod’s birthday came, the daughter of Herodias danced among them and pleased Herod.

text.KJV: Whereupon he promised with an oath to give her whatsoever she would ask.
text.ASV: Whereupon he promised with an oath to give her whatsoever she should ask.
text.WEB: Whereupon he promised with an oath to give her whatever she should ask.

text.KJV: And she, being before instructed of her mother, said, Give me here John Baptist's head in a charger.
text.ASV: And she, being put forward by her mother, saith, Give me here on a platter the head of John the Baptist.
text.WEB: She, being prompted by her mother, said, “Give me here on a platter the head of John the Baptizer.”

text.KJV: And the king was sorry: nevertheless for the oath's sake, and them which sat with him at meat, he commanded it to be given her.
text.ASV: And the king was grieved; but for the sake of his oaths, and of them that sat at meat with him, he commanded it to be given;
text.WEB: The king was grieved, but for the sake of his oaths, and of those who sat at the table with him, he commanded it to be given,

text.KJV: And he sent, and beheaded John in the prison.
text.ASV: and he sent and beheaded John in the prison.
text.WEB: and he sent and beheaded John in the prison.

text.KJV: And his head was brought in a charger, and given to the damsel: and she brought it to her mother.
text.ASV: And his head was brought on a platter, and given to the damsel: and she brought it to her mother.
text.WEB: His head was brought on a platter, and given to the young lady: and she brought it to her mother.

text.KJV: And his disciples came, and took up the body, and buried it, and went and told Jesus.
text.ASV: And his disciples came, and took up the corpse, and buried him; and they went and told Jesus.
text.WEB: His disciples came, and took the body, and buried it; and they went and told Jesus.

text.KJV: When Jesus heard of it, he departed thence by ship into a desert place apart: and when the people had heard thereof, they followed him on foot out of the cities.
text.ASV: Now when Jesus heard `it', he withdrew from thence in a boat, to a desert place apart: and when the multitudes heard `thereof,' they followed him on foot from the cities.
text.WEB: Now when Jesus heard this, he withdrew from there in a boat, to a deserted place apart. When the multitudes heard it, they followed him on foot from the cities.

text.KJV: And Jesus went forth, and saw a great multitude, and was moved with compassion toward them, and he healed their sick.
text.ASV: And he came forth, and saw a great multitude, and he had compassion on them, and healed their sick.
text.WEB: Jesus went out, and he saw a great multitude. He had compassion on them, and healed their sick.

text.KJV: And when it was evening, his disciples came to him, saying, This is a desert place, and the time is now past; send the multitude away, that they may go into the villages, and buy themselves victuals.
text.ASV: And when even was come, the disciples came to him, saying, The place is desert, and the time is already past; send the multitudes away, that they may go into the villages, and buy themselves food.
text.WEB: When evening had come, his disciples came to him, saying, “This place is deserted, and the hour is already late. Send the multitudes away, that they may go into the villages, and buy themselves food.”

text.KJV: But Jesus said unto them, They need not depart; give ye them to eat.
text.ASV: But Jesus said unto them, They have no need to go away; give ye them to eat.
text.WEB: But Jesus said to them, “They don’t need to go away. You give them something to eat.”

text.KJV: And they say unto him, We have here but five loaves, and two fishes.
text.ASV: And they say unto him, We have here but five loaves, and two fishes.
text.WEB: They told him, “We only have here five loaves and two fish.”

text.KJV: He said, Bring them hither to me.
text.ASV: And he said, Bring them hither to me.
text.WEB: He said, “Bring them here to me.”

text.KJV: And he commanded the multitude to sit down on the grass, and took the five loaves, and the two fishes, and looking up to heaven, he blessed, and brake, and gave the loaves to his disciples, and the disciples to the multitude.
text.ASV: And he commanded the multitudes to sit down on the grass; and he took the five loaves, and the two fishes, and looking up to heaven, he blessed, and brake and gave the loaves to the disciples, and the disciples to the multitudes.
text.WEB: He commanded the multitudes to sit down on the grass; and he took the five loaves and the two fish, and looking up to heaven, he blessed, broke and gave the loaves to the disciples, and the disciples gave to the multitudes.

text.KJV: And they did all eat, and were filled: and they took up of the fragments that remained twelve baskets full.
text.ASV: And they all ate, and were filled: and they took up that which remained over of the broken pieces, twelve baskets full.
text.WEB: They all ate, and were filled. They took up twelve baskets full of that which remained left over from the broken pieces.

text.KJV: And they that had eaten were about five thousand men, beside women and children.
text.ASV: And they that did eat were about five thousand men, besides women and children.
text.WEB: Those who ate were about five thousand men, besides women and children.

text.KJV: And straightway Jesus constrained his disciples to get into a ship, and to go before him unto the other side, while he sent the multitudes away.
text.ASV: And straightway he constrained the disciples to enter into the boat, and to go before him unto the other side, till he should send the multitudes away.
text.WEB: Immediately Jesus made the disciples get into the boat, and to go ahead of him to the other side, while he sent the multitudes away.

text.KJV: And when he had sent the multitudes away, he went up into a mountain apart to pray: and when the evening was come, he was there alone.
text.ASV: And after he had sent the multitudes away, he went up into the mountain apart to pray: and when even was come, he was there alone.
text.WEB: After he had sent the multitudes away, he went up into the mountain by himself to pray. When evening had come, he was there alone.

text.KJV: But the ship was now in the midst of the sea, tossed with waves: for the wind was contrary.
text.ASV: But the boat was now in the midst of the sea, distressed by the waves; for the wind was contrary.
text.WEB: But the boat was now in the middle of the sea, distressed by the waves, for the wind was contrary.

text.KJV: And in the fourth watch of the night Jesus went unto them, walking on the sea.
text.ASV: And in the fourth watch of the night he came unto them, walking upon the sea.
text.WEB: In the fourth watch of the night, Jesus came to them, walking on the sea.

text.KJV: And when the disciples saw him walking on the sea, they were troubled, saying, It is a spirit; and they cried out for fear.
text.ASV: And when the disciples saw him walking on the sea, they were troubled, saying, It is a ghost; and they cried out for fear.
text.WEB: When the disciples saw him walking on the sea, they were troubled, saying, “It’s a ghost!” and they cried out for fear.

text.KJV: But straightway Jesus spake unto them, saying, Be of good cheer; it is I; be not afraid.
text.ASV: But straightway Jesus spake unto them, saying Be of good cheer; it is I; be not afraid.
text.WEB: But immediately Jesus spoke to them, saying, “Cheer up! It is I! Don’t be afraid.”

text.KJV: And Peter answered him and said, Lord, if it be thou, bid me come unto thee on the water.
text.ASV: And Peter answered him and said, Lord, if it be thou, bid me come unto the upon the waters.
text.WEB: Peter answered him and said, “Lord, if it is you, command me to come to you on the waters.”

text.KJV: And he said, Come. And when Peter was come down out of the ship, he walked on the water, to go to Jesus.
text.ASV: And he said, Come. And Peter went down from the boat, and walked upon the waters to come to Jesus.
text.WEB: He said, “Come!” Peter stepped down from the boat, and walked on the waters to come to Jesus.

text.KJV: But when he saw the wind boisterous, he was afraid; and beginning to sink, he cried, saying, Lord, save me.
text.ASV: But when he saw the wind, he was afraid; and beginning to sink, he cried out, saying, Lord, save me.
text.WEB: But when he saw that the wind was strong, he was afraid, and beginning to sink, he cried out, saying, “Lord, save me!”

text.KJV: And immediately Jesus stretched forth his hand, and caught him, and said unto him, O thou of little faith, wherefore didst thou doubt?
text.ASV: And immediately Jesus stretched forth his hand, and took hold of him, and saith unto him, O thou of little faith, wherefore didst thou doubt?
text.WEB: Immediately Jesus stretched out his hand, took hold of him, and said to him, “You of little faith, why did you doubt?”

text.KJV: And when they were come into the ship, the wind ceased.
text.ASV: And when they were gone up into the boat, the wind ceased.
text.WEB: When they got up into the boat, the wind ceased.

text.KJV: Then they that were in the ship came and worshipped him, saying, Of a truth thou art the Son of God.
text.ASV: And they that were in the boat worshipped him, saying, Of a truth thou art the Son of God.
text.WEB: Those who were in the boat came and worshiped him, saying, “You are truly the Son of God!”

text.KJV: And when they were gone over, they came into the land of Gennesaret.
text.ASV: And when they had crossed over, they came to the land, unto Gennesaret.
text.WEB: When they had crossed over, they came to the land of Gennesaret.

text.KJV: And when the men of that place had knowledge of him, they sent out into all that country round about, and brought unto him all that were diseased;
text.ASV: And when the men of that place knew him, they sent into all that region round about, and brought unto him all that were sick,
text.WEB: When the people of that place recognized him, they sent into all that surrounding region, and brought to him all who were sick;

text.KJV: And besought him that they might only touch the hem of his garment: and as many as touched were made perfectly whole.
text.ASV: and they besought him that they might only touch the border of his garment: and as many as touched were made whole.
text.WEB: and they begged him that they might just touch the fringe of his garment. As many as touched it were made whole.

text.KJV: Then came to Jesus scribes and Pharisees, which were of Jerusalem, saying,
text.ASV: Then there come to Jesus from Jerusalem Pharisees and scribes, saying,
text.WEB: Then Pharisees and scribes came to Jesus from Jerusalem, saying,

text.KJV: Why do thy disciples transgress the tradition of the elders? for they wash not their hands when they eat bread.
text.ASV: Why do thy disciples transgress the tradition of the elders? for they wash not their hands when they eat bread.
text.WEB: “Why do your disciples disobey the tradition of the elders? For they don’t wash their hands when they eat bread.”

text.KJV: But he answered and said unto them, Why do ye also transgress the commandment of God by your tradition?
text.ASV: And he answered and said unto them, Why do ye also transgress the commandment of God because of your tradition?
text.WEB: He answered them, “Why do you also disobey the commandment of God because of your tradition?

text.KJV: For God commanded, saying, Honour thy father and mother: and, He that curseth father or mother, let him die the death.
text.ASV: For God said, Honor thy father and thy mother: and, He that speaketh evil of father or mother, let him die the death.
text.WEB: For God commanded, ‘Honor your father and your mother,’; and, ‘He who speaks evil of father or mother, let him be put to death.’;

text.KJV: But ye say, Whosoever shall say to his father or his mother, It is a gift, by whatsoever thou mightest be profited by me;
text.ASV: But ye say, whosoever shall say to his father or his mother, That wherewith thou mightest have been profited by me is given `to God';
text.WEB: But you say, ‘Whoever may tell his father or his mother, “Whatever help you might otherwise have gotten from me is a gift devoted to God,”

text.KJV: And honour not his father or his mother, he shall be free. Thus have ye made the commandment of God of none effect by your tradition.
text.ASV: he shall not honor his father. And ye have made void the word of God because of your tradition.
text.WEB: he shall not honor his father or mother.’ You have made the commandment of God void because of your tradition.

text.KJV: Ye hypocrites, well did Esaias prophesy of you, saying,
text.ASV: Ye hypocrites, well did Isaiah prophesy of you, saying,
text.WEB: You hypocrites! Well did Isaiah prophesy of you, saying,

text.KJV: This people draweth nigh unto me with their mouth, and honoureth me with their lips; but their heart is far from me.
text.ASV: This people honoreth me with their lips; But their heart is far from me.
text.WEB: ‘These people draw near to me with their mouth, and honor me with their lips; but their heart is far from me.

text.KJV: But in vain they do worship me, teaching for doctrines the commandments of men.
text.ASV: But in vain do they worship me, Teaching `as their' doctrines the precepts of men.
text.WEB: And in vain do they worship me, teaching as doctrine rules made by men.’”

text.KJV: And he called the multitude, and said unto them, Hear, and understand:
text.ASV: And he called to him the multitude, and said unto them, Hear, and understand:
text.WEB: He summoned the multitude, and said to them, “Hear, and understand.

text.KJV: Not that which goeth into the mouth defileth a man; but that which cometh out of the mouth, this defileth a man.
text.ASV: Not that which entereth into the mouth defileth the man; but that which proceedeth out of the mouth, this defileth the man.
text.WEB: That which enters into the mouth doesn’t defile the man; but that which proceeds out of the mouth, this defiles the man.”

text.KJV: Then came his disciples, and said unto him, Knowest thou that the Pharisees were offended, after they heard this saying?
text.ASV: Then came the disciples, and said unto him, Knowest thou that the Pharisees were offended, when they heard this saying?
text.WEB: Then the disciples came, and said to him, “Do you know that the Pharisees were offended, when they heard this saying?”

text.KJV: But he answered and said, Every plant, which my heavenly Father hath not planted, shall be rooted up.
text.ASV: But he answered and said, Every plant which my heavenly Father planted not, shall be rooted up.
text.WEB: But he answered, “Every plant which my heavenly Father didn’t plant will be uprooted.

text.KJV: Let them alone: they be blind leaders of the blind. And if the blind lead the blind, both shall fall into the ditch.
text.ASV: Let them alone: they are blind guides. And if the blind guide the blind, both shall fall into a pit.
text.WEB: Leave them alone. They are blind guides of the blind. If the blind guide the blind, both will fall into a pit.”

text.KJV: Then answered Peter and said unto him, Declare unto us this parable.
text.ASV: And Peter answered and said unto him, Declare unto us the parable.
text.WEB: Peter answered him, “Explain the parable to us.”

text.KJV: And Jesus said, Are ye also yet without understanding?
text.ASV: And he said, Are ye also even yet without understanding?
text.WEB: So Jesus said, “Do you also still not understand?

text.KJV: Do not ye yet understand, that whatsoever entereth in at the mouth goeth into the belly, and is cast out into the draught?
text.ASV: Perceive ye not, that whatsoever goeth into the mouth passeth into the belly, and is cast out into the draught?
text.WEB: Don’t you understand that whatever goes into the mouth passes into the belly, and then out of the body?

text.KJV: But those things which proceed out of the mouth come forth from the heart; and they defile the man.
text.ASV: But the things which proceed out of the mouth come forth out of the heart; and they defile the man.
text.WEB: But the things which proceed out of the mouth come out of the heart, and they defile the man.

text.KJV: For out of the heart proceed evil thoughts, murders, adulteries, fornications, thefts, false witness, blasphemies:
text.ASV: For out of the heart come forth evil thoughts, murders, adulteries, fornications, thefts, false witness, railings:
text.WEB: For out of the heart come evil thoughts, murders, adulteries, sexual sins, thefts, false testimony, and blasphemies.

text.KJV: These are the things which defile a man: but to eat with unwashen hands defileth not a man.
text.ASV: these are the things which defile the man; but to eat with unwashen hands defileth not the man.
text.WEB: These are the things which defile the man; but to eat with unwashed hands doesn’t defile the man.”

text.KJV: Then Jesus went thence, and departed into the coasts of Tyre and Sidon.
text.ASV: And Jesus went out thence, and withdrew into the parts of Tyre and Sidon.
text.WEB: Jesus went out from there, and withdrew into the region of Tyre and Sidon.

text.KJV: And, behold, a woman of Canaan came out of the same coasts, and cried unto him, saying, Have mercy on me, O Lord, thou son of David; my daughter is grievously vexed with a devil.
text.ASV: And behold, a Canaanitish woman came out from those borders, and cried, saying, Have mercy on me, O Lord, thou son of David; my daughter is grievously vexed with a demon.
text.WEB: Behold, a Canaanite woman came out from those borders, and cried, saying, “Have mercy on me, Lord, you son of David! My daughter is severely possessed by a demon!”

text.KJV: But he answered her not a word. And his disciples came and besought him, saying, Send her away; for she crieth after us.
text.ASV: But he answered her not a word. And his disciples came and besought him, saying, Send her away; for she crieth after us.
text.WEB: But he answered her not a word. His disciples came and begged him, saying, “Send her away; for she cries after us.”

text.KJV: But he answered and said, I am not sent but unto the lost sheep of the house of Israel.
text.ASV: But he answered and said, I was not sent but unto the lost sheep of the house of Israel.
text.WEB: But he answered, “I wasn’t sent to anyone but the lost sheep of the house of Israel.”

text.KJV: Then came she and worshipped him, saying, Lord, help me.
text.ASV: But she came and worshipped him, saying, Lord, help me.
text.WEB: But she came and worshiped him, saying, “Lord, help me.”

text.KJV: But he answered and said, It is not meet to take the children's bread, and to cast it to dogs.
text.ASV: And he answered and said, It is not meet to take the children's bread and cast it to the dogs.
text.WEB: But he answered, “It is not appropriate to take the children’s bread and throw it to the dogs.”

text.KJV: And she said, Truth, Lord: yet the dogs eat of the crumbs which fall from their masters' table.
text.ASV: But she said, Yea, Lord: for even the dogs eat of the crumbs which fall from their masters' table.
text.WEB: But she said, “Yes, Lord, but even the dogs eat the crumbs which fall from their masters’ table.”

text.KJV: Then Jesus answered and said unto her, O woman, great is thy faith: be it unto thee even as thou wilt. And her daughter was made whole from that very hour.
text.ASV: Then Jesus answered and said unto her, O woman, great is thy faith: be it done unto thee even as thou wilt. And her daughter was healed from that hour.
text.WEB: Then Jesus answered her, “Woman, great is your faith! Be it done to you even as you desire.” And her daughter was healed from that hour.

text.KJV: And Jesus departed from thence, and came nigh unto the sea of Galilee; and went up into a mountain, and sat down there.
text.ASV: And Jesus departed thence, and came nigh unto the sea of Galilee; and he went up into the mountain, and sat there.
text.WEB: Jesus departed from there, and came near to the sea of Galilee; and he went up into the mountain, and sat there.

text.KJV: And great multitudes came unto him, having with them those that were lame, blind, dumb, maimed, and many others, and cast them down at Jesus' feet; and he healed them:
text.ASV: And there came unto him great multitudes, having with them the lame, blind, dumb, maimed, and many others, and they cast them down at this feet; and he healed them:
text.WEB: Great multitudes came to him, having with them the lame, blind, mute, maimed, and many others, and they put them down at his feet. He healed them,

text.KJV: Insomuch that the multitude wondered, when they saw the dumb to speak, the maimed to be whole, the lame to walk, and the blind to see: and they glorified the God of Israel.
text.ASV: insomuch that the multitude wondered, when they saw the dumb speaking, the maimed whole, and lame walking, and the blind seeing: and they glorified the God of Israel.
text.WEB: so that the multitude wondered when they saw the mute speaking, the injured healed, the lame walking, and the blind seeing—and they glorified the God of Israel.

text.KJV: Then Jesus called his disciples unto him, and said, I have compassion on the multitude, because they continue with me now three days, and have nothing to eat: and I will not send them away fasting, lest they faint in the way.
text.ASV: And Jesus called unto him his disciples, and said, I have compassion on the multitude, because they continue with me now three days and have nothing to eat: and I would not send them away fasting, lest haply they faint on the way.
text.WEB: Jesus summoned his disciples and said, “I have compassion on the multitude, because they continue with me now three days and have nothing to eat. I don’t want to send them away fasting, or they might faint on the way.”

text.KJV: And his disciples say unto him, Whence should we have so much bread in the wilderness, as to fill so great a multitude?
text.ASV: And the disciples say unto him, Whence should we have so many loaves in a desert place as to fill so great a multitude?
text.WEB: The disciples said to him, “Where should we get so many loaves in a deserted place as to satisfy so great a multitude?”

text.KJV: And Jesus saith unto them, How many loaves have ye? And they said, Seven, and a few little fishes.
text.ASV: And Jesus said unto them, How many loaves have ye? And they said, Seven, and a few small fishes.
text.WEB: Jesus said to them, “How many loaves do you have?” They said, “Seven, and a few small fish.”

text.KJV: And he commanded the multitude to sit down on the ground.
text.ASV: And he commanded the multitude to sit down on the ground;
text.WEB: He commanded the multitude to sit down on the ground;

text.KJV: And he took the seven loaves and the fishes, and gave thanks, and brake them, and gave to his disciples, and the disciples to the multitude.
text.ASV: and he took the seven loaves and the fishes; and he gave thanks and brake, and gave to the disciples, and the disciples to the multitudes.
text.WEB: and he took the seven loaves and the fish. He gave thanks and broke them, and gave to the disciples, and the disciples to the multitudes.

text.KJV: And they did all eat, and were filled: and they took up of the broken meat that was left seven baskets full.
text.ASV: And they all ate, and were filled: and they took up that which remained over of the broken pieces, seven baskets full.
text.WEB: They all ate, and were filled. They took up seven baskets full of the broken pieces that were left over.

text.KJV: And they that did eat were four thousand men, beside women and children.
text.ASV: And they that did eat were four thousand men, besides women and children.
text.WEB: Those who ate were four thousand men, besides women and children.

text.KJV: And he sent away the multitude, and took ship, and came into the coasts of Magdala.
text.ASV: And he sent away the multitudes, and entered into the boat, and came into the borders of Magadan.
text.WEB: Then he sent away the multitudes, got into the boat, and came into the borders of Magdala.

text.KJV: The Pharisees also with the Sadducees came, and tempting desired him that he would shew them a sign from heaven.
text.ASV: And the Pharisees and Sadducees came, and trying him asked him to show them a sign from heaven.
text.WEB: The Pharisees and Sadducees came, and testing him, asked him to show them a sign from heaven.

text.KJV: He answered and said unto them, When it is evening, ye say, It will be fair weather: for the sky is red.
text.ASV: But he answered and said unto them, When it is evening, ye say, `It will be' fair weather: for the heaven is red.
text.WEB: But he answered them, “When it is evening, you say, ‘It will be fair weather, for the sky is red.’

text.KJV: And in the morning, It will be foul weather to day: for the sky is red and lowering. O ye hypocrites, ye can discern the face of the sky; but can ye not discern the signs of the times?
text.ASV: And in the morning, `It will be' foul weather to-day: for the heaven is red and lowering. Ye know how to discern the face of the heaven; but ye cannot `discern' the signs of the times.
text.WEB: In the morning, ‘It will be foul weather today, for the sky is red and threatening.’ Hypocrites! You know how to discern the appearance of the sky, but you can’t discern the signs of the times!

text.KJV: A wicked and adulterous generation seeketh after a sign; and there shall no sign be given unto it, but the sign of the prophet Jonas. And he left them, and departed.
text.ASV: An evil and adulterous generation seeketh after a sign; and there shall no sign be given unto it, but the sign of Jonah. And he left them, and departed.
text.WEB: An evil and adulterous generation seeks after a sign, and there will be no sign given to it, except the sign of the prophet Jonah.” He left them, and departed.

text.KJV: And when his disciples were come to the other side, they had forgotten to take bread.
text.ASV: And the disciples came to the other side and forgot to take bread.
text.WEB: The disciples came to the other side and had forgotten to take bread.

text.KJV: Then Jesus said unto them, Take heed and beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and of the Sadducees.
text.ASV: And Jesus said unto them, Take heed and beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and Sadducees.
text.WEB: Jesus said to them, “Take heed and beware of the yeast of the Pharisees and Sadducees.”

text.KJV: And they reasoned among themselves, saying, It is because we have taken no bread.
text.ASV: And they reasoned among themselves, saying, We took no bread.
text.WEB: They reasoned among themselves, saying, “We brought no bread.”

text.KJV: Which when Jesus perceived, he said unto them, O ye of little faith, why reason ye among yourselves, because ye have brought no bread?
text.ASV: And Jesus perceiving it said, O ye of little faith, why reason ye among yourselves, because ye have no bread?
text.WEB: Jesus, perceiving it, said, “Why do you reason among yourselves, you of little faith, ‘because you have brought no bread?’

text.KJV: Do ye not yet understand, neither remember the five loaves of the five thousand, and how many baskets ye took up?
text.ASV: Do ye not yet perceive, neither remember the five loaves of the five thousand, and how many baskets ye took up?
text.WEB: Don’t you yet perceive, neither remember the five loaves for the five thousand, and how many baskets you took up?

text.KJV: Neither the seven loaves of the four thousand, and how many baskets ye took up?
text.ASV: Neither the seven loaves of the four thousand, and how many baskets ye took up?
text.WEB: Nor the seven loaves for the four thousand, and how many baskets you took up?

text.KJV: How is it that ye do not understand that I spake it not to you concerning bread, that ye should beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and of the Sadducees?
text.ASV: How is it that ye do not perceive that I spake not to you concerning bread? But beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and Sadducees.
text.WEB: How is it that you don’t perceive that I didn’t speak to you concerning bread? But beware of the yeast of the Pharisees and Sadducees.”

text.KJV: Then understood they how that he bade them not beware of the leaven of bread, but of the doctrine of the Pharisees and of the Sadducees.
text.ASV: Then understood they that he bade them not beware of the leaven of bread, but of the teaching of the Pharisees and Sadducees.
text.WEB: Then they understood that he didn’t tell them to beware of the yeast of bread, but of the teaching of the Pharisees and Sadducees.

text.KJV: When Jesus came into the coasts of Caesarea Philippi, he asked his disciples, saying, Whom do men say that I the Son of man am?
text.ASV: Now when Jesus came into the parts of Caesarea Philippi, he asked his disciples, saying, Who do men say that the Son of man is?
text.WEB: Now when Jesus came into the parts of Caesarea Philippi, he asked his disciples, saying, “Who do men say that I, the Son of Man, am?”

text.KJV: And they said, Some say that thou art John the Baptist: some, Elias; and others, Jeremias, or one of the prophets.
text.ASV: And they said, Some `say' John the Baptist; some, Elijah; and others, Jeremiah, or one of the prophets.
text.WEB: They said, “Some say John the Baptizer, some, Elijah, and others, Jeremiah, or one of the prophets.”

text.KJV: He saith unto them, But whom say ye that I am?
text.ASV: He saith unto them, But who say ye that I am?
text.WEB: He said to them, “But who do you say that I am?”

text.KJV: And Simon Peter answered and said, Thou art the Christ, the Son of the living God.
text.ASV: And Simon Peter answered and said, Thou art the Christ, the Son of the living God.
text.WEB: Simon Peter answered, “You are the Christ, the Son of the living God.”

text.KJV: And Jesus answered and said unto him, Blessed art thou, Simon Barjona: for flesh and blood hath not revealed it unto thee, but my Father which is in heaven.
text.ASV: And Jesus answered and said unto him, Blessed art thou, Simon Bar-jonah: for flesh and blood hath not revealed it unto thee, but my Father who is in heaven.
text.WEB: Jesus answered him, “Blessed are you, Simon Bar Jonah, for flesh and blood has not revealed this to you, but my Father who is in heaven.

text.KJV: And I say also unto thee, That thou art Peter, and upon this rock I will build my church; and the gates of hell shall not prevail against it.
text.ASV: And I also say unto thee, that thou art Peter, and upon this rock I will build my church; and the gates of Hades shall not prevail against it.
text.WEB: I also tell you that you are Peter, and on this rock I will build my assembly, and the gates of Hades will not prevail against it.

text.KJV: And I will give unto thee the keys of the kingdom of heaven: and whatsoever thou shalt bind on earth shall be bound in heaven: and whatsoever thou shalt loose on earth shall be loosed in heaven.
text.ASV: I will give unto thee the keys of the kingdom of heaven: and whatsoever thou shalt bind on earth shall be bound in heaven; and whatsoever thou shalt loose on earth shall be loosed in heaven.
text.WEB: I will give to you the keys of the Kingdom of Heaven, and whatever you bind on earth will have been bound in heaven; and whatever you release on earth will have been released in heaven.”

text.KJV: Then charged he his disciples that they should tell no man that he was Jesus the Christ.
text.ASV: Then charged he the disciples that they should tell no man that he was the Christ.
text.WEB: Then he commanded the disciples that they should tell no one that he was Jesus the Christ.

text.KJV: From that time forth began Jesus to shew unto his disciples, how that he must go unto Jerusalem, and suffer many things of the elders and chief priests and scribes, and be killed, and be raised again the third day.
text.ASV: From that time began Jesus to show unto his disciples, that he must go unto Jerusalem, and suffer many things of the elders and chief priests and scribes, and be killed, and the third day be raised up.
text.WEB: From that time, Jesus began to show his disciples that he must go to Jerusalem and suffer many things from the elders, chief priests, and scribes, and be killed, and the third day be raised up.

text.KJV: Then Peter took him, and began to rebuke him, saying, Be it far from thee, Lord: this shall not be unto thee.
text.ASV: And Peter took him, and began to rebuke him, saying, Be it far from thee, Lord: this shall never be unto thee.
text.WEB: Peter took him aside, and began to rebuke him, saying, “Far be it from you, Lord! This will never be done to you.”

text.KJV: But he turned, and said unto Peter, Get thee behind me, Satan: thou art an offence unto me: for thou savourest not the things that be of God, but those that be of men.
text.ASV: But he turned, and said unto Peter, Get thee behind me, Satan: thou art a stumbling-block unto me: for thou mindest not the things of God, but the things of men.
text.WEB: But he turned, and said to Peter, “Get behind me, Satan! You are a stumbling block to me, for you are not setting your mind on the things of God, but on the things of men.”

text.KJV: Then said Jesus unto his disciples, If any man will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.
text.ASV: Then said Jesus unto his disciples, If any man would come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.
text.WEB: Then Jesus said to his disciples, “If anyone desires to come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.

text.KJV: For whosoever will save his life shall lose it: and whosoever will lose his life for my sake shall find it.
text.ASV: For whosoever would save his life shall lose it: and whosoever shall lose his life for my sake shall find it.
text.WEB: For whoever desires to save his life will lose it, and whoever will lose his life for my sake will find it.

text.KJV: For what is a man profited, if he shall gain the whole world, and lose his own soul? or what shall a man give in exchange for his soul?
text.ASV: For what shall a man be profited, if he shall gain the whole world, and forfeit his life? or what shall a man give in exchange for his life?
text.WEB: For what will it profit a man, if he gains the whole world, and forfeits his life? Or what will a man give in exchange for his life?

text.KJV: For the Son of man shall come in the glory of his Father with his angels; and then he shall reward every man according to his works.
text.ASV: For the Son of man shall come in the glory of his Father with his angels; and then shall he render unto every man according to his deeds.
text.WEB: For the Son of Man will come in the glory of his Father with his angels, and then he will render to everyone according to his deeds.

text.KJV: Verily I say unto you, There be some standing here, which shall not taste of death, till they see the Son of man coming in his kingdom.
text.ASV: Verily I say unto you, there are some of them that stand here, who shall in no wise taste of death, till they see the Son of man coming in his kingdom.
text.WEB: Most certainly I tell you, there are some standing here who will in no way taste of death, until they see the Son of Man coming in his Kingdom.”

text.KJV: And after six days Jesus taketh Peter, James, and John his brother, and bringeth them up into an high mountain apart,
text.ASV: And after six days Jesus taketh with him Peter, and James, and John his brother, and bringeth them up into a high mountain apart:
text.WEB: After six days, Jesus took with him Peter, James, and John his brother, and brought them up into a high mountain by themselves.

text.KJV: And was transfigured before them: and his face did shine as the sun, and his raiment was white as the light.
text.ASV: and he was transfigured before them; and his face did shine as the sun, and his garments became white as the light.
text.WEB: He was transfigured before them. His face shone like the sun, and his garments became as white as the light.

text.KJV: And, behold, there appeared unto them Moses and Elias talking with him.
text.ASV: And behold, there appeared unto them Moses and Elijah talking with him.
text.WEB: Behold, Moses and Elijah appeared to them talking with him.

text.KJV: Then answered Peter, and said unto Jesus, Lord, it is good for us to be here: if thou wilt, let us make here three tabernacles; one for thee, and one for Moses, and one for Elias.
text.ASV: And Peter answered, and said unto Jesus, Lord, it is good for us to be here: if thou wilt, I will make here three tabernacles; one for thee, and one for Moses, and one for Elijah.
text.WEB: Peter answered, and said to Jesus, “Lord, it is good for us to be here. If you want, let’s make three tents here: one for you, one for Moses, and one for Elijah.”

text.KJV: While he yet spake, behold, a bright cloud overshadowed them: and behold a voice out of the cloud, which said, This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased; hear ye him.
text.ASV: While he was yet speaking, behold, a bright cloud overshadowed them: and behold, a voice out of the cloud, saying, This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased; hear ye him.
text.WEB: While he was still speaking, behold, a bright cloud overshadowed them. Behold, a voice came out of the cloud, saying, “This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased. Listen to him.”

text.KJV: And when the disciples heard it, they fell on their face, and were sore afraid.
text.ASV: And when the disciples heard it, they fell on their face, and were sore afraid.
text.WEB: When the disciples heard it, they fell on their faces, and were very afraid.

text.KJV: And Jesus came and touched them, and said, Arise, and be not afraid.
text.ASV: And Jesus came and touched them and said, Arise, and be not afraid.
text.WEB: Jesus came and touched them and said, “Get up, and don’t be afraid.”

text.KJV: And when they had lifted up their eyes, they saw no man, save Jesus only.
text.ASV: And lifting up their eyes, they saw no one, save Jesus only.
text.WEB: Lifting up their eyes, they saw no one, except Jesus alone.

text.KJV: And as they came down from the mountain, Jesus charged them, saying, Tell the vision to no man, until the Son of man be risen again from the dead.
text.ASV: And as they were coming down from the mountain, Jesus commanded them, saying, Tell the vision to no man, until the Son of man be risen from the dead.
text.WEB: As they were coming down from the mountain, Jesus commanded them, saying, “Don’t tell anyone what you saw, until the Son of Man has risen from the dead.”

text.KJV: And his disciples asked him, saying, Why then say the scribes that Elias must first come?
text.ASV: And his disciples asked him, saying, Why then say the scribes that Elijah must first come?
text.WEB: His disciples asked him, saying, “Then why do the scribes say that Elijah must come first?”

text.KJV: And Jesus answered and said unto them, Elias truly shall first come, and restore all things.
text.ASV: And he answered and said, Elijah indeed cometh, and shall restore all things:
text.WEB: Jesus answered them, “Elijah indeed comes first, and will restore all things,

text.KJV: But I say unto you, That Elias is come already, and they knew him not, but have done unto him whatsoever they listed. Likewise shall also the Son of man suffer of them.
text.ASV: but I say into you, that Elijah is come already, and they knew him not, but did unto him whatsoever they would. Even so shall the Son of man also suffer of them.
text.WEB: but I tell you that Elijah has come already, and they didn’t recognize him, but did to him whatever they wanted to. Even so the Son of Man will also suffer by them.”

text.KJV: Then the disciples understood that he spake unto them of John the Baptist.
text.ASV: Then understood the disciples that he spake unto them of John the Baptist.
text.WEB: Then the disciples understood that he spoke to them of John the Baptizer.

text.KJV: And when they were come to the multitude, there came to him a certain man, kneeling down to him, and saying,
text.ASV: And when they were come to the multitude, there came to him a man, kneeling to him, saying,
text.WEB: When they came to the multitude, a man came to him, kneeling down to him, and saying,

text.KJV: Lord, have mercy on my son: for he is lunatick, and sore vexed: for ofttimes he falleth into the fire, and oft into the water.
text.ASV: Lord, have mercy on my son: for he is epileptic, and suffereth grievously; for oft-times he falleth into the fire, and off-times into the water.
text.WEB: “Lord, have mercy on my son, for he is epileptic, and suffers grievously; for he often falls into the fire, and often into the water.

text.KJV: And I brought him to thy disciples, and they could not cure him.
text.ASV: And I brought him to thy disciples, and they could not cure him.
text.WEB: So I brought him to your disciples, and they could not cure him.”

text.KJV: Then Jesus answered and said, O faithless and perverse generation, how long shall I be with you? how long shall I suffer you? bring him hither to me.
text.ASV: And Jesus answered and said, O faithless and perverse generation, how long shall I be with you? how long shall I bear with you? bring him hither to me.
text.WEB: Jesus answered, “Faithless and perverse generation! How long will I be with you? How long will I bear with you? Bring him here to me.”

text.KJV: And Jesus rebuked the devil; and he departed out of him: and the child was cured from that very hour.
text.ASV: And Jesus rebuked him; and the demon went out of him: and the boy was cured from that hour.
text.WEB: Jesus rebuked him, the demon went out of him, and the boy was cured from that hour.

text.KJV: Then came the disciples to Jesus apart, and said, Why could not we cast him out?
text.ASV: Then came the disciples to Jesus apart, and said, Why could not we cast it out?
text.WEB: Then the disciples came to Jesus privately, and said, “Why weren’t we able to cast it out?”

text.KJV: And Jesus said unto them, Because of your unbelief: for verily I say unto you, If ye have faith as a grain of mustard seed, ye shall say unto this mountain, Remove hence to yonder place; and it shall remove; and nothing shall be impossible unto you.
text.ASV: And he saith unto them, Because of your little faith: for verily I say unto you, If ye have faith as a grain of mustard seed, ye shall say unto this mountain, Remove hence to yonder place; and it shall remove; and nothing shall be impossible unto you.
text.WEB: He said to them, “Because of your unbelief. For most certainly I tell you, if you have faith as a grain of mustard seed, you will tell this mountain, ‘Move from here to there,’ and it will move; and nothing will be impossible for you.

text.KJV: Howbeit this kind goeth not out but by prayer and fasting.
text.ASV: `But this kind goeth not out save by prayer and fasting.'
text.WEB: But this kind doesn’t go out except by prayer and fasting.”

text.KJV: And while they abode in Galilee, Jesus said unto them, The Son of man shall be betrayed into the hands of men:
text.ASV: And while they abode in Galilee, Jesus said unto them, The Son of man shall be delivered up into the hands of men;
text.WEB: While they were staying in Galilee, Jesus said to them, “The Son of Man is about to be delivered up into the hands of men,

text.KJV: And they shall kill him, and the third day he shall be raised again. And they were exceeding sorry.
text.ASV: and they shall kill him, and the third day he shall be raised up. And they were exceeding sorry.
text.WEB: and they will kill him, and the third day he will be raised up.” They were exceedingly sorry.

text.KJV: And when they were come to Capernaum, they that received tribute money came to Peter, and said, Doth not your master pay tribute?
text.ASV: And when they were come to Capernaum, they that received the half-shekel came to Peter, and said, Doth not your teacher pay the half-shekel?
text.WEB: When they had come to Capernaum, those who collected the didrachma coins came to Peter, and said, “Doesn’t your teacher pay the didrachma?”

text.KJV: He saith, Yes. And when he was come into the house, Jesus prevented him, saying, What thinkest thou, Simon? of whom do the kings of the earth take custom or tribute? of their own children, or of strangers?
text.ASV: He saith, Yea. And when he came into the house, Jesus spake first to him, saying, What thinkest thou, Simon? the kings of the earth, from whom do they receive toll or tribute? from their sons, or from strangers?
text.WEB: He said, “Yes.” When he came into the house, Jesus anticipated him, saying, “What do you think, Simon? From whom do the kings of the earth receive toll or tribute? From their children, or from strangers?”

text.KJV: Peter saith unto him, Of strangers. Jesus saith unto him, Then are the children free.
text.ASV: And when he said, From strangers, Jesus said unto him, Therefore the sons are free.
text.WEB: Peter said to him, “From strangers.” Jesus said to him, “Therefore the children are exempt.

text.KJV: Notwithstanding, lest we should offend them, go thou to the sea, and cast an hook, and take up the fish that first cometh up; and when thou hast opened his mouth, thou shalt find a piece of money: that take, and give unto them for me and thee.
text.ASV: But, lest we cause them to stumble, go thou to the sea, and cast a hook, and take up the fish that first cometh up; and when thou hast opened his mouth, thou shalt find a shekel: that take, and give unto them for me and thee.
text.WEB: But, lest we cause them to stumble, go to the sea, cast a hook, and take up the first fish that comes up. When you have opened its mouth, you will find a stater coin. Take that, and give it to them for me and you.”

text.KJV: At the same time came the disciples unto Jesus, saying, Who is the greatest in the kingdom of heaven?
text.ASV: In that hour came the disciples unto Jesus, saying, Who then is greatest in the kingdom of heaven?
text.WEB: In that hour the disciples came to Jesus, saying, “Who then is greatest in the Kingdom of Heaven?”

text.KJV: And Jesus called a little child unto him, and set him in the midst of them,
text.ASV: And he called to him a little child, and set him in the midst of them,
text.WEB: Jesus called a little child to himself, and set him in the middle of them,

text.KJV: And said, Verily I say unto you, Except ye be converted, and become as little children, ye shall not enter into the kingdom of heaven.
text.ASV: and said, Verily I say unto you, Except ye turn, and become as little children, ye shall in no wise enter into the kingdom of heaven.
text.WEB: and said, “Most certainly I tell you, unless you turn, and become as little children, you will in no way enter into the Kingdom of Heaven.

text.KJV: Whosoever therefore shall humble himself as this little child, the same is greatest in the kingdom of heaven.
text.ASV: Whosoever therefore shall humble himself as this little child, the same is the greatest in the kingdom of heaven.
text.WEB: Whoever therefore humbles himself as this little child, the same is the greatest in the Kingdom of Heaven.

text.KJV: And whoso shall receive one such little child in my name receiveth me.
text.ASV: And whoso shall receive one such little child in my name receiveth me:
text.WEB: Whoever receives one such little child in my name receives me,

text.KJV: But whoso shall offend one of these little ones which believe in me, it were better for him that a millstone were hanged about his neck, and that he were drowned in the depth of the sea.
text.ASV: But whoso shall cause one of these little ones that believe on me to stumble, it is profitable for him that a great millstone should be hanged about his neck, and `that' he should be sunk in the depth of the sea.
text.WEB: but whoever causes one of these little ones who believe in me to stumble, it would be better for him that a huge millstone should be hung around his neck, and that he should be sunk in the depths of the sea.

text.KJV: Woe unto the world because of offences! for it must needs be that offences come; but woe to that man by whom the offence cometh!
text.ASV: Woe unto the world because of occasions of stumbling! for it must needs be that the occasions come; but woe to that man through whom the occasion cometh!
text.WEB: “Woe to the world because of occasions of stumbling! For it must be that the occasions come, but woe to that person through whom the occasion comes!

text.KJV: Wherefore if thy hand or thy foot offend thee, cut them off, and cast them from thee: it is better for thee to enter into life halt or maimed, rather than having two hands or two feet to be cast into everlasting fire.
text.ASV: And if thy hand or thy foot causeth thee to stumble, cut it off, and cast it from thee: it is good for thee to enter into life maimed or halt, rather than having two hands or two feet to be cast into the eternal fire.
text.WEB: If your hand or your foot causes you to stumble, cut it off, and cast it from you. It is better for you to enter into life maimed or crippled, rather than having two hands or two feet to be cast into the eternal fire.

text.KJV: And if thine eye offend thee, pluck it out, and cast it from thee: it is better for thee to enter into life with one eye, rather than having two eyes to be cast into hell fire.
text.ASV: And if thine eye causeth thee to stumble, pluck it out, and cast it from thee: it is good for thee to enter into life with one eye, rather than having two eyes to be cast into the hell of fire.
text.WEB: If your eye causes you to stumble, pluck it out, and cast it from you. It is better for you to enter into life with one eye, rather than having two eyes to be cast into the Gehenna of fire.

text.KJV: Take heed that ye despise not one of these little ones; for I say unto you, That in heaven their angels do always behold the face of my Father which is in heaven.
text.ASV: See that ye despise not one of these little ones; for I say unto you, that in heaven their angels do always behold the face of my Father who is in heaven.
text.WEB: See that you don’t despise one of these little ones, for I tell you that in heaven their angels always see the face of my Father who is in heaven.

text.KJV: For the Son of man is come to save that which was lost.
text.ASV: `For the Son of man came to save that which was lost.'
text.WEB: For the Son of Man came to save that which was lost.

text.KJV: How think ye? if a man have an hundred sheep, and one of them be gone astray, doth he not leave the ninety and nine, and goeth into the mountains, and seeketh that which is gone astray?
text.ASV: How think ye? if any man have a hundred sheep, and one of them be gone astray, doth he not leave the ninety and nine, and go unto the mountains, and seek that which goeth astray?
text.WEB: “What do you think? If a man has one hundred sheep, and one of them goes astray, doesn’t he leave the ninety-nine, go to the mountains, and seek that which has gone astray?

text.KJV: And if so be that he find it, verily I say unto you, he rejoiceth more of that sheep, than of the ninety and nine which went not astray.
text.ASV: And if so be that he find it, verily I say unto you, he rejoiceth over it more than over the ninety and nine which have not gone astray.
text.WEB: If he finds it, most certainly I tell you, he rejoices over it more than over the ninety-nine which have not gone astray.

text.KJV: Even so it is not the will of your Father which is in heaven, that one of these little ones should perish.
text.ASV: Even so it is not the will of your Father who is in heaven, that one of these little ones should perish.
text.WEB: Even so it is not the will of your Father who is in heaven that one of these little ones should perish.

text.KJV: Moreover if thy brother shall trespass against thee, go and tell him his fault between thee and him alone: if he shall hear thee, thou hast gained thy brother.
text.ASV: And if thy brother sin against thee, go, show him his fault between thee and him alone: if he hear thee, thou hast gained thy brother.
text.WEB: “If your brother sins against you, go, show him his fault between you and him alone. If he listens to you, you have gained back your brother.

text.KJV: But if he will not hear thee, then take with thee one or two more, that in the mouth of two or three witnesses every word may be established.
text.ASV: But if he hear `thee' not, take with thee one or two more, that at the mouth of two witnesses or three every word may be established.
text.WEB: But if he doesn’t listen, take one or two more with you, that at the mouth of two or three witnesses every word may be established.

text.KJV: And if he shall neglect to hear them, tell it unto the church: but if he neglect to hear the church, let him be unto thee as an heathen man and a publican.
text.ASV: And if he refuse to hear them, tell it unto the church: and if he refuse to hear the church also, let him be unto thee as the Gentile and the publican.
text.WEB: If he refuses to listen to them, tell it to the assembly. If he refuses to hear the assembly also, let him be to you as a Gentile or a tax collector.

text.KJV: Verily I say unto you, Whatsoever ye shall bind on earth shall be bound in heaven: and whatsoever ye shall loose on earth shall be loosed in heaven.
text.ASV: Verily I say unto you, what things soever ye shall bind on earth shall be bound in heaven; and what things soever ye shall loose on earth shall be loosed in heaven.
text.WEB: Most certainly I tell you, whatever things you bind on earth will have been bound in heaven, and whatever things you release on earth will have been released in heaven.

text.KJV: Again I say unto you, That if two of you shall agree on earth as touching any thing that they shall ask, it shall be done for them of my Father which is in heaven.
text.ASV: Again I say unto you, that if two of you shall agree on earth as touching anything that they shall ask, it shall be done for them of my Father who is in heaven.
text.WEB: Again, assuredly I tell you, that if two of you will agree on earth concerning anything that they will ask, it will be done for them by my Father who is in heaven.

text.KJV: For where two or three are gathered together in my name, there am I in the midst of them.
text.ASV: For where two or three are gathered together in my name, there am I in the midst of them.
text.WEB: For where two or three are gathered together in my name, there I am in the middle of them.”

text.KJV: Then came Peter to him, and said, Lord, how oft shall my brother sin against me, and I forgive him? till seven times?
text.ASV: Then came Peter and said to him, Lord, how oft shall my brother sin against me, and I forgive him? until seven times?
text.WEB: Then Peter came and said to him, “Lord, how often shall my brother sin against me, and I forgive him? Until seven times?”

text.KJV: Jesus saith unto him, I say not unto thee, Until seven times: but, Until seventy times seven.
text.ASV: Jesus saith unto him, I say not unto thee, Until seven times; but, Until seventy times seven.
text.WEB: Jesus said to him, “I don’t tell you until seven times, but, until seventy times seven.

text.KJV: Therefore is the kingdom of heaven likened unto a certain king, which would take account of his servants.
text.ASV: Therefore is the kingdom of heaven likened unto a certain king, who would make a reckoning with his servants.
text.WEB: Therefore the Kingdom of Heaven is like a certain king, who wanted to reconcile accounts with his servants.

text.KJV: And when he had begun to reckon, one was brought unto him, which owed him ten thousand talents.
text.ASV: And when he had begun to reckon, one was brought unto him, that owed him ten thousand talents.
text.WEB: When he had begun to reconcile, one was brought to him who owed him ten thousand talents.

text.KJV: But forasmuch as he had not to pay, his lord commanded him to be sold, and his wife, and children, and all that he had, and payment to be made.
text.ASV: But forasmuch as he had not `wherewith' to pay, his lord commanded him to be sold, and his wife, and children, and all that he had, and payment to be made.
text.WEB: But because he couldn’t pay, his lord commanded him to be sold, with his wife, his children, and all that he had, and payment to be made.

text.KJV: The servant therefore fell down, and worshipped him, saying, Lord, have patience with me, and I will pay thee all.
text.ASV: The servant therefore fell down and worshipped him, saying, Lord, have patience with me, and I will pay thee all.
text.WEB: The servant therefore fell down and knelt before him, saying, ‘Lord, have patience with me, and I will repay you all!’

text.KJV: Then the lord of that servant was moved with compassion, and loosed him, and forgave him the debt.
text.ASV: And the lord of that servant, being moved with compassion, released him, and forgave him the debt.
text.WEB: The lord of that servant, being moved with compassion, released him, and forgave him the debt.

text.KJV: But the same servant went out, and found one of his fellowservants, which owed him an hundred pence: and he laid hands on him, and took him by the throat, saying, Pay me that thou owest.
text.ASV: But that servant went out, and found one of his fellow-servants, who owed him a hundred shillings: and he laid hold on him, and took `him' by the throat, saying, Pay what thou owest.
text.WEB: “But that servant went out, and found one of his fellow servants, who owed him one hundred denarii, and he grabbed him, and took him by the throat, saying, ‘Pay me what you owe!’

text.KJV: And his fellowservant fell down at his feet, and besought him, saying, Have patience with me, and I will pay thee all.
text.ASV: So his fellow-servant fell down and besought him, saying, Have patience with me, and I will pay thee.
text.WEB: “So his fellow servant fell down at his feet and begged him, saying, ‘Have patience with me, and I will repay you!’

text.KJV: And he would not: but went and cast him into prison, till he should pay the debt.
text.ASV: And he would not: but went and cast him into prison, till he should pay that which was due.
text.WEB: He would not, but went and cast him into prison, until he should pay back that which was due.

text.KJV: So when his fellowservants saw what was done, they were very sorry, and came and told unto their lord all that was done.
text.ASV: So when his fellow-servants saw what was done, they were exceeding sorry, and came and told unto their lord all that was done.
text.WEB: So when his fellow servants saw what was done, they were exceedingly sorry, and came and told their lord all that was done.

text.KJV: Then his lord, after that he had called him, said unto him, O thou wicked servant, I forgave thee all that debt, because thou desiredst me:
text.ASV: Then his lord called him unto him, and saith to him, Thou wicked servant, I forgave thee all that debt, because thou besoughtest me:
text.WEB: Then his lord called him in, and said to him, ‘You wicked servant! I forgave you all that debt, because you begged me.

text.KJV: Shouldest not thou also have had compassion on thy fellowservant, even as I had pity on thee?
text.ASV: shouldest not thou also have had mercy on thy fellow-servant, even as I had mercy on thee?
text.WEB: Shouldn’t you also have had mercy on your fellow servant, even as I had mercy on you?’

text.KJV: And his lord was wroth, and delivered him to the tormentors, till he should pay all that was due unto him.
text.ASV: And his lord was wroth, and delivered him to the tormentors, till he should pay all that was due.
text.WEB: His lord was angry, and delivered him to the tormentors, until he should pay all that was due to him.

text.KJV: So likewise shall my heavenly Father do also unto you, if ye from your hearts forgive not every one his brother their trespasses.
text.ASV: So shall also my heavenly Father do unto you, if ye forgive not every one his brother from your hearts.
text.WEB: So my heavenly Father will also do to you, if you don’t each forgive your brother from your hearts for his misdeeds.”

text.KJV: And it came to pass, that when Jesus had finished these sayings, he departed from Galilee, and came into the coasts of Judaea beyond Jordan;
text.ASV: And it came to pass when Jesus had finished these words, he departed from Galilee, and came into the borders of Judaea beyond the Jordan;
text.WEB: When Jesus had finished these words, he departed from Galilee, and came into the borders of Judea beyond the Jordan.

text.KJV: And great multitudes followed him; and he healed them there.
text.ASV: and great multitudes followed him; and he healed them there.
text.WEB: Great multitudes followed him, and he healed them there.

text.KJV: The Pharisees also came unto him, tempting him, and saying unto him, Is it lawful for a man to put away his wife for every cause?
text.ASV: And there came unto him Pharisees, trying him, and saying, Is it lawful `for a man' to put away his wife for every cause?
text.WEB: Pharisees came to him, testing him, and saying, “Is it lawful for a man to divorce his wife for any reason?”

text.KJV: And he answered and said unto them, Have ye not read, that he which made them at the beginning made them male and female,
text.ASV: And he answered and said, Have ye not read, that he who made `them' from the beginning made them male and female,
text.WEB: He answered, “Haven’t you read that he who made them from the beginning made them male and female,

text.KJV: And said, For this cause shall a man leave father and mother, and shall cleave to his wife: and they twain shall be one flesh?
text.ASV: and said, For this cause shall a man leave his father and mother, and shall cleave to his wife; and the two shall become one flesh?
text.WEB: and said, ‘For this cause a man shall leave his father and mother, and shall be joined to his wife; and the two shall become one flesh?’

text.KJV: Wherefore they are no more twain, but one flesh. What therefore God hath joined together, let not man put asunder.
text.ASV: So that they are no more two, but one flesh. What therefore God hath joined together, let not man put asunder.
text.WEB: So that they are no more two, but one flesh. What therefore God has joined together, don’t let man tear apart.”

text.KJV: They say unto him, Why did Moses then command to give a writing of divorcement, and to put her away?
text.ASV: They say unto him, Why then did Moses command to give a bill of divorcement, and to put `her' away?
text.WEB: They asked him, “Why then did Moses command us to give her a bill of divorce, and divorce her?”

text.KJV: He saith unto them, Moses because of the hardness of your hearts suffered you to put away your wives: but from the beginning it was not so.
text.ASV: He saith unto them, Moses for your hardness of heart suffered you to put away your wives: but from the beginning it hath not been so.
text.WEB: He said to them, “Moses, because of the hardness of your hearts, allowed you to divorce your wives, but from the beginning it has not been so.

text.KJV: And I say unto you, Whosoever shall put away his wife, except it be for fornication, and shall marry another, committeth adultery: and whoso marrieth her which is put away doth commit adultery.
text.ASV: And I say unto you, Whosoever shall put away his wife, except for fornication, and shall marry another, committeth adultery: and he that marrieth her when she is put away committeth adultery.
text.WEB: I tell you that whoever divorces his wife, except for sexual immorality, and marries another, commits adultery; and he who marries her when she is divorced commits adultery.”

text.KJV: His disciples say unto him, If the case of the man be so with his wife, it is not good to marry.
text.ASV: The disciples say unto him, If the case of the man is so with his wife, it is not expedient to marry.
text.WEB: His disciples said to him, “If this is the case of the man with his wife, it is not expedient to marry.”
