text.KJV: But he said unto them, All men cannot receive this saying, save they to whom it is given.
text.ASV: But he said unto them, Not all men can receive this saying, but they to whom it is given.
text.WEB: But he said to them, “Not all men can receive this saying, but those to whom it is given.

text.KJV: For there are some eunuchs, which were so born from their mother's womb: and there are some eunuchs, which were made eunuchs of men: and there be eunuchs, which have made themselves eunuchs for the kingdom of heaven's sake. He that is able to receive it, let him receive it.
text.ASV: For there are eunuchs, that were so born from their mother's womb: and there are eunuchs, that were made eunuchs by men: and there are eunuchs, that made themselves eunuchs for the kingdom of heaven's sake. He that is able to receive it, let him receive it.
text.WEB: For there are eunuchs who were born that way from their mother’s womb, and there are eunuchs who were made eunuchs by men; and there are eunuchs who made themselves eunuchs for the Kingdom of Heaven’s sake. He who is able to receive it, let him receive it.”

text.KJV: Then were there brought unto him little children, that he should put his hands on them, and pray: and the disciples rebuked them.
text.ASV: Then were there brought unto him little children, that he should lay his hands on them, and pray: and the disciples rebuked them.
text.WEB: Then little children were brought to him, that he should lay his hands on them and pray; and the disciples rebuked them.

text.KJV: But Jesus said, Suffer little children, and forbid them not, to come unto me: for of such is the kingdom of heaven.
text.ASV: But Jesus said, Suffer the little children, and forbid them not, to come unto me: for to such belongeth the kingdom of heaven.
text.WEB: But Jesus said, “Allow the little children, and don’t forbid them to come to me; for the Kingdom of Heaven belongs to ones like these.”

text.KJV: And he laid his hands on them, and departed thence.
text.ASV: And he laid his hands on them, and departed thence.
text.WEB: He laid his hands on them, and departed from there.

text.KJV: And, behold, one came and said unto him, Good Master, what good thing shall I do, that I may have eternal life?
text.ASV: And behold, one came to him and said, Teacher, what good thing shall I do, that I may have eternal life?
text.WEB: Behold, one came to him and said, “Good teacher, what good thing shall I do, that I may have eternal life?”

text.KJV: And he said unto him, Why callest thou me good? there is none good but one, that is, God: but if thou wilt enter into life, keep the commandments.
text.ASV: And he said unto him, Why askest thou me concerning that which is good? One there is who is good: but if thou wouldest enter into life, keep the commandments.
text.WEB: He said to him, “Why do you call me good? No one is good but one, that is, God. But if you want to enter into life, keep the commandments.”

text.KJV: He saith unto him, Which? Jesus said, Thou shalt do no murder, Thou shalt not commit adultery, Thou shalt not steal, Thou shalt not bear false witness,
text.ASV: He saith unto him, Which? And Jesus said, Thou shalt not kill, Thou shalt not commit adultery, Thou shalt not steal, Thou shalt not bear false witness,
text.WEB: He said to him, “Which ones?” Jesus said, “‘You shall not murder.’ ‘You shall not commit adultery.’ ‘You shall not steal.’ ‘You shall not offer false testimony.’

text.KJV: Honour thy father and thy mother: and, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.
text.ASV: Honor thy father and mother; and, Thou shalt love thy neighbor as thyself.
text.WEB: ‘Honor your father and your mother.’; And, ‘You shall love your neighbor as yourself.’”

text.KJV: The young man saith unto him, All these things have I kept from my youth up: what lack I yet?
text.ASV: The young man saith unto him, All these things have I observed: what lack I yet?
text.WEB: The young man said to him, “All these things I have observed from my youth. What do I still lack?”

text.KJV: Jesus said unto him, If thou wilt be perfect, go and sell that thou hast, and give to the poor, and thou shalt have treasure in heaven: and come and follow me.
text.ASV: Jesus said unto him, If thou wouldest be perfect, go, sell that which thou hast, and give to the poor, and thou shalt have treasure in heaven: and come, follow me.
text.WEB: Jesus said to him, “If you want to be perfect, go, sell what you have, and give to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven; and come, follow me.”

text.KJV: But when the young man heard that saying, he went away sorrowful: for he had great possessions.
text.ASV: But when the young man heard the saying, he went away sorrowful; for he was one that had great possessions.
text.WEB: But when the young man heard the saying, he went away sad, for he was one who had great possessions.

text.KJV: Then said Jesus unto his disciples, Verily I say unto you, That a rich man shall hardly enter into the kingdom of heaven.
text.ASV: And Jesus said unto his disciples, Verily I say unto you, It is hard for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of heaven.
text.WEB: Jesus said to his disciples, “Most certainly I say to you, a rich man will enter into the Kingdom of Heaven with difficulty.

text.KJV: And again I say unto you, It is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle, than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God.
text.ASV: And again I say unto you, It is easier for a camel to go through a needle's eye, than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God.
text.WEB: Again I tell you, it is easier for a camel to go through a needle’s eye, than for a rich man to enter into God’s Kingdom.”

text.KJV: When his disciples heard it, they were exceedingly amazed, saying, Who then can be saved?
text.ASV: And when the disciples heard it, they were astonished exceedingly, saying, Who then can be saved?
text.WEB: When the disciples heard it, they were exceedingly astonished, saying, “Who then can be saved?”

text.KJV: But Jesus beheld them, and said unto them, With men this is impossible; but with God all things are possible.
text.ASV: And Jesus looking upon `them' said to them, With men this is impossible; but with God all things are possible.
text.WEB: Looking at them, Jesus said, “With men this is impossible, but with God all things are possible.”

text.KJV: Then answered Peter and said unto him, Behold, we have forsaken all, and followed thee; what shall we have therefore?
text.ASV: Then answered Peter and said unto him, Lo, we have left all, and followed thee; what then shall we have?
text.WEB: Then Peter answered, “Behold, we have left everything, and followed you. What then will we have?”

text.KJV: And Jesus said unto them, Verily I say unto you, That ye which have followed me, in the regeneration when the Son of man shall sit in the throne of his glory, ye also shall sit upon twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.
text.ASV: And Jesus said unto them, Verily I say unto you, that ye who have followed me, in the regeneration when the Son of man shall sit on the throne of his glory, ye also shall sit upon twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.
text.WEB: Jesus said to them, “Most certainly I tell you that you who have followed me, in the regeneration when the Son of Man will sit on the throne of his glory, you also will sit on twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.

text.KJV: And every one that hath forsaken houses, or brethren, or sisters, or father, or mother, or wife, or children, or lands, for my name's sake, shall receive an hundredfold, and shall inherit everlasting life.
text.ASV: And every one that hath left houses, or brethren, or sisters, or father, or mother, or children, or lands, for my name's sake, shall receive a hundredfold, and shall inherit eternal life.
text.WEB: Everyone who has left houses, or brothers, or sisters, or father, or mother, or wife, or children, or lands, for my name’s sake, will receive one hundred times, and will inherit eternal life.

text.KJV: But many that are first shall be last; and the last shall be first.
text.ASV: But many shall be last `that are' first; and first `that are' last.
text.WEB: But many will be last who are first; and first who are last.

text.KJV: For the kingdom of heaven is like unto a man that is an householder, which went out early in the morning to hire labourers into his vineyard.
text.ASV: For the kingdom of heaven is like unto a man that was a householder, who went out early in the morning to hire laborers into his vineyard.
text.WEB: “For the Kingdom of Heaven is like a man who was the master of a household, who went out early in the morning to hire laborers for his vineyard.

text.KJV: And when he had agreed with the labourers for a penny a day, he sent them into his vineyard.
text.ASV: And when he had agreed with the laborers for a shilling a day, he sent them into his vineyard.
text.WEB: When he had agreed with the laborers for a denarius a day, he sent them into his vineyard.

text.KJV: And he went out about the third hour, and saw others standing idle in the marketplace,
text.ASV: And he went out about the third hour, and saw others standing in the marketplace idle;
text.WEB: He went out about the third hour, and saw others standing idle in the marketplace.

text.KJV: And said unto them; Go ye also into the vineyard, and whatsoever is right I will give you. And they went their way.
text.ASV: and to them he said, Go ye also into the vineyard, and whatsoever is right I will give you. And they went their way.
text.WEB: He said to them, ‘You also go into the vineyard, and whatever is right I will give you.’ So they went their way.

text.KJV: Again he went out about the sixth and ninth hour, and did likewise.
text.ASV: Again he went out about the sixth and the ninth hour, and did likewise.
text.WEB: Again he went out about the sixth and the ninth hour, and did likewise.

text.KJV: And about the eleventh hour he went out, and found others standing idle, and saith unto them, Why stand ye here all the day idle?
text.ASV: And about the eleventh `hour' he went out, and found others standing; and he saith unto them, Why stand ye here all the day idle?
text.WEB: About the eleventh hour he went out, and found others standing idle. He said to them, ‘Why do you stand here all day idle?’

text.KJV: They say unto him, Because no man hath hired us. He saith unto them, Go ye also into the vineyard; and whatsoever is right, that shall ye receive.
text.ASV: They say unto him, Because no man hath hired us. He saith unto them, Go ye also into the vineyard.
text.WEB: “They said to him, ‘Because no one has hired us.’ “He said to them, ‘You also go into the vineyard, and you will receive whatever is right.’

text.KJV: So when even was come, the lord of the vineyard saith unto his steward, Call the labourers, and give them their hire, beginning from the last unto the first.
text.ASV: And when even was come, the lord of the vineyard saith unto his steward, Call the laborers, and pay them their hire, beginning from the last unto the first.
text.WEB: When evening had come, the lord of the vineyard said to his manager, ‘Call the laborers and pay them their wages, beginning from the last to the first.’

text.KJV: And when they came that were hired about the eleventh hour, they received every man a penny.
text.ASV: And when they came that `were hired' about the eleventh hour, they received every man a shilling.
text.WEB: “When those who were hired at about the eleventh hour came, they each received a denarius.

text.KJV: But when the first came, they supposed that they should have received more; and they likewise received every man a penny.
text.ASV: And when the first came, they supposed that they would receive more; and they likewise received every man a shilling.
text.WEB: When the first came, they supposed that they would receive more; and they likewise each received a denarius.

text.KJV: And when they had received it, they murmured against the goodman of the house,
text.ASV: And when they received it, they murmured against the householder,
text.WEB: When they received it, they murmured against the master of the household,

text.KJV: Saying, These last have wrought but one hour, and thou hast made them equal unto us, which have borne the burden and heat of the day.
text.ASV: saying, These last have spent `but' one hour, and thou hast made them equal unto us, who have borne the burden of the day and the scorching heat.
text.WEB: saying, ‘These last have spent one hour, and you have made them equal to us, who have borne the burden of the day and the scorching heat!’

text.KJV: But he answered one of them, and said, Friend, I do thee no wrong: didst not thou agree with me for a penny?
text.ASV: But he answered and said to one of them, Friend, I do thee no wrong: didst not thou agree with me for a shilling?
text.WEB: “But he answered one of them, ‘Friend, I am doing you no wrong. Didn’t you agree with me for a denarius?

text.KJV: Take that thine is, and go thy way: I will give unto this last, even as unto thee.
text.ASV: Take up that which is thine, and go thy way; it is my will to give unto this last, even as unto thee.
text.WEB: Take that which is yours, and go your way. It is my desire to give to this last just as much as to you.

text.KJV: Is it not lawful for me to do what I will with mine own? Is thine eye evil, because I am good?
text.ASV: Is it not lawful for me to do what I will with mine own? or is thine eye evil, because I am good?
text.WEB: Isn’t it lawful for me to do what I want to with what I own? Or is your eye evil, because I am good?’

text.KJV: So the last shall be first, and the first last: for many be called, but few chosen.
text.ASV: So the last shall be first, and the first last.
text.WEB: So the last will be first, and the first last. For many are called, but few are chosen.”

text.KJV: And Jesus going up to Jerusalem took the twelve disciples apart in the way, and said unto them,
text.ASV: And as Jesus was going up to Jerusalem, he took the twelve disciples apart, and on the way he said unto them,
text.WEB: As Jesus was going up to Jerusalem, he took the twelve disciples aside, and on the way he said to them,

text.KJV: Behold, we go up to Jerusalem; and the Son of man shall be betrayed unto the chief priests and unto the scribes, and they shall condemn him to death,
text.ASV: Behold, we go up to Jerusalem; and the Son of man shall be delivered unto the chief priests and scribes; and they shall condemn him to death,
text.WEB: “Behold, we are going up to Jerusalem, and the Son of Man will be delivered to the chief priests and scribes, and they will condemn him to death,

text.KJV: And shall deliver him to the Gentiles to mock, and to scourge, and to crucify him: and the third day he shall rise again.
text.ASV: and shall deliver him unto the Gentiles to mock, and to scourge, and to crucify: and the third day he shall be raised up.
text.WEB: and will hand him over to the Gentiles to mock, to scourge, and to crucify; and the third day he will be raised up.”

text.KJV: Then came to him the mother of Zebedees children with her sons, worshipping him, and desiring a certain thing of him.
text.ASV: Then came to him the mother of the sons of Zebedee with her sons, worshipping `him', and asking a certain thing of him.
text.WEB: Then the mother of the sons of Zebedee came to him with her sons, kneeling and asking a certain thing of him.

text.KJV: And he said unto her, What wilt thou? She saith unto him, Grant that these my two sons may sit, the one on thy right hand, and the other on the left, in thy kingdom.
text.ASV: And he said unto her, What wouldest thou? She saith unto him, Command that these my two sons may sit, one on thy right hand, and one on thy left hand, in thy kingdom.
text.WEB: He said to her, “What do you want?” She said to him, “Command that these, my two sons, may sit, one on your right hand, and one on your left hand, in your Kingdom.”

text.KJV: But Jesus answered and said, Ye know not what ye ask. Are ye able to drink of the cup that I shall drink of, and to be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with? They say unto him, We are able.
text.ASV: But Jesus answered and said, Ye know not what ye ask. Are ye able to drink the cup that I am about to drink? They say unto him, We are able.
text.WEB: But Jesus answered, “You don’t know what you are asking. Are you able to drink the cup that I am about to drink, and be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with?” They said to him, “We are able.”

text.KJV: And he saith unto them, Ye shall drink indeed of my cup, and be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with: but to sit on my right hand, and on my left, is not mine to give, but it shall be given to them for whom it is prepared of my Father.
text.ASV: He saith unto them, My cup indeed ye shall drink: but to sit on my right hand, and on `my' left hand, is not mine to give; but `it is for them' for whom it hath been prepared of my Father.
text.WEB: He said to them, “You will indeed drink my cup, and be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with, but to sit on my right hand and on my left hand is not mine to give; but it is for whom it has been prepared by my Father.”

text.KJV: And when the ten heard it, they were moved with indignation against the two brethren.
text.ASV: And when the ten heard it, they were moved with indignation concerning the two brethren.
text.WEB: When the ten heard it, they were indignant with the two brothers.

text.KJV: But Jesus called them unto him, and said, Ye know that the princes of the Gentiles exercise dominion over them, and they that are great exercise authority upon them.
text.ASV: But Jesus called them unto him, and said, Ye know that the rulers of the Gentiles lord it over them, and their great ones exercise authority over them.
text.WEB: But Jesus summoned them, and said, “You know that the rulers of the nations lord it over them, and their great ones exercise authority over them.

text.KJV: But it shall not be so among you: but whosoever will be great among you, let him be your minister;
text.ASV: Not so shall it be among you: but whosoever would become great among you shall be your minister;
text.WEB: It shall not be so among you, but whoever desires to become great among you shall be your servant.

text.KJV: And whosoever will be chief among you, let him be your servant:
text.ASV: and whosoever would be first among you shall be your servant:
text.WEB: Whoever desires to be first among you shall be your bondservant,

text.KJV: Even as the Son of man came not to be ministered unto, but to minister, and to give his life a ransom for many.
text.ASV: even as the Son of man came not to be ministered unto, but to minister, and to give his life a ransom for many.
text.WEB: even as the Son of Man came not to be served, but to serve, and to give his life as a ransom for many.”

text.KJV: And as they departed from Jericho, a great multitude followed him.
text.ASV: And as they went out from Jericho, a great multitude followed him.
text.WEB: As they went out from Jericho, a great multitude followed him.

text.KJV: And, behold, two blind men sitting by the way side, when they heard that Jesus passed by, cried out, saying, Have mercy on us, O Lord, thou son of David.
text.ASV: And behold, two blind men sitting by the way side, when they heard that Jesus was passing by, cried out, saying, Lord, have mercy on us, thou son of David.
text.WEB: Behold, two blind men sitting by the road, when they heard that Jesus was passing by, cried out, “Lord, have mercy on us, you son of David!”

text.KJV: And the multitude rebuked them, because they should hold their peace: but they cried the more, saying, Have mercy on us, O Lord, thou son of David.
text.ASV: And the multitude rebuked them, that they should hold their peace: but they cried out the more, saying, Lord, have mercy on us, thou son of David.
text.WEB: The multitude rebuked them, telling them that they should be quiet, but they cried out even more, “Lord, have mercy on us, you son of David!”

text.KJV: And Jesus stood still, and called them, and said, What will ye that I shall do unto you?
text.ASV: And Jesus stood still, and called them, and said, What will ye that I should do unto you?
text.WEB: Jesus stood still, and called them, and asked, “What do you want me to do for you?”

text.KJV: They say unto him, Lord, that our eyes may be opened.
text.ASV: They say unto him, Lord, that our eyes may be opened.
text.WEB: They told him, “Lord, that our eyes may be opened.”

text.KJV: So Jesus had compassion on them, and touched their eyes: and immediately their eyes received sight, and they followed him.
text.ASV: And Jesus, being moved with compassion, touched their eyes; and straightway they received their sight, and followed him.
text.WEB: Jesus, being moved with compassion, touched their eyes; and immediately their eyes received their sight, and they followed him.

text.KJV: And when they drew nigh unto Jerusalem, and were come to Bethphage, unto the mount of Olives, then sent Jesus two disciples,
text.ASV: And when they drew nigh unto Jerusalem, and came unto Bethphage, unto the mount of Olives, then Jesus sent two disciples,
text.WEB: When they came near to Jerusalem, and came to Bethsphage, to the Mount of Olives, then Jesus sent two disciples,

text.KJV: Saying unto them, Go into the village over against you, and straightway ye shall find an ass tied, and a colt with her: loose them, and bring them unto me.
text.ASV: saying unto them, Go into the village that is over against you, and straightway ye shall find an ass tied, and a colt with her: loose `them', and bring `them' unto me.
text.WEB: saying to them, “Go into the village that is opposite you, and immediately you will find a donkey tied, and a colt with her. Untie them, and bring them to me.

text.KJV: And if any man say ought unto you, ye shall say, The Lord hath need of them; and straightway he will send them.
text.ASV: And if any one say aught unto you, ye shall say, The Lord hath need of them; and straightway he will send them.
text.WEB: If anyone says anything to you, you shall say, ‘The Lord needs them,’ and immediately he will send them.”

text.KJV: All this was done, that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophet, saying,
text.ASV: Now this is come to pass, that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through the prophet, saying,
text.WEB: All this was done, that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through the prophet, saying,

text.KJV: Tell ye the daughter of Sion, Behold, thy King cometh unto thee, meek, and sitting upon an ass, and a colt the foal of an ass.
text.ASV: Tell ye the daughter of Zion, Behold, thy King cometh unto thee, Meek, and riding upon an ass, And upon a colt the foal of an ass.
text.WEB: “Tell the daughter of Zion, behold, your King comes to you, humble, and riding on a donkey, on a colt, the foal of a donkey.”

text.KJV: And the disciples went, and did as Jesus commanded them,
text.ASV: And the disciples went, and did even as Jesus appointed them,
text.WEB: The disciples went, and did just as Jesus commanded them,

text.KJV: And brought the ass, and the colt, and put on them their clothes, and they set him thereon.
text.ASV: and brought the ass, and the colt, and put on them their garments; and he sat thereon.
text.WEB: and brought the donkey and the colt, and laid their clothes on them; and he sat on them.

text.KJV: And a very great multitude spread their garments in the way; others cut down branches from the trees, and strawed them in the way.
text.ASV: And the most part of the multitude spread their garments in the way; and others cut branches from the trees, and spread them in the way.
text.WEB: A very great multitude spread their clothes on the road. Others cut branches from the trees, and spread them on the road.

text.KJV: And the multitudes that went before, and that followed, cried, saying, Hosanna to the son of David: Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord; Hosanna in the highest.
text.ASV: And the multitudes that went before him, and that followed, cried, saying, Hosanna to the son of David: Blessed `is' he that cometh in the name of the Lord; Hosanna in the highest.
text.WEB: The multitudes who went in front of him, and those who followed, kept shouting, “Hosanna to the son of David! Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord! Hosanna in the highest!”

text.KJV: And when he was come into Jerusalem, all the city was moved, saying, Who is this?
text.ASV: And when he was come into Jerusalem, all the city was stirred, saying, Who is this?
text.WEB: When he had come into Jerusalem, all the city was stirred up, saying, “Who is this?”

text.KJV: And the multitude said, This is Jesus the prophet of Nazareth of Galilee.
text.ASV: And the multitudes said, This is the prophet, Jesus, from Nazareth of Galilee.
text.WEB: The multitudes said, “This is the prophet, Jesus, from Nazareth of Galilee.”

text.KJV: And Jesus went into the temple of God, and cast out all them that sold and bought in the temple, and overthrew the tables of the moneychangers, and the seats of them that sold doves,
text.ASV: And Jesus entered into the temple of God, and cast out all them that sold and bought in the temple, and overthrew the tables of he money-changers, and the seats of them that sold the doves;
text.WEB: Jesus entered into the temple of God, and drove out all of those who sold and bought in the temple, and overthrew the money changers’ tables and the seats of those who sold the doves.

text.KJV: And said unto them, It is written, My house shall be called the house of prayer; but ye have made it a den of thieves.
text.ASV: and he saith unto them, It is written, My house shall be called a house of prayer: but ye make it a den of robbers.
text.WEB: He said to them, “It is written, ‘My house shall be called a house of prayer,’ but you have made it a den of robbers!”

text.KJV: And the blind and the lame came to him in the temple; and he healed them.
text.ASV: And the blind and the lame came to him in the temple; and he healed them.
text.WEB: The blind and the lame came to him in the temple, and he healed them.

text.KJV: And when the chief priests and scribes saw the wonderful things that he did, and the children crying in the temple, and saying, Hosanna to the son of David; they were sore displeased,
text.ASV: But when the chief priests and the scribes saw the wonderful things that he did, and the children that were crying in the temple and saying, Hosanna to the son of David; they were moved with indignation,
text.WEB: But when the chief priests and the scribes saw the wonderful things that he did, and the children who were crying in the temple and saying, “Hosanna to the son of David!” they were indignant,

text.KJV: And said unto him, Hearest thou what these say? And Jesus saith unto them, Yea; have ye never read, Out of the mouth of babes and sucklings thou hast perfected praise?
text.ASV: and said unto him, Hearest thou what these are saying? And Jesus saith unto them, Yea: did ye never read, Out of the mouth of babes and sucklings thou has perfected praise?
text.WEB: and said to him, “Do you hear what these are saying?” Jesus said to them, “Yes. Did you never read, ‘Out of the mouth of babes and nursing babies you have perfected praise?’”

text.KJV: And he left them, and went out of the city into Bethany; and he lodged there.
text.ASV: And he left them, and went forth out of the city to Bethany, and lodged there.
text.WEB: He left them, and went out of the city to Bethany, and camped there.

text.KJV: Now in the morning as he returned into the city, he hungered.
text.ASV: Now in the morning as he returned to the city, he hungered.
text.WEB: Now in the morning, as he returned to the city, he was hungry.

text.KJV: And when he saw a fig tree in the way, he came to it, and found nothing thereon, but leaves only, and said unto it, Let no fruit grow on thee henceforward for ever. And presently the fig tree withered away.
text.ASV: And seeing a fig tree by the way side, he came to it, and found nothing thereon, but leaves only; and he saith unto it, Let there be no fruit from thee henceforward for ever. And immediately the fig tree withered away.
text.WEB: Seeing a fig tree by the road, he came to it, and found nothing on it but leaves. He said to it, “Let there be no fruit from you forever!” Immediately the fig tree withered away.

text.KJV: And when the disciples saw it, they marvelled, saying, How soon is the fig tree withered away!
text.ASV: And when the disciples saw it, they marvelled, saying, How did the fig tree immediately wither away?
text.WEB: When the disciples saw it, they marveled, saying, “How did the fig tree immediately wither away?”

text.KJV: Jesus answered and said unto them, Verily I say unto you, If ye have faith, and doubt not, ye shall not only do this which is done to the fig tree, but also if ye shall say unto this mountain, Be thou removed, and be thou cast into the sea; it shall be done.
text.ASV: And Jesus answered and said unto them, Verily I say unto you, If ye have faith, and doubt not, ye shall not only do what is done to the fig tree, but even if ye shall say unto this mountain, Be thou taken up and cast into the sea, it shall be done.
text.WEB: Jesus answered them, “Most certainly I tell you, if you have faith, and don’t doubt, you will not only do what was done to the fig tree, but even if you told this mountain, ‘Be taken up and cast into the sea,’ it would be done.

text.KJV: And all things, whatsoever ye shall ask in prayer, believing, ye shall receive.
text.ASV: And all things, whatsoever ye shall ask in prayer, believing, ye shall receive.
text.WEB: All things, whatever you ask in prayer, believing, you will receive.”

text.KJV: And when he was come into the temple, the chief priests and the elders of the people came unto him as he was teaching, and said, By what authority doest thou these things? and who gave thee this authority?
text.ASV: And when he was come into the temple, the chief priests and the elders of the people came unto him as he was teaching, and said, By what authority doest thou these things? and who gave thee this authority?
text.WEB: When he had come into the temple, the chief priests and the elders of the people came to him as he was teaching, and said, “By what authority do you do these things? Who gave you this authority?”

text.KJV: And Jesus answered and said unto them, I also will ask you one thing, which if ye tell me, I in like wise will tell you by what authority I do these things.
text.ASV: And Jesus answered and said unto them, I also will ask you one question, which if ye tell me, I likewise will tell you by what authority I do these things.
text.WEB: Jesus answered them, “I also will ask you one question, which if you tell me, I likewise will tell you by what authority I do these things.

text.KJV: The baptism of John, whence was it? from heaven, or of men? And they reasoned with themselves, saying, If we shall say, From heaven; he will say unto us, Why did ye not then believe him?
text.ASV: The baptism of John, whence was it? from heaven or from men? And they reasoned with themselves, saying, If we shall say, From heaven; he will say unto us, Why then did ye not believe him?
text.WEB: The baptism of John, where was it from? From heaven or from men?” They reasoned with themselves, saying, “If we say, ‘From heaven,’ he will ask us, ‘Why then did you not believe him?’

text.KJV: But if we shall say, Of men; we fear the people; for all hold John as a prophet.
text.ASV: But if we shall say, From men; we fear the multitude; for all hold John as a prophet.
text.WEB: But if we say, ‘From men,’ we fear the multitude, for all hold John as a prophet.”

text.KJV: And they answered Jesus, and said, We cannot tell. And he said unto them, Neither tell I you by what authority I do these things.
text.ASV: And they answered Jesus, and said, We know not. He also said unto them, Neither tell I you by what authority I do these things.
text.WEB: They answered Jesus, and said, “We don’t know.” He also said to them, “Neither will I tell you by what authority I do these things.

text.KJV: But what think ye? A certain man had two sons; and he came to the first, and said, Son, go work to day in my vineyard.
text.ASV: But what think ye? A man had two sons; and he came to the first, and said, Son, go work to-day in the vineyard.
text.WEB: But what do you think? A man had two sons, and he came to the first, and said, ‘Son, go work today in my vineyard.’

text.KJV: He answered and said, I will not: but afterward he repented, and went.
text.ASV: And he answered and said, I will not: but afterward he repented himself, and went.
text.WEB: He answered, ‘I will not,’ but afterward he changed his mind, and went.

text.KJV: And he came to the second, and said likewise. And he answered and said, I go, sir: and went not.
text.ASV: And he came to the second, and said likewise. And he answered and said, I `go', sir: and went not.
text.WEB: He came to the second, and said the same thing. He answered, ‘I’ m going, sir,’ but he didn’t go.

text.KJV: Whether of them twain did the will of his father? They say unto him, The first. Jesus saith unto them, Verily I say unto you, That the publicans and the harlots go into the kingdom of God before you.
text.ASV: Which of the two did the will of his father? They say, The first. Jesus saith unto them, Verily I say unto you, that the publicans and the harlots go into the kingdom of God before you.
text.WEB: Which of the two did the will of his father?” They said to him, “The first.” Jesus said to them, “Most certainly I tell you that the tax collectors and the prostitutes are entering into God’s Kingdom before you.

text.KJV: For John came unto you in the way of righteousness, and ye believed him not: but the publicans and the harlots believed him: and ye, when ye had seen it, repented not afterward, that ye might believe him.
text.ASV: For John came unto you in the way of righteousness, and ye believed him not; but the publicans and the harlots believed him: and ye, when ye saw it, did not even repent yourselves afterward, that ye might believe him.
text.WEB: For John came to you in the way of righteousness, and you didn’t believe him, but the tax collectors and the prostitutes believed him. When you saw it, you didn’t even repent afterward, that you might believe him.

text.KJV: Hear another parable: There was a certain householder, which planted a vineyard, and hedged it round about, and digged a winepress in it, and built a tower, and let it out to husbandmen, and went into a far country:
text.ASV: Hear another parable: There was a man that was a householder, who planted a vineyard, and set a hedge about it, and digged a winepress in it, and built a tower, and let it out to husbandmen, and went into another country.
text.WEB: “Hear another parable. There was a man who was a master of a household, who planted a vineyard, set a hedge about it, dug a wine press in it, built a tower, leased it out to farmers, and went into another country.

text.KJV: And when the time of the fruit drew near, he sent his servants to the husbandmen, that they might receive the fruits of it.
text.ASV: And when the season of the fruits drew near, he sent his servants to the husbandmen, to receive his fruits.
text.WEB: When the season for the fruit came near, he sent his servants to the farmers, to receive his fruit.

text.KJV: And the husbandmen took his servants, and beat one, and killed another, and stoned another.
text.ASV: And the husbandmen took his servants, and beat one, and killed another, and stoned another.
text.WEB: The farmers took his servants, beat one, killed another, and stoned another.

text.KJV: Again, he sent other servants more than the first: and they did unto them likewise.
text.ASV: Again, he sent other servants more than the first: and they did unto them in like manner.
text.WEB: Again, he sent other servants more than the first: and they treated them the same way.

text.KJV: But last of all he sent unto them his son, saying, They will reverence my son.
text.ASV: But afterward he sent unto them his son, saying, They will reverence my son.
text.WEB: But afterward he sent to them his son, saying, ‘They will respect my son.’

text.KJV: But when the husbandmen saw the son, they said among themselves, This is the heir; come, let us kill him, and let us seize on his inheritance.
text.ASV: But the husbandmen, when they saw the son, said among themselves, This is the heir; come, let us kill him, and take his inheritance.
text.WEB: But the farmers, when they saw the son, said among themselves, ‘This is the heir. Come, let’s kill him, and seize his inheritance.’

text.KJV: And they caught him, and cast him out of the vineyard, and slew him.
text.ASV: And they took him, and cast him forth out of the vineyard, and killed him.
text.WEB: So they took him, and threw him out of the vineyard, and killed him.

text.KJV: When the lord therefore of the vineyard cometh, what will he do unto those husbandmen?
text.ASV: When therefore the lord of the vineyard shall come, what will he do unto those husbandmen?
text.WEB: When therefore the lord of the vineyard comes, what will he do to those farmers?”

text.KJV: They say unto him, He will miserably destroy those wicked men, and will let out his vineyard unto other husbandmen, which shall render him the fruits in their seasons.
text.ASV: They say unto him, He will miserably destroy those miserable men, and will let out the vineyard unto other husbandmen, who shall render him the fruits in their seasons.
text.WEB: They told him, “He will miserably destroy those miserable men, and will lease out the vineyard to other farmers, who will give him the fruit in its season.”

text.KJV: Jesus saith unto them, Did ye never read in the scriptures, The stone which the builders rejected, the same is become the head of the corner: this is the Lord's doing, and it is marvellous in our eyes?
text.ASV: Jesus saith unto them, Did ye never read in the scriptures, The stone which the builders rejected, The same was made the head of the corner; This was from the Lord, And it is marvelous in our eyes?
text.WEB: Jesus said to them, “Did you never read in the Scriptures, ‘The stone which the builders rejected, the same was made the head of the corner. This was from the Lord. It is marvelous in our eyes?’

text.KJV: Therefore say I unto you, The kingdom of God shall be taken from you, and given to a nation bringing forth the fruits thereof.
text.ASV: Therefore say I unto you, The kingdom of God shall be taken away from you, and shall be given to a nation bringing forth the fruits thereof.
text.WEB: “Therefore I tell you, God’s Kingdom will be taken away from you, and will be given to a nation producing its fruit.

text.KJV: And whosoever shall fall on this stone shall be broken: but on whomsoever it shall fall, it will grind him to powder.
text.ASV: And he that falleth on this stone shall be broken to pieces: but on whomsoever it shall fall, it will scatter him as dust.
text.WEB: He who falls on this stone will be broken to pieces, but on whomever it will fall, it will scatter him as dust.”

text.KJV: And when the chief priests and Pharisees had heard his parables, they perceived that he spake of them.
text.ASV: And when the chief priests and the Pharisees heard his parables, they perceived that he spake of them.
text.WEB: When the chief priests and the Pharisees heard his parables, they perceived that he spoke about them.

text.KJV: But when they sought to lay hands on him, they feared the multitude, because they took him for a prophet.
text.ASV: And when they sought to lay hold on him, they feared the multitudes, because they took him for a prophet.
text.WEB: When they sought to seize him, they feared the multitudes, because they considered him to be a prophet.

text.KJV: And Jesus answered and spake unto them again by parables, and said,
text.ASV: And Jesus answered and spake again in parables unto them, saying,
text.WEB: Jesus answered and spoke to them again in parables, saying,

text.KJV: The kingdom of heaven is like unto a certain king, which made a marriage for his son,
text.ASV: The kingdom of heaven is likened unto a certain king, who made a marriage feast for his son,
text.WEB: “The Kingdom of Heaven is like a certain king, who made a marriage feast for his son,

text.KJV: And sent forth his servants to call them that were bidden to the wedding: and they would not come.
text.ASV: and sent forth his servants to call them that were bidden to the marriage feast: and they would not come.
text.WEB: and sent out his servants to call those who were invited to the marriage feast, but they would not come.

text.KJV: Again, he sent forth other servants, saying, Tell them which are bidden, Behold, I have prepared my dinner: my oxen and my fatlings are killed, and all things are ready: come unto the marriage.
text.ASV: Again he sent forth other servants, saying, Tell them that are bidden, Behold, I have made ready my dinner; my oxen and my fatlings are killed, and all things are ready: come to the marriage feast.
text.WEB: Again he sent out other servants, saying, ‘Tell those who are invited, “Behold, I have prepared my dinner. My cattle and my fatlings are killed, and all things are ready. Come to the marriage feast!”’

text.KJV: But they made light of it, and went their ways, one to his farm, another to his merchandise:
text.ASV: But they made light of it, and went their ways, one to his own farm, another to his merchandise;
text.WEB: But they made light of it, and went their ways, one to his own farm, another to his merchandise,

text.KJV: And the remnant took his servants, and entreated them spitefully, and slew them.
text.ASV: and the rest laid hold on his servants, and treated them shamefully, and killed them.
text.WEB: and the rest grabbed his servants, and treated them shamefully, and killed them.

text.KJV: But when the king heard thereof, he was wroth: and he sent forth his armies, and destroyed those murderers, and burned up their city.
text.ASV: But the king was wroth; and he sent his armies, and destroyed those murderers, and burned their city.
text.WEB: When the king heard that, he was angry, and sent his armies, destroyed those murderers, and burned their city.

text.KJV: Then saith he to his servants, The wedding is ready, but they which were bidden were not worthy.
text.ASV: Then saith he to his servants, The wedding is ready, but they that were bidden were not worthy.
text.WEB: “Then he said to his servants, ‘The wedding is ready, but those who were invited weren’t worthy.

text.KJV: Go ye therefore into the highways, and as many as ye shall find, bid to the marriage.
text.ASV: Go ye therefore unto the partings of the highways, and as many as ye shall find, bid to the marriage feast.
text.WEB: Go therefore to the intersections of the highways, and as many as you may find, invite to the marriage feast.’

text.KJV: So those servants went out into the highways, and gathered together all as many as they found, both bad and good: and the wedding was furnished with guests.
text.ASV: And those servants went out into the highways, and gathered together all as many as they found, both bad and good: and the wedding was filled with guests.
text.WEB: Those servants went out into the highways, and gathered together as many as they found, both bad and good. The wedding was filled with guests.

text.KJV: And when the king came in to see the guests, he saw there a man which had not on a wedding garment:
text.ASV: But when the king came in to behold the guests, he saw there a man who had not on a wedding-garment:
text.WEB: But when the king came in to see the guests, he saw there a man who didn’t have on wedding clothing,

text.KJV: And he saith unto him, Friend, how camest thou in hither not having a wedding garment? And he was speechless.
text.ASV: and he saith unto him, Friend, how camest thou in hither not having a wedding-garment? And he was speechless.
text.WEB: and he said to him, ‘Friend, how did you come in here not wearing wedding clothing?’ He was speechless.

text.KJV: Then said the king to the servants, Bind him hand and foot, and take him away, and cast him into outer darkness, there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
text.ASV: Then the king said to the servants, Bind him hand and foot, and cast him out into the outer darkness; there shall be the weeping and the gnashing of teeth.
text.WEB: Then the king said to the servants, ‘Bind him hand and foot, take him away, and throw him into the outer darkness. That is where the weeping and grinding of teeth will be.’

text.KJV: For many are called, but few are chosen.
text.ASV: For many are called, but few chosen.
text.WEB: For many are called, but few chosen.”

text.KJV: Then went the Pharisees, and took counsel how they might entangle him in his talk.
text.ASV: Then went the Pharisees, and took counsel how they might ensnare him in `his' talk.
text.WEB: Then the Pharisees went and took counsel how they might entrap him in his talk.

text.KJV: And they sent out unto him their disciples with the Herodians, saying, Master, we know that thou art true, and teachest the way of God in truth, neither carest thou for any man: for thou regardest not the person of men.
text.ASV: And they send to him their disciples, with the Herodians, saying, Teacher, we know that thou art true, and teachest the way of God in truth, and carest not for any one: for thou regardest not the person of men.
text.WEB: They sent their disciples to him, along with the Herodians, saying, “Teacher, we know that you are honest, and teach the way of God in truth, no matter whom you teach, for you aren’t partial to anyone.

text.KJV: Tell us therefore, What thinkest thou? Is it lawful to give tribute unto Caesar, or not?
text.ASV: Tell us therefore, What thinkest thou? Is it lawful to give tribute unto Caesar, or not?
text.WEB: Tell us therefore, what do you think? Is it lawful to pay taxes to Caesar, or not?”

text.KJV: But Jesus perceived their wickedness, and said, Why tempt ye me, ye hypocrites?
text.ASV: But Jesus perceived their wickedness, and said, Why make ye trial of me, ye hypocrites?
text.WEB: But Jesus perceived their wickedness, and said, “Why do you test me, you hypocrites?

text.KJV: Shew me the tribute money. And they brought unto him a penny.
text.ASV: Show me the tribute money. And they brought unto him a denarius.
text.WEB: Show me the tax money.” They brought to him a denarius.

text.KJV: And he saith unto them, Whose is this image and superscription?
text.ASV: And he saith unto them, Whose is this image and superscription?
text.WEB: He asked them, “Whose is this image and inscription?”

text.KJV: They say unto him, Caesar's. Then saith he unto them, Render therefore unto Caesar the things which are Caesar's; and unto God the things that are God's.
text.ASV: They say unto him, Caesar's. Then saith he unto them, Render therefore unto Caesar the things that are Caesar's; and unto God the things that are God's.
text.WEB: They said to him, “Caesar’s.” Then he said to them, “Give therefore to Caesar the things that are Caesar’s, and to God the things that are God’s.”

text.KJV: When they had heard these words, they marvelled, and left him, and went their way.
text.ASV: And when they heard it, they marvelled, and left him, and went away.
text.WEB: When they heard it, they marveled, and left him, and went away.

text.KJV: The same day came to him the Sadducees, which say that there is no resurrection, and asked him,
text.ASV: On that day there came to him Sadducees, they that say that there is no resurrection: and they asked him,
text.WEB: On that day Sadducees (those who say that there is no resurrection) came to him. They asked him,

text.KJV: Saying, Master, Moses said, If a man die, having no children, his brother shall marry his wife, and raise up seed unto his brother.
text.ASV: saying, Teacher, Moses said, If a man die, having no children, his brother shall marry his wife, and raise up seed unto his brother.
text.WEB: saying, “Teacher, Moses said, ‘If a man dies, having no children, his brother shall marry his wife, and raise up offspring for his brother.’

text.KJV: Now there were with us seven brethren: and the first, when he had married a wife, deceased, and, having no issue, left his wife unto his brother:
text.ASV: Now there were with us seven brethren: and the first married and deceased, and having no seed left his wife unto his brother;
text.WEB: Now there were with us seven brothers. The first married and died, and having no offspring left his wife to his brother.

text.KJV: Likewise the second also, and the third, unto the seventh.
text.ASV: in like manner the second also, and the third, unto the seventh.
text.WEB: In the same way, the second also, and the third, to the seventh.

text.KJV: And last of all the woman died also.
text.ASV: And after them all, the woman died.
text.WEB: After them all, the woman died.

text.KJV: Therefore in the resurrection whose wife shall she be of the seven? for they all had her.
text.ASV: In the resurrection therefore whose wife shall she be of the seven? for they all had her.
text.WEB: In the resurrection therefore, whose wife will she be of the seven? For they all had her.”

text.KJV: Jesus answered and said unto them, Ye do err, not knowing the scriptures, nor the power of God.
text.ASV: But Jesus answered and said unto them, Ye do err, not knowing the scriptures, nor the power of God.
text.WEB: But Jesus answered them, “You are mistaken, not knowing the Scriptures, nor the power of God.

text.KJV: For in the resurrection they neither marry, nor are given in marriage, but are as the angels of God in heaven.
text.ASV: For in the resurrection they neither marry, nor are given in marriage, but are as angels in heaven.
text.WEB: For in the resurrection they neither marry, nor are given in marriage, but are like God’s angels in heaven.

text.KJV: But as touching the resurrection of the dead, have ye not read that which was spoken unto you by God, saying,
text.ASV: But as touching the resurrection of the dead, have ye not read that which was spoken unto you by God, saying,
text.WEB: But concerning the resurrection of the dead, haven’t you read that which was spoken to you by God, saying,

text.KJV: I am the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob? God is not the God of the dead, but of the living.
text.ASV: I am the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob? God is not `the God' of the dead, but of the living.
text.WEB: ‘I am the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob?’ God is not the God of the dead, but of the living.”

text.KJV: And when the multitude heard this, they were astonished at his doctrine.
text.ASV: And when the multitudes heard it, they were astonished at his teaching.
text.WEB: When the multitudes heard it, they were astonished at his teaching.

text.KJV: But when the Pharisees had heard that he had put the Sadducees to silence, they were gathered together.
text.ASV: But the Pharisees, when they heard that he had put the Sadducees to silence, gathered themselves together.
text.WEB: But the Pharisees, when they heard that he had silenced the Sadducees, gathered themselves together.

text.KJV: Then one of them, which was a lawyer, asked him a question, tempting him, and saying,
text.ASV: And one of them, a lawyer, asked him a question, trying him:
text.WEB: One of them, a lawyer, asked him a question, testing him.

text.KJV: Master, which is the great commandment in the law?
text.ASV: Teacher, which is the great commandment in the law?
text.WEB: “Teacher, which is the greatest commandment in the law?”

text.KJV: Jesus said unto him, Thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy mind.
text.ASV: And he said unto him, Thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy mind.
text.WEB: Jesus said to him, “‘You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, with all your soul, and with all your mind.’

text.KJV: This is the first and great commandment.
text.ASV: This is the great and first commandment.
text.WEB: This is the first and great commandment.

text.KJV: And the second is like unto it, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.
text.ASV: And a second like `unto it' is this, Thou shalt love thy neighbor as thyself.
text.WEB: A second likewise is this, ‘You shall love your neighbor as yourself.’

text.KJV: On these two commandments hang all the law and the prophets.
text.ASV: On these two commandments the whole law hangeth, and the prophets.
text.WEB: The whole law and the prophets depend on these two commandments.”

text.KJV: While the Pharisees were gathered together, Jesus asked them,
text.ASV: Now while the Pharisees were gathered together, Jesus asked them a question,
text.WEB: Now while the Pharisees were gathered together, Jesus asked them a question,

text.KJV: Saying, What think ye of Christ? whose son is he? They say unto him, The son of David.
text.ASV: saying, What think ye of the Christ? whose son is he? They say unto him, `The son' of David.
text.WEB: saying, “What do you think of the Christ? Whose son is he?” They said to him, “Of David.”

text.KJV: He saith unto them, How then doth David in spirit call him Lord, saying,
text.ASV: He saith unto them, How then doth David in the Spirit call him Lord, saying,
text.WEB: He said to them, “How then does David in the Spirit call him Lord, saying,

text.KJV: The LORD said unto my Lord, Sit thou on my right hand, till I make thine enemies thy footstool?
text.ASV: The Lord said unto my Lord, Sit thou on my right hand, Till I put thine enemies underneath thy feet?
text.WEB: ‘The Lord said to my Lord, sit on my right hand, until I make your enemies a footstool for your feet?’

text.KJV: If David then call him Lord, how is he his son?
text.ASV: If David then calleth him Lord, how is he his son?
text.WEB: “If then David calls him Lord, how is he his son?”

text.KJV: And no man was able to answer him a word, neither durst any man from that day forth ask him any more questions.
text.ASV: And no one was able to answer him a word, neither durst any man from that day forth ask him any more questions.
text.WEB: No one was able to answer him a word, neither did any man dare ask him any more questions from that day forward.

text.KJV: Then spake Jesus to the multitude, and to his disciples,
text.ASV: Then spake Jesus to the multitudes and to his disciples,
text.WEB: Then Jesus spoke to the multitudes and to his disciples,

text.KJV: Saying The scribes and the Pharisees sit in Moses' seat:
text.ASV: saying, The scribes and the Pharisees sit on Moses seat:
text.WEB: saying, “The scribes and the Pharisees sat on Moses’ seat.

text.KJV: All therefore whatsoever they bid you observe, that observe and do; but do not ye after their works: for they say, and do not.
text.ASV: all things therefore whatsoever they bid you, `these' do and observe: but do not ye after their works; for they say, and do not.
text.WEB: All things therefore whatever they tell you to observe, observe and do, but don’t do their works; for they say, and don’t do.

text.KJV: For they bind heavy burdens and grievous to be borne, and lay them on men's shoulders; but they themselves will not move them with one of their fingers.
text.ASV: Yea, they bind heavy burdens and grievous to be borne, and lay them on men's shoulders; but they themselves will not move them with their finger.
text.WEB: For they bind heavy burdens that are grievous to be borne, and lay them on men’s shoulders; but they themselves will not lift a finger to help them.

text.KJV: But all their works they do for to be seen of men: they make broad their phylacteries, and enlarge the borders of their garments,
text.ASV: But all their works they do to be seen of men: for they make broad their phylacteries, and enlarge the borders `of their garments',
text.WEB: But all their works they do to be seen by men. They make their phylacteries broad, enlarge the fringes of their garments,

text.KJV: And love the uppermost rooms at feasts, and the chief seats in the synagogues,
text.ASV: and love the chief place at feasts, and the chief seats in the synagogues,
text.WEB: and love the place of honor at feasts, the best seats in the synagogues,

text.KJV: And greetings in the markets, and to be called of men, Rabbi, Rabbi.
text.ASV: and the salutations in the marketplaces, and to be called of men, Rabbi.
text.WEB: the salutations in the marketplaces, and to be called ‘Rabbi, Rabbi’ by men.

text.KJV: But be not ye called Rabbi: for one is your Master, even Christ; and all ye are brethren.
text.ASV: But be not ye called Rabbi: for one is your teacher, and all ye are brethren.
text.WEB: But don’t you be called ‘Rabbi,’ for one is your teacher, the Christ, and all of you are brothers.

text.KJV: And call no man your father upon the earth: for one is your Father, which is in heaven.
text.ASV: And call no man your father on the earth: for one is your Father, `even' he who is in heaven.
text.WEB: Call no man on the earth your father, for one is your Father, he who is in heaven.

text.KJV: Neither be ye called masters: for one is your Master, even Christ.
text.ASV: Neither be ye called masters: for one is your master, `even' the Christ.
text.WEB: Neither be called masters, for one is your master, the Christ.

text.KJV: But he that is greatest among you shall be your servant.
text.ASV: But he that is greatest among you shall be your servant.
text.WEB: But he who is greatest among you will be your servant.

text.KJV: And whosoever shall exalt himself shall be abased; and he that shall humble himself shall be exalted.
text.ASV: And whosoever shall exalt himself shall be humbled; and whosoever shall humble himself shall be exalted.
text.WEB: Whoever exalts himself will be humbled, and whoever humbles himself will be exalted.

text.KJV: But woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye shut up the kingdom of heaven against men: for ye neither go in yourselves, neither suffer ye them that are entering to go in.
text.ASV: But woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! because ye shut the kingdom of heaven against men: for ye enter not in yourselves, neither suffer ye them that are entering in to enter.
text.WEB: “Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you devour widows’ houses, and as a pretense you make long prayers. Therefore you will receive greater condemnation.

text.KJV: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye devour widows' houses, and for a pretence make long prayer: therefore ye shall receive the greater damnation.
text.ASV: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye devour widows' houses, even while for a pretence ye make long prayers: therefore ye shall receive greater condemnation.
text.WEB: “But woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! Because you shut up the Kingdom of Heaven against men; for you don’t enter in yourselves, neither do you allow those who are entering in to enter.

text.KJV: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye compass sea and land to make one proselyte, and when he is made, ye make him twofold more the child of hell than yourselves.
text.ASV: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye compass sea and land to make one proselyte; and when he is become so, ye make him twofold more a son of hell than yourselves.
text.WEB: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you travel around by sea and land to make one proselyte; and when he becomes one, you make him twice as much a son of Gehenna as yourselves.

text.KJV: Woe unto you, ye blind guides, which say, Whosoever shall swear by the temple, it is nothing; but whosoever shall swear by the gold of the temple, he is a debtor!
text.ASV: Woe unto you, ye blind guides, that say, Whosoever shall swear by the temple, it is nothing; but whosoever shall swear by the gold of the temple, he is a debtor.
text.WEB: “Woe to you, you blind guides, who say, ‘Whoever swears by the temple, it is nothing; but whoever swears by the gold of the temple, he is obligated.’

text.KJV: Ye fools and blind: for whether is greater, the gold, or the temple that sanctifieth the gold?
text.ASV: Ye fools and blind: for which is greater, the gold, or the temple that hath sanctified the gold?
text.WEB: You blind fools! For which is greater, the gold, or the temple that sanctifies the gold?

text.KJV: And, Whosoever shall swear by the altar, it is nothing; but whosoever sweareth by the gift that is upon it, he is guilty.
text.ASV: And, Whosoever shall swear by the altar, it is nothing; but whosoever shall swear by the gift that is upon it, he is a debtor.
text.WEB: ‘Whoever swears by the altar, it is nothing; but whoever swears by the gift that is on it, he is obligated?’

text.KJV: Ye fools and blind: for whether is greater, the gift, or the altar that sanctifieth the gift?
text.ASV: Ye blind: for which is greater, the gift, or the altar that sanctifieth the gift?
text.WEB: You blind fools! For which is greater, the gift, or the altar that sanctifies the gift?

text.KJV: Whoso therefore shall swear by the altar, sweareth by it, and by all things thereon.
text.ASV: He therefore that sweareth by the altar, sweareth by it, and by all things thereon.
text.WEB: He therefore who swears by the altar, swears by it, and by everything on it.

text.KJV: And whoso shall swear by the temple, sweareth by it, and by him that dwelleth therein.
text.ASV: And he that sweareth by the temple, sweareth by it, and by him that dwelleth therein.
text.WEB: He who swears by the temple, swears by it, and by him who has been living in it.

text.KJV: And he that shall swear by heaven, sweareth by the throne of God, and by him that sitteth thereon.
text.ASV: And he that sweareth by the heaven, sweareth by the throne of God, and by him that sitteth thereon.
text.WEB: He who swears by heaven, swears by the throne of God, and by him who sits on it.

text.KJV: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye pay tithe of mint and anise and cummin, and have omitted the weightier matters of the law, judgment, mercy, and faith: these ought ye to have done, and not to leave the other undone.
text.ASV: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye tithe mint and anise and cummin, and have left undone the weightier matters of the law, justice, and mercy, and faith: but these ye ought to have done, and not to have left the other undone.
text.WEB: “Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you tithe mint, dill, and cumin, and have left undone the weightier matters of the law: justice, mercy, and faith. But you ought to have done these, and not to have left the other undone.

text.KJV: Ye blind guides, which strain at a gnat, and swallow a camel.
text.ASV: Ye blind guides, that strain out the gnat, and swallow the camel!
text.WEB: You blind guides, who strain out a gnat, and swallow a camel!

text.KJV: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye make clean the outside of the cup and of the platter, but within they are full of extortion and excess.
text.ASV: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye cleanse the outside of the cup and of the platter, but within they are full from extortion and excess.
text.WEB: “Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you clean the outside of the cup and of the platter, but within they are full of extortion and unrighteousness.

text.KJV: Thou blind Pharisee, cleanse first that which is within the cup and platter, that the outside of them may be clean also.
text.ASV: Thou blind Pharisee, cleanse first the inside of the cup and of the platter, that the outside thereof may become clean also.
text.WEB: You blind Pharisee, first clean the inside of the cup and of the platter, that its outside may become clean also.

text.KJV: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye are like unto whited sepulchres, which indeed appear beautiful outward, but are within full of dead men's bones, and of all uncleanness.
text.ASV: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye are like unto whited sepulchres, which outwardly appear beautiful, but inwardly are full of dead men's bones, and of all uncleanness.
text.WEB: “Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you are like whitened tombs, which outwardly appear beautiful, but inwardly are full of dead men’s bones, and of all uncleanness.

text.KJV: Even so ye also outwardly appear righteous unto men, but within ye are full of hypocrisy and iniquity.
text.ASV: Even so ye also outwardly appear righteous unto men, but inwardly ye are full of hypocrisy and iniquity.
text.WEB: Even so you also outwardly appear righteous to men, but inwardly you are full of hypocrisy and iniquity.

text.KJV: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! because ye build the tombs of the prophets, and garnish the sepulchres of the righteous,
text.ASV: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye build the sepulchres of the prophets, and garnish the tombs of the righteous,
text.WEB: “Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you build the tombs of the prophets, and decorate the tombs of the righteous,

text.KJV: And say, If we had been in the days of our fathers, we would not have been partakers with them in the blood of the prophets.
text.ASV: and say, If we had been in the days of our fathers, we should not have been partakers with them in the blood of the prophets.
text.WEB: and say, ‘If we had lived in the days of our fathers, we wouldn’t have been partakers with them in the blood of the prophets.’

text.KJV: Wherefore ye be witnesses unto yourselves, that ye are the children of them which killed the prophets.
text.ASV: Wherefore ye witness to yourselves, that ye are sons of them that slew the prophets.
text.WEB: Therefore you testify to yourselves that you are children of those who killed the prophets.

text.KJV: Fill ye up then the measure of your fathers.
text.ASV: Fill ye up then the measure of your fathers.
text.WEB: Fill up, then, the measure of your fathers.

text.KJV: Ye serpents, ye generation of vipers, how can ye escape the damnation of hell?
text.ASV: Ye serpents, ye offspring of vipers, how shall ye escape the judgment of hell?
text.WEB: You serpents, you offspring of vipers, how will you escape the judgment of Gehenna?

text.KJV: Wherefore, behold, I send unto you prophets, and wise men, and scribes: and some of them ye shall kill and crucify; and some of them shall ye scourge in your synagogues, and persecute them from city to city:
text.ASV: Therefore, behold, I send unto you prophets, and wise men, and scribes: some of them shall ye kill and crucify; and some of them shall ye scourge in your synagogues, and persecute from city to city:
text.WEB: Therefore behold, I send to you prophets, wise men, and scribes. Some of them you will kill and crucify; and some of them you will scourge in your synagogues, and persecute from city to city;

text.KJV: That upon you may come all the righteous blood shed upon the earth, from the blood of righteous Abel unto the blood of Zacharias son of Barachias, whom ye slew between the temple and the altar.
text.ASV: that upon you may come all the righteous blood shed on the earth, from the blood of Abel the righteous unto the blood of Zachariah son of Barachiah, whom ye slew between the sanctuary and the altar.
text.WEB: that on you may come all the righteous blood shed on the earth, from the blood of righteous Abel to the blood of Zachariah son of Barachiah, whom you killed between the sanctuary and the altar.

text.KJV: Verily I say unto you, All these things shall come upon this generation.
text.ASV: Verily I say unto you, All these things shall come upon this generation.
text.WEB: Most certainly I tell you, all these things will come upon this generation.

text.KJV: O Jerusalem, Jerusalem, thou that killest the prophets, and stonest them which are sent unto thee, how often would I have gathered thy children together, even as a hen gathereth her chickens under her wings, and ye would not!
text.ASV: O Jerusalem, Jerusalem, that killeth the prophets, and stoneth them that are sent unto her! how often would I have gathered thy children together, even as a hen gathereth her chickens under her wings, and ye would not!
text.WEB: “Jerusalem, Jerusalem, who kills the prophets, and stones those who are sent to her! How often I would have gathered your children together, even as a hen gathers her chicks under her wings, and you would not!

text.KJV: Behold, your house is left unto you desolate.
text.ASV: Behold, your house is left unto you desolate.
text.WEB: Behold, your house is left to you desolate.

text.KJV: For I say unto you, Ye shall not see me henceforth, till ye shall say, Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord.
text.ASV: For I say unto you, Ye shall not see me henceforth, till ye shall say, Blessed `is' he that cometh in the name of the Lord.
text.WEB: For I tell you, you will not see me from now on, until you say, ‘Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord!’”

text.KJV: And Jesus went out, and departed from the temple: and his disciples came to him for to shew him the buildings of the temple.
text.ASV: And Jesus went out from the temple, and was going on his way; and his disciples came to him to show him the buildings of the temple.
text.WEB: Jesus went out from the temple, and was going on his way. His disciples came to him to show him the buildings of the temple.

text.KJV: And Jesus said unto them, See ye not all these things? verily I say unto you, There shall not be left here one stone upon another, that shall not be thrown down.
text.ASV: But he answered and said unto them, See ye not all these things? verily I say unto you, There shall not be left here one stone upon another, that shall not be thrown down.
text.WEB: But he answered them, “You see all of these things, don’t you? Most certainly I tell you, there will not be left here one stone on another, that will not be thrown down.”

text.KJV: And as he sat upon the mount of Olives, the disciples came unto him privately, saying, Tell us, when shall these things be? and what shall be the sign of thy coming, and of the end of the world?
text.ASV: And as he sat on the mount of Olives, the disciples came unto him privately, saying, Tell us, when shall these things be? and what `shall be' the sign of thy coming, and of the end of the world?
text.WEB: As he sat on the Mount of Olives, the disciples came to him privately, saying, “Tell us, when will these things be? What is the sign of your coming, and of the end of the age?”

text.KJV: And Jesus answered and said unto them, Take heed that no man deceive you.
text.ASV: And Jesus answered and said unto them, Take heed that no man lead you astray.
text.WEB: Jesus answered them, “Be careful that no one leads you astray.

text.KJV: For many shall come in my name, saying, I am Christ; and shall deceive many.
text.ASV: For many shall come in my name, saying, I am the Christ; and shall lead many astray.
text.WEB: For many will come in my name, saying, ‘I am the Christ,’ and will lead many astray.

text.KJV: And ye shall hear of wars and rumours of wars: see that ye be not troubled: for all these things must come to pass, but the end is not yet.
text.ASV: And ye shall hear of wars and rumors of wars; see that ye be not troubled: for `these things' must needs come to pass; but the end is not yet.
text.WEB: You will hear of wars and rumors of wars. See that you aren’t troubled, for all this must happen, but the end is not yet.

text.KJV: For nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom: and there shall be famines, and pestilences, and earthquakes, in divers places.
text.ASV: For nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom; and there shall be famines and earthquakes in divers places.
text.WEB: For nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom; and there will be famines, plagues, and earthquakes in various places.

text.KJV: All these are the beginning of sorrows.
text.ASV: But all these things are the beginning of travail.
text.WEB: But all these things are the beginning of birth pains.

text.KJV: Then shall they deliver you up to be afflicted, and shall kill you: and ye shall be hated of all nations for my name's sake.
text.ASV: Then shall they deliver you up unto tribulation, and shall kill you: and ye shall be hated of all the nations for my name's sake.
text.WEB: Then they will deliver you up to oppression, and will kill you. You will be hated by all of the nations for my name’s sake.

text.KJV: And then shall many be offended, and shall betray one another, and shall hate one another.
text.ASV: And then shall many stumble, and shall deliver up one another, and shall hate one another.
text.WEB: Then many will stumble, and will deliver up one another, and will hate one another.

text.KJV: And many false prophets shall rise, and shall deceive many.
text.ASV: And many false prophets shall arise, and shall lead many astray.
text.WEB: Many false prophets will arise, and will lead many astray.

text.KJV: And because iniquity shall abound, the love of many shall wax cold.
text.ASV: And because iniquity shall be multiplied, the love of the many shall wax cold.
text.WEB: Because iniquity will be multiplied, the love of many will grow cold.

text.KJV: But he that shall endure unto the end, the same shall be saved.
text.ASV: But he that endureth to the end, the same shall be saved.
text.WEB: But he who endures to the end, the same will be saved.

text.KJV: And this gospel of the kingdom shall be preached in all the world for a witness unto all nations; and then shall the end come.
text.ASV: And this gospel of the kingdom shall be preached in the whole world for a testimony unto all the nations; and then shall the end come.
text.WEB: This Good News of the Kingdom will be preached in the whole world for a testimony to all the nations, and then the end will come.

text.KJV: When ye therefore shall see the abomination of desolation, spoken of by Daniel the prophet, stand in the holy place, (whoso readeth, let him understand:)
text.ASV: When therefore ye see the abomination of desolation, which was spoken of through Daniel the prophet, standing in the holy place (let him that readeth understand),
text.WEB: “When, therefore, you see the abomination of desolation, ; ; which was spoken of through Daniel the prophet, standing in the holy place (let the reader understand),

text.KJV: Then let them which be in Judaea flee into the mountains:
text.ASV: then let them that are in Judaea flee unto the mountains:
text.WEB: then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains.

text.KJV: Let him which is on the housetop not come down to take any thing out of his house:
text.ASV: let him that is on the housetop not go down to take out things that are in his house:
text.WEB: Let him who is on the housetop not go down to take out the things that are in his house.

text.KJV: Neither let him which is in the field return back to take his clothes.
text.ASV: and let him that is in the field not return back to take his cloak.
text.WEB: Let him who is in the field not return back to get his clothes.

text.KJV: And woe unto them that are with child, and to them that give suck in those days!
text.ASV: But woe unto them that are with child and to them that give suck in those days!
text.WEB: But woe to those who are with child and to nursing mothers in those days!

text.KJV: But pray ye that your flight be not in the winter, neither on the sabbath day:
text.ASV: And pray ye that your flight be not in the winter, neither on a sabbath:
text.WEB: Pray that your flight will not be in the winter, nor on a Sabbath,

text.KJV: For then shall be great tribulation, such as was not since the beginning of the world to this time, no, nor ever shall be.
text.ASV: for then shall be great tribulation, such as hath not been from the beginning of the world until now, no, nor ever shall be.
text.WEB: for then there will be great oppression, such as has not been from the beginning of the world until now, no, nor ever will be.

text.KJV: And except those days should be shortened, there should no flesh be saved: but for the elect's sake those days shall be shortened.
text.ASV: And except those days had been shortened, no flesh would have been saved: but for the elect's sake those days shall be shortened.
text.WEB: Unless those days had been shortened, no flesh would have been saved. But for the sake of the chosen ones, those days will be shortened.

text.KJV: Then if any man shall say unto you, Lo, here is Christ, or there; believe it not.
text.ASV: Then if any man shall say unto you, Lo, here is the Christ, or, Here; believe `it' not.
text.WEB: “Then if any man tells you, ‘Behold, here is the Christ,’ or, ‘There,’ don’t believe it.

text.KJV: For there shall arise false Christs, and false prophets, and shall shew great signs and wonders; insomuch that, if it were possible, they shall deceive the very elect.
text.ASV: For there shall arise false Christs, and false prophets, and shall show great signs and wonders; so as to lead astray, if possible, even the elect.
text.WEB: For there will arise false christs, and false prophets, and they will show great signs and wonders, so as to lead astray, if possible, even the chosen ones.

text.KJV: Behold, I have told you before.
text.ASV: Behold, I have told you beforehand.
text.WEB: “Behold, I have told you beforehand.

text.KJV: Wherefore if they shall say unto you, Behold, he is in the desert; go not forth: behold, he is in the secret chambers; believe it not.
text.ASV: If therefore they shall say unto you, Behold, he is in the wilderness; go not forth: Behold, he is in the inner chambers; believe `it' not.
text.WEB: If therefore they tell you, ‘Behold, he is in the wilderness,’ don’t go out; ‘Behold, he is in the inner rooms,’ don’t believe it.

text.KJV: For as the lightning cometh out of the east, and shineth even unto the west; so shall also the coming of the Son of man be.
text.ASV: For as the lightning cometh forth from the east, and is seen even unto the west; so shall be the coming of the Son of man.
text.WEB: For as the lightning flashes from the east, and is seen even to the west, so will be the coming of the Son of Man.

text.KJV: For wheresoever the carcase is, there will the eagles be gathered together.
text.ASV: Wheresoever the carcase is, there will the eagles be gathered together.
text.WEB: For wherever the carcass is, that is where the vultures gather together.

text.KJV: Immediately after the tribulation of those days shall the sun be darkened, and the moon shall not give her light, and the stars shall fall from heaven, and the powers of the heavens shall be shaken:
text.ASV: But immediately after the tribulation of those days the sun shall be darkened, and the moon shall not give her light, and the stars shall fall from heaven, and the powers of the heavens shall be shaken:
text.WEB: But immediately after the oppression of those days, the sun will be darkened, the moon will not give its light, the stars will fall from the sky, and the powers of the heavens will be shaken;;

text.KJV: And then shall appear the sign of the Son of man in heaven: and then shall all the tribes of the earth mourn, and they shall see the Son of man coming in the clouds of heaven with power and great glory.
