text.ASV: and then shall appear the sign of the Son of man in heaven: and then shall all the tribes of the earth mourn, and they shall see the Son of man coming on the clouds of heaven with power and great glory.
text.WEB: and then the sign of the Son of Man will appear in the sky. Then all the tribes of the earth will mourn, and they will see the Son of Man coming on the clouds of the sky with power and great glory.

text.KJV: And he shall send his angels with a great sound of a trumpet, and they shall gather together his elect from the four winds, from one end of heaven to the other.
text.ASV: And he shall send forth his angels with a great sound of a trumpet, and they shall gather together his elect from the four winds, from one end of heaven to the other.
text.WEB: He will send out his angels with a great sound of a trumpet, and they will gather together his chosen ones from the four winds, from one end of the sky to the other.

text.KJV: Now learn a parable of the fig tree; When his branch is yet tender, and putteth forth leaves, ye know that summer is nigh:
text.ASV: Now from the fig tree learn her parable: when her branch is now become tender, and putteth forth its leaves, ye know that the summer is nigh;
text.WEB: “Now from the fig tree learn this parable. When its branch has now become tender, and produces its leaves, you know that the summer is near.

text.KJV: So likewise ye, when ye shall see all these things, know that it is near, even at the doors.
text.ASV: even so ye also, when ye see all these things, know ye that he is nigh, `even' at the doors.
text.WEB: Even so you also, when you see all these things, know that it is near, even at the doors.

text.KJV: Verily I say unto you, This generation shall not pass, till all these things be fulfilled.
text.ASV: Verily I say unto you, This generation shall not pass away, till all these things be accomplished.
text.WEB: Most certainly I tell you, this generation will not pass away, until all these things are accomplished.

text.KJV: Heaven and earth shall pass away, but my words shall not pass away.
text.ASV: Heaven and earth shall pass away, but my words shall not pass away.
text.WEB: Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will not pass away.

text.KJV: But of that day and hour knoweth no man, no, not the angels of heaven, but my Father only.
text.ASV: But of that day and hour knoweth no one, not even the angels of heaven, neither the Son, but the Father only.
text.WEB: But no one knows of that day and hour, not even the angels of heaven, but my Father only.

text.KJV: But as the days of Noe were, so shall also the coming of the Son of man be.
text.ASV: And as `were' the days of Noah, so shall be the coming of the Son of man.
text.WEB: “As the days of Noah were, so will be the coming of the Son of Man.

text.KJV: For as in the days that were before the flood they were eating and drinking, marrying and giving in marriage, until the day that Noe entered into the ark,
text.ASV: For as in those days which were before the flood they were eating and drinking, marrying and giving in marriage, until the day that Noah entered into the ark,
text.WEB: For as in those days which were before the flood they were eating and drinking, marrying and giving in marriage, until the day that Noah entered into the ship,

text.KJV: And knew not until the flood came, and took them all away; so shall also the coming of the Son of man be.
text.ASV: and they knew not until the flood came, and took them all away; so shall be the coming of the Son of man.
text.WEB: and they didn’t know until the flood came, and took them all away, so will be the coming of the Son of Man.

text.KJV: Then shall two be in the field; the one shall be taken, and the other left.
text.ASV: Then shall two man be in the field; one is taken, and one is left:
text.WEB: Then two men will be in the field: one will be taken and one will be left.

text.KJV: Two women shall be grinding at the mill; the one shall be taken, and the other left.
text.ASV: two women `shall be' grinding at the mill; one is taken, and one is left.
text.WEB: Two women will be grinding at the mill: one will be taken and one will be left.

text.KJV: Watch therefore: for ye know not what hour your Lord doth come.
text.ASV: Watch therefore: for ye know not on what day your Lord cometh.
text.WEB: Watch therefore, for you don’t know in what hour your Lord comes.

text.KJV: But know this, that if the goodman of the house had known in what watch the thief would come, he would have watched, and would not have suffered his house to be broken up.
text.ASV: But know this, that if the master of the house had known in what watch the thief was coming, he would have watched, and would not have suffered his house to be broken through.
text.WEB: But know this, that if the master of the house had known in what watch of the night the thief was coming, he would have watched, and would not have allowed his house to be broken into.

text.KJV: Therefore be ye also ready: for in such an hour as ye think not the Son of man cometh.
text.ASV: Therefore be ye also ready; for in an hour that ye think not the Son of man cometh.
text.WEB: Therefore also be ready, for in an hour that you don’t expect, the Son of Man will come.

text.KJV: Who then is a faithful and wise servant, whom his lord hath made ruler over his household, to give them meat in due season?
text.ASV: Who then is the faithful and wise servant, whom his lord hath set over his household, to give them their food in due season?
text.WEB: “Who then is the faithful and wise servant, whom his lord has set over his household, to give them their food in due season?

text.KJV: Blessed is that servant, whom his lord when he cometh shall find so doing.
text.ASV: Blessed is that servant, whom his lord when he cometh shall find so doing.
text.WEB: Blessed is that servant whom his lord finds doing so when he comes.

text.KJV: Verily I say unto you, That he shall make him ruler over all his goods.
text.ASV: Verily I say unto you, that he will set him over all that he hath.
text.WEB: Most certainly I tell you that he will set him over all that he has.

text.KJV: But and if that evil servant shall say in his heart, My lord delayeth his coming;
text.ASV: But if that evil servant shall say in his heart, My lord tarrieth;
text.WEB: But if that evil servant should say in his heart, ‘My lord is delaying his coming,’

text.KJV: And shall begin to smite his fellowservants, and to eat and drink with the drunken;
text.ASV: and shall begin to beat his fellow-servants, and shall eat and drink with the drunken;
text.WEB: and begins to beat his fellow servants, and eat and drink with the drunkards,

text.KJV: The lord of that servant shall come in a day when he looketh not for him, and in an hour that he is not aware of,
text.ASV: the lord of that servant shall come in a day when he expecteth not, and in an hour when he knoweth not,
text.WEB: the lord of that servant will come in a day when he doesn’t expect it, and in an hour when he doesn’t know it,

text.KJV: And shall cut him asunder, and appoint him his portion with the hypocrites: there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
text.ASV: and shall cut him asunder, and appoint his portion with the hypocrites: there shall be the weeping and the gnashing of teeth.
text.WEB: and will cut him in pieces, and appoint his portion with the hypocrites. That is where the weeping and grinding of teeth will be.

text.KJV: Then shall the kingdom of heaven be likened unto ten virgins, which took their lamps, and went forth to meet the bridegroom.
text.ASV: Then shall the kingdom of heaven be likened unto ten virgins, who took their lamps, and went forth to meet the bridegroom.
text.WEB: “Then the Kingdom of Heaven will be like ten virgins, who took their lamps, and went out to meet the bridegroom.

text.KJV: And five of them were wise, and five were foolish.
text.ASV: And five of them were foolish, and five were wise.
text.WEB: Five of them were foolish, and five were wise.

text.KJV: They that were foolish took their lamps, and took no oil with them:
text.ASV: For the foolish, when they took their lamps, took no oil with them:
text.WEB: Those who were foolish, when they took their lamps, took no oil with them,

text.KJV: But the wise took oil in their vessels with their lamps.
text.ASV: but the wise took oil in their vessels with their lamps.
text.WEB: but the wise took oil in their vessels with their lamps.

text.KJV: While the bridegroom tarried, they all slumbered and slept.
text.ASV: Now while the bridegroom tarried, they all slumbered and slept.
text.WEB: Now while the bridegroom delayed, they all slumbered and slept.

text.KJV: And at midnight there was a cry made, Behold, the bridegroom cometh; go ye out to meet him.
text.ASV: But at midnight there is a cry, Behold, the bridegroom! Come ye forth to meet him.
text.WEB: But at midnight there was a cry, ‘Behold! The bridegroom is coming! Come out to meet him!’

text.KJV: Then all those virgins arose, and trimmed their lamps.
text.ASV: Then all those virgins arose, and trimmed their lamps.
text.WEB: Then all those virgins arose, and trimmed their lamps.

text.KJV: And the foolish said unto the wise, Give us of your oil; for our lamps are gone out.
text.ASV: And the foolish said unto the wise, Give us of your oil; for our lamps are going out.
text.WEB: The foolish said to the wise, ‘Give us some of your oil, for our lamps are going out.’

text.KJV: But the wise answered, saying, Not so; lest there be not enough for us and you: but go ye rather to them that sell, and buy for yourselves.
text.ASV: But the wise answered, saying, Peradventure there will not be enough for us and you: go ye rather to them that sell, and buy for yourselves.
text.WEB: But the wise answered, saying, ‘What if there isn’t enough for us and you? You go rather to those who sell, and buy for yourselves.’

text.KJV: And while they went to buy, the bridegroom came; and they that were ready went in with him to the marriage: and the door was shut.
text.ASV: And while they went away to buy, the bridegroom came; and they that were ready went in with him to the marriage feast: and the door was shut.
text.WEB: While they went away to buy, the bridegroom came, and those who were ready went in with him to the marriage feast, and the door was shut.

text.KJV: Afterward came also the other virgins, saying, Lord, Lord, open to us.
text.ASV: Afterward came also the other virgins, saying, Lord, Lord, open to us.
text.WEB: Afterward the other virgins also came, saying, ‘Lord, Lord, open to us.’

text.KJV: But he answered and said, Verily I say unto you, I know you not.
text.ASV: But he answered and said, Verily I say unto you, I know you not.
text.WEB: But he answered, ‘Most certainly I tell you, I don’t know you.’

text.KJV: Watch therefore, for ye know neither the day nor the hour wherein the Son of man cometh.
text.ASV: Watch therefore, for ye know not the day nor the hour.
text.WEB: Watch therefore, for you don’t know the day nor the hour in which the Son of Man is coming.

text.KJV: For the kingdom of heaven is as a man travelling into a far country, who called his own servants, and delivered unto them his goods.
text.ASV: For `it is' as `when' a man, going into another country, called his own servants, and delivered unto them his goods.
text.WEB: “For it is like a man, going into another country, who called his own servants, and entrusted his goods to them.

text.KJV: And unto one he gave five talents, to another two, and to another one; to every man according to his several ability; and straightway took his journey.
text.ASV: And unto one he gave five talents, to another two, to another one; to each according to his several ability; and he went on his journey.
text.WEB: To one he gave five talents, to another two, to another one; to each according to his own ability. Then he went on his journey.

text.KJV: Then he that had received the five talents went and traded with the same, and made them other five talents.
text.ASV: Straightway he that received the five talents went and traded with them, and made other five talents.
text.WEB: Immediately he who received the five talents went and traded with them, and made another five talents.

text.KJV: And likewise he that had received two, he also gained other two.
text.ASV: In like manner he also that `received' the two gained other two.
text.WEB: In the same way, he also who got the two gained another two.

text.KJV: But he that had received one went and digged in the earth, and hid his lord's money.
text.ASV: But he that received the one went away and digged in the earth, and hid his lord's money.
text.WEB: But he who received the one talent went away and dug in the earth, and hid his lord’s money.

text.KJV: After a long time the lord of those servants cometh, and reckoneth with them.
text.ASV: Now after a long time the lord of those servants cometh, and maketh a reckoning with them.
text.WEB: “Now after a long time the lord of those servants came, and reconciled accounts with them.

text.KJV: And so he that had received five talents came and brought other five talents, saying, Lord, thou deliveredst unto me five talents: behold, I have gained beside them five talents more.
text.ASV: And he that received the five talents came and brought other five talents, saying, Lord, thou deliveredst unto me five talents: lo, I have gained other five talents.
text.WEB: He who received the five talents came and brought another five talents, saying, ‘Lord, you delivered to me five talents. Behold, I have gained another five talents besides them.’

text.KJV: His lord said unto him, Well done, thou good and faithful servant: thou hast been faithful over a few things, I will make thee ruler over many things: enter thou into the joy of thy lord.
text.ASV: His lord said unto him, Well done, good and faithful servant: thou hast been faithful over a few things, I will set thee over many things; enter thou into the joy of thy lord.
text.WEB: “His lord said to him, ‘Well done, good and faithful servant. You have been faithful over a few things, I will set you over many things. Enter into the joy of your lord.’

text.KJV: He also that had received two talents came and said, Lord, thou deliveredst unto me two talents: behold, I have gained two other talents beside them.
text.ASV: And he also that `received' the two talents came and said, Lord, thou deliveredst unto me two talents: lo, I have gained other two talents.
text.WEB: “He also who got the two talents came and said, ‘Lord, you delivered to me two talents. Behold, I have gained another two talents besides them.’

text.KJV: His lord said unto him, Well done, good and faithful servant; thou hast been faithful over a few things, I will make thee ruler over many things: enter thou into the joy of thy lord.
text.ASV: His lord said unto him, Well done, good and faithful servant: thou hast been faithful over a few things, I will set thee over many things; enter thou into the joy of thy lord.
text.WEB: “His lord said to him, ‘Well done, good and faithful servant. You have been faithful over a few things, I will set you over many things. Enter into the joy of your lord.’

text.KJV: Then he which had received the one talent came and said, Lord, I knew thee that thou art an hard man, reaping where thou hast not sown, and gathering where thou hast not strawed:
text.ASV: And he also that had received the one talent came and said, Lord, I knew thee that thou art a hard man, reaping where thou didst not sow, and gathering where thou didst not scatter;
text.WEB: “He also who had received the one talent came and said, ‘Lord, I knew you that you are a hard man, reaping where you did not sow, and gathering where you did not scatter.

text.KJV: And I was afraid, and went and hid thy talent in the earth: lo, there thou hast that is thine.
text.ASV: and I was afraid, and went away and hid thy talent in the earth: lo, thou hast thine own.
text.WEB: I was afraid, and went away and hid your talent in the earth. Behold, you have what is yours.’

text.KJV: His lord answered and said unto him, Thou wicked and slothful servant, thou knewest that I reap where I sowed not, and gather where I have not strawed:
text.ASV: But his lord answered and said unto him, Thou wicked and slothful servant, thou knewest that I reap where I sowed not, and gather where I did not scatter;
text.WEB: “But his lord answered him, ‘You wicked and slothful servant. You knew that I reap where I didn’t sow, and gather where I didn’t scatter.

text.KJV: Thou oughtest therefore to have put my money to the exchangers, and then at my coming I should have received mine own with usury.
text.ASV: thou oughtest therefore to have put my money to the bankers, and at my coming I should have received back mine own with interest.
text.WEB: You ought therefore to have deposited my money with the bankers, and at my coming I should have received back my own with interest.

text.KJV: Take therefore the talent from him, and give it unto him which hath ten talents.
text.ASV: Take ye away therefore the talent from him, and give it unto him that hath the ten talents.
text.WEB: Take away therefore the talent from him, and give it to him who has the ten talents.

text.KJV: For unto every one that hath shall be given, and he shall have abundance: but from him that hath not shall be taken away even that which he hath.
text.ASV: For unto every one that hath shall be given, and he shall have abundance: but from him that hath not, even that which he hath shall be taken away.
text.WEB: For to everyone who has will be given, and he will have abundance, but from him who doesn’t have, even that which he has will be taken away.

text.KJV: And cast ye the unprofitable servant into outer darkness: there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
text.ASV: And cast ye out the unprofitable servant into the outer darkness: there shall be the weeping and the gnashing of teeth.
text.WEB: Throw out the unprofitable servant into the outer darkness, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.’

text.KJV: When the Son of man shall come in his glory, and all the holy angels with him, then shall he sit upon the throne of his glory:
text.ASV: But when the Son of man shall come in his glory, and all the angels with him, then shall he sit on the throne of his glory:
text.WEB: “But when the Son of Man comes in his glory, and all the holy angels with him, then he will sit on the throne of his glory.

text.KJV: And before him shall be gathered all nations: and he shall separate them one from another, as a shepherd divideth his sheep from the goats:
text.ASV: and before him shall be gathered all the nations: and he shall separate them one from another, as the shepherd separateth the sheep from the goats;
text.WEB: Before him all the nations will be gathered, and he will separate them one from another, as a shepherd separates the sheep from the goats.

text.KJV: And he shall set the sheep on his right hand, but the goats on the left.
text.ASV: and he shall set the sheep on his right hand, but the goats on the left.
text.WEB: He will set the sheep on his right hand, but the goats on the left.

text.KJV: Then shall the King say unto them on his right hand, Come, ye blessed of my Father, inherit the kingdom prepared for you from the foundation of the world:
text.ASV: Then shall the King say unto them on his right hand, Come, ye blessed of my Father, inherit the kingdom prepared for you from the foundation of the world:
text.WEB: Then the King will tell those on his right hand, ‘Come, blessed of my Father, inherit the Kingdom prepared for you from the foundation of the world;

text.KJV: For I was an hungred, and ye gave me meat: I was thirsty, and ye gave me drink: I was a stranger, and ye took me in:
text.ASV: for I was hungry, and ye gave me to eat; I was thirsty, and ye gave me drink; I was a stranger, and ye took me in;
text.WEB: for I was hungry, and you gave me food to eat. I was thirsty, and you gave me drink. I was a stranger, and you took me in.

text.KJV: Naked, and ye clothed me: I was sick, and ye visited me: I was in prison, and ye came unto me.
text.ASV: naked, and ye clothed me; I was sick, and ye visited me; I was in prison, and ye came unto me.
text.WEB: I was naked, and you clothed me. I was sick, and you visited me. I was in prison, and you came to me.’

text.KJV: Then shall the righteous answer him, saying, Lord, when saw we thee an hungred, and fed thee? or thirsty, and gave thee drink?
text.ASV: Then shall the righteous answer him, saying, Lord, when saw we thee hungry, and fed thee? or athirst, and gave thee drink?
text.WEB: “Then the righteous will answer him, saying, ‘Lord, when did we see you hungry, and feed you; or thirsty, and give you a drink?

text.KJV: When saw we thee a stranger, and took thee in? or naked, and clothed thee?
text.ASV: And when saw we thee a stranger, and took thee in? or naked, and clothed thee?
text.WEB: When did we see you as a stranger, and take you in; or naked, and clothe you?

text.KJV: Or when saw we thee sick, or in prison, and came unto thee?
text.ASV: And when saw we thee sick, or in prison, and came unto thee?
text.WEB: When did we see you sick, or in prison, and come to you?’

text.KJV: And the King shall answer and say unto them, Verily I say unto you, Inasmuch as ye have done it unto one of the least of these my brethren, ye have done it unto me.
text.ASV: And the King shall answer and say unto them, Verily I say unto you, Inasmuch as ye did it unto one of these my brethren, `even' these least, ye did it unto me.
text.WEB: “The King will answer them, ‘Most certainly I tell you, because you did it to one of the least of these my brothers, you did it to me.’

text.KJV: Then shall he say also unto them on the left hand, Depart from me, ye cursed, into everlasting fire, prepared for the devil and his angels:
text.ASV: Then shall he say also unto them on the left hand, Depart from me, ye cursed, into the eternal fire which is prepared for the devil and his angels:
text.WEB: Then he will say also to those on the left hand, ‘Depart from me, you cursed, into the eternal fire which is prepared for the devil and his angels;

text.KJV: For I was an hungred, and ye gave me no meat: I was thirsty, and ye gave me no drink:
text.ASV: for I was hungry, and ye did not give me to eat; I was thirsty, and ye gave me no drink;
text.WEB: for I was hungry, and you didn’t give me food to eat; I was thirsty, and you gave me no drink;

text.KJV: I was a stranger, and ye took me not in: naked, and ye clothed me not: sick, and in prison, and ye visited me not.
text.ASV: I was a stranger, and ye took me not in; naked, and ye clothed me not; sick, and in prison, and ye visited me not.
text.WEB: I was a stranger, and you didn’t take me in; naked, and you didn’t clothe me; sick, and in prison, and you didn’t visit me.’

text.KJV: Then shall they also answer him, saying, Lord, when saw we thee an hungred, or athirst, or a stranger, or naked, or sick, or in prison, and did not minister unto thee?
text.ASV: Then shall they also answer, saying, Lord, when saw we thee hungry, or athirst, or a stranger, or naked, or sick, or in prison, and did not minister unto thee?
text.WEB: “Then they will also answer, saying, ‘Lord, when did we see you hungry, or thirsty, or a stranger, or naked, or sick, or in prison, and didn’t help you?’

text.KJV: Then shall he answer them, saying, Verily I say unto you, Inasmuch as ye did it not to one of the least of these, ye did it not to me.
text.ASV: Then shall he answer them, saying, Verily I say unto you, Inasmuch as ye did it not unto one of these least, ye did it not unto me.
text.WEB: “Then he will answer them, saying, ‘Most certainly I tell you, because you didn’t do it to one of the least of these, you didn’t do it to me.’

text.KJV: And these shall go away into everlasting punishment: but the righteous into life eternal.
text.ASV: And these shall go away into eternal punishment: but the righteous into eternal life.
text.WEB: These will go away into eternal punishment, but the righteous into eternal life.”

text.KJV: And it came to pass, when Jesus had finished all these sayings, he said unto his disciples,
text.ASV: And it came to pass, when Jesus had finished all these words, he said unto his disciples,
text.WEB: When Jesus had finished all these words, he said to his disciples,

text.KJV: Ye know that after two days is the feast of the passover, and the Son of man is betrayed to be crucified.
text.ASV: Ye know that after two days the passover cometh, and the Son of man is delivered up to be crucified.
text.WEB: “You know that after two days the Passover is coming, and the Son of Man will be delivered up to be crucified.”

text.KJV: Then assembled together the chief priests, and the scribes, and the elders of the people, unto the palace of the high priest, who was called Caiaphas,
text.ASV: Then were gathered together the chief priests, and the elders of the people, unto the court of the high priest, who was called Caiaphas;
text.WEB: Then the chief priests, the scribes, and the elders of the people were gathered together in the court of the high priest, who was called Caiaphas.

text.KJV: And consulted that they might take Jesus by subtilty, and kill him.
text.ASV: and they took counsel together that they might take Jesus by subtlety, and kill him.
text.WEB: They took counsel together that they might take Jesus by deceit, and kill him.

text.KJV: But they said, Not on the feast day, lest there be an uproar among the people.
text.ASV: But they said, Not during the feast, lest a tumult arise among people.
text.WEB: But they said, “Not during the feast, lest a riot occur among the people.”

text.KJV: Now when Jesus was in Bethany, in the house of Simon the leper,
text.ASV: Now when Jesus was in Bethany, in the house of Simon the leper,
text.WEB: Now when Jesus was in Bethany, in the house of Simon the leper,

text.KJV: There came unto him a woman having an alabaster box of very precious ointment, and poured it on his head, as he sat at meat.
text.ASV: there came unto him a woman having an alabaster cruse of exceeding precious ointment, and she poured it upon his head, as he sat at meat.
text.WEB: a woman came to him having an alabaster jar of very expensive ointment, and she poured it on his head as he sat at the table.

text.KJV: But when his disciples saw it, they had indignation, saying, To what purpose is this waste?
text.ASV: But when the disciples saw it, they had indignation, saying, To what purpose is this waste?
text.WEB: But when his disciples saw this, they were indignant, saying, “Why this waste?

text.KJV: For this ointment might have been sold for much, and given to the poor.
text.ASV: For this `ointment' might have been sold for much, and given to the poor.
text.WEB: For this ointment might have been sold for much, and given to the poor.”

text.KJV: When Jesus understood it, he said unto them, Why trouble ye the woman? for she hath wrought a good work upon me.
text.ASV: But Jesus perceiving it said unto them, Why trouble ye the woman? for she hath wrought a good work upon me.
text.WEB: However, knowing this, Jesus said to them, “Why do you trouble the woman? She has done a good work for me.

text.KJV: For ye have the poor always with you; but me ye have not always.
text.ASV: For ye have the poor always with you; but me ye have not always.
text.WEB: For you always have the poor with you; but you don’t always have me.

text.KJV: For in that she hath poured this ointment on my body, she did it for my burial.
text.ASV: For in that she poured this ointment upon my body, she did it to prepare me for burial.
text.WEB: For in pouring this ointment on my body, she did it to prepare me for burial.

text.KJV: Verily I say unto you, Wheresoever this gospel shall be preached in the whole world, there shall also this, that this woman hath done, be told for a memorial of her.
text.ASV: Verily I say unto you, Wheresoever this gospel shall be preached in the whole world, that also which this woman hath done shall be spoken of for a memorial of her.
text.WEB: Most certainly I tell you, wherever this Good News is preached in the whole world, what this woman has done will also be spoken of as a memorial of her.”

text.KJV: Then one of the twelve, called Judas Iscariot, went unto the chief priests,
text.ASV: Then one of the twelve, who was called Judas Iscariot, went unto the chief priests,
text.WEB: Then one of the twelve, who was called Judas Iscariot, went to the chief priests,

text.KJV: And said unto them, What will ye give me, and I will deliver him unto you? And they covenanted with him for thirty pieces of silver.
text.ASV: and said, What are ye willing to give me, and I will deliver him unto you? And they weighed unto him thirty pieces of silver.

text.KJV: And from that time he sought opportunity to betray him.
text.ASV: And from that time he sought opportunity to deliver him `unto them.'
text.WEB: From that time he sought opportunity to betray him.

text.KJV: Now the first day of the feast of unleavened bread the disciples came to Jesus, saying unto him, Where wilt thou that we prepare for thee to eat the passover?
text.ASV: Now on the first `day' of unleavened bread the disciples came to Jesus, saying, Where wilt thou that we make ready for thee to eat the passover?
text.WEB: Now on the first day of unleavened bread, the disciples came to Jesus, saying to him, “Where do you want us to prepare for you to eat the Passover?”

text.KJV: And he said, Go into the city to such a man, and say unto him, The Master saith, My time is at hand; I will keep the passover at thy house with my disciples.
text.ASV: And he said, Go into the city to such a man, and say unto him, The Teacher saith, My time is at hand; I keep the passover at thy house with my disciples.
text.WEB: He said, “Go into the city to a certain person, and tell him, ‘The Teacher says, “My time is at hand. I will keep the Passover at your house with my disciples.”’”

text.KJV: And the disciples did as Jesus had appointed them; and they made ready the passover.
text.ASV: And the disciples did as Jesus appointed them; and they made ready the passover.
text.WEB: The disciples did as Jesus commanded them, and they prepared the Passover.

text.KJV: Now when the even was come, he sat down with the twelve.
text.ASV: Now when even was come, he was sitting at meat with the twelve disciples;
text.WEB: Now when evening had come, he was reclining at the table with the twelve disciples.

text.KJV: And as they did eat, he said, Verily I say unto you, that one of you shall betray me.
text.ASV: and as they were eating, he said, Verily I say unto you, that one of you shall betray me.
text.WEB: As they were eating, he said, “Most certainly I tell you that one of you will betray me.”

text.KJV: And they were exceeding sorrowful, and began every one of them to say unto him, Lord, is it I?
text.ASV: And they were exceeding sorrowful, and began to say unto him every one, Is it I, Lord?
text.WEB: They were exceedingly sorrowful, and each began to ask him, “It isn’t me, is it, Lord?”

text.KJV: And he answered and said, He that dippeth his hand with me in the dish, the same shall betray me.
text.ASV: And he answered and said, He that dipped his hand with me in the dish, the same shall betray me.
text.WEB: He answered, “He who dipped his hand with me in the dish, the same will betray me.

text.KJV: The Son of man goeth as it is written of him: but woe unto that man by whom the Son of man is betrayed! it had been good for that man if he had not been born.
text.ASV: The Son of man goeth, even as it is written of him: but woe unto that man through whom the Son of man is betrayed! good were it for that man if he had not been born.
text.WEB: The Son of Man goes, even as it is written of him, but woe to that man through whom the Son of Man is betrayed! It would be better for that man if he had not been born.”

text.KJV: Then Judas, which betrayed him, answered and said, Master, is it I? He said unto him, Thou hast said.
text.ASV: And Judas, who betrayed him, answered and said, Is it I, Rabbi? He saith unto him, Thou hast said.
text.WEB: Judas, who betrayed him, answered, “It isn’t me, is it, Rabbi?” He said to him, “You said it.”

text.KJV: And as they were eating, Jesus took bread, and blessed it, and brake it, and gave it to the disciples, and said, Take, eat; this is my body.
text.ASV: And as they were eating, Jesus took bread, and blessed, and brake it; and he gave to the disciples, and said, Take, eat; this is my body.
text.WEB: As they were eating, Jesus took bread, gave thanks for it, and broke it. He gave to the disciples, and said, “Take, eat; this is my body.”

text.KJV: And he took the cup, and gave thanks, and gave it to them, saying, Drink ye all of it;
text.ASV: And he took a cup, and gave thanks, and gave to them, saying, Drink ye all of it;
text.WEB: He took the cup, gave thanks, and gave to them, saying, “All of you drink it,

text.KJV: For this is my blood of the new testament, which is shed for many for the remission of sins.
text.ASV: for this is my blood of the covenant, which is poured out for many unto remission of sins.
text.WEB: for this is my blood of the new covenant, which is poured out for many for the remission of sins.

text.KJV: But I say unto you, I will not drink henceforth of this fruit of the vine, until that day when I drink it new with you in my Father's kingdom.
text.ASV: But I say unto you, I shall not drink henceforth of this fruit of the vine, until that day when I drink it new with you in my Father's kingdom.
text.WEB: But I tell you that I will not drink of this fruit of the vine from now on, until that day when I drink it anew with you in my Father’s Kingdom.”

text.KJV: And when they had sung an hymn, they went out into the mount of Olives.
text.ASV: And when they had sung a hymn, they went out unto the mount of Olives.
text.WEB: When they had sung a hymn, they went out to the Mount of Olives.

text.KJV: Then saith Jesus unto them, All ye shall be offended because of me this night: for it is written, I will smite the shepherd, and the sheep of the flock shall be scattered abroad.
text.ASV: Then saith Jesus unto them, All ye shall be offended in me this night: for it is written, I will smite the shepherd, and the sheep of the flock shall be scattered abroad.
text.WEB: Then Jesus said to them, “All of you will be made to stumble because of me tonight, for it is written, ‘I will strike the shepherd, and the sheep of the flock will be scattered.’

text.KJV: But after I am risen again, I will go before you into Galilee.
text.ASV: But after I am raised up, I will go before you into Galilee.
text.WEB: But after I am raised up, I will go before you into Galilee.”

text.ASV: But Peter answered and said unto him, If all shall be offended in thee, I will never be offended.
text.WEB: But Peter answered him, “Even if all will be made to stumble because of you, I will never be made to stumble.”

text.KJV: Jesus said unto him, Verily I say unto thee, That this night, before the cock crow, thou shalt deny me thrice.
text.ASV: Jesus said unto him, Verily I say unto thee, that this night, before the cock crow, thou shalt deny me thrice.
text.WEB: Jesus said to him, “Most certainly I tell you that tonight, before the rooster crows, you will deny me three times.”

text.KJV: Peter said unto him, Though I should die with thee, yet will I not deny thee. Likewise also said all the disciples.
text.ASV: Peter saith unto him, Even if I must die with thee, `yet' will I not deny thee. Likewise also said all the disciples.
text.WEB: Peter said to him, “Even if I must die with you, I will not deny you.” All of the disciples also said likewise.

text.KJV: Then cometh Jesus with them unto a place called Gethsemane, and saith unto the disciples, Sit ye here, while I go and pray yonder.
text.ASV: Then cometh Jesus with them unto a place called Gethsemane, and saith unto his disciples, Sit ye here, while I go yonder and pray.
text.WEB: Then Jesus came with them to a place called Gethsemane, and said to his disciples, “Sit here, while I go there and pray.”

text.KJV: And he took with him Peter and the two sons of Zebedee, and began to be sorrowful and very heavy.
text.ASV: And he took with him Peter and the two sons of Zebedee, and began to be sorrowful and sore troubled.
text.WEB: He took with him Peter and the two sons of Zebedee, and began to be sorrowful and severely troubled.

text.KJV: Then saith he unto them, My soul is exceeding sorrowful, even unto death: tarry ye here, and watch with me.
text.ASV: Then saith he unto them, My soul is exceeding sorrowful, even unto death: abide ye here, and watch with me.
text.WEB: Then he said to them, “My soul is exceedingly sorrowful, even to death. Stay here, and watch with me.”

text.KJV: And he went a little farther, and fell on his face, and prayed, saying, O my Father, if it be possible, let this cup pass from me: nevertheless not as I will, but as thou wilt.
text.ASV: And he went forward a little, and fell on his face, and prayed, saying, My Father, if it be possible, let this cup pass away from me: nevertheless, not as I will, but as thou wilt.
text.WEB: He went forward a little, fell on his face, and prayed, saying, “My Father, if it is possible, let this cup pass away from me; nevertheless, not what I desire, but what you desire.”

text.ASV: And he cometh unto the disciples, and findeth them sleeping, and saith unto Peter, What, could ye not watch with me one hour?

text.ASV: Watch and pray, that ye enter not into temptation: the spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak.
text.WEB: Watch and pray, that you don’t enter into temptation. The spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak.”

text.KJV: He went away again the second time, and prayed, saying, O my Father, if this cup may not pass away from me, except I drink it, thy will be done.

text.WEB: Again, a second time he went away, and prayed, saying, “My Father, if this cup can’t pass away from me unless I drink it, your desire be done.”

text.KJV: And he came and found them asleep again: for their eyes were heavy.
text.ASV: And he came again and found them sleeping, for their eyes were heavy.
text.WEB: He came again and found them sleeping, for their eyes were heavy.

text.KJV: And he left them, and went away again, and prayed the third time, saying the same words.
text.ASV: And he left them again, and went away, and prayed a third time, saying again the same words.
text.WEB: He left them again, went away, and prayed a third time, saying the same words.

text.KJV: Then cometh he to his disciples, and saith unto them, Sleep on now, and take your rest: behold, the hour is at hand, and the Son of man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.
text.ASV: Then cometh he to the disciples, and saith unto them, Sleep on now, and take your rest: behold, the hour is at hand, and the Son of man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.
text.WEB: Then he came to his disciples, and said to them, “Sleep on now, and take your rest. Behold, the hour is at hand, and the Son of Man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.

text.KJV: Rise, let us be going: behold, he is at hand that doth betray me.
text.ASV: Arise, let us be going: behold, he is at hand that betrayeth me.
text.WEB: Arise, let’s be going. Behold, he who betrays me is at hand.”

text.KJV: And while he yet spake, lo, Judas, one of the twelve, came, and with him a great multitude with swords and staves, from the chief priests and elders of the people.
text.ASV: And while he yet spake, lo, Judas, one of the twelve, came, and with him a great multitude with swords and staves, from the chief priest and elders of the people.

text.KJV: Thinkest thou that I cannot now pray to my Father, and he shall presently give me more than twelve legions of angels?

text.WEB: Or do you think that I couldn’t ask my Father, and he would even now send me more than twelve legions of angels?

text.KJV: But how then shall the scriptures be fulfilled, that thus it must be?
text.ASV: How then should the scriptures be fulfilled that thus it must be?
text.WEB: How then would the Scriptures be fulfilled that it must be so?”

text.KJV: But all this was done, that the scriptures of the prophets might be fulfilled. Then all the disciples forsook him, and fled.
text.ASV: But all this is come to pass, that the scriptures of the prophets might be fulfilled. Then all the disciples left him, and fled.

text.WEB: When he was accused by the chief priests and elders, he answered nothing.

text.KJV: Then said Pilate unto him, Hearest thou not how many things they witness against thee?
text.ASV: Then saith Pilate unto him, Hearest thou not how many things they witness against thee?
text.WEB: Then Pilate said to him, “Don’t you hear how many things they testify against you?”

text.KJV: And he answered him to never a word; insomuch that the governor marvelled greatly.
text.ASV: And he gave him no answer, not even to one word: insomuch that the governor marvelled greatly.
text.WEB: He gave him no answer, not even one word, so that the governor marveled greatly.

text.KJV: Now at that feast the governor was wont to release unto the people a prisoner, whom they would.
text.ASV: Now at the feast the governor was wont to release unto the multitude one prisoner, whom they would.
text.WEB: Now at the feast the governor was accustomed to release to the multitude one prisoner, whom they desired.

text.KJV: And they had then a notable prisoner, called Barabbas.
text.ASV: And they had then a notable prisoner, called Barabbas.
text.WEB: They had then a notable prisoner, called Barabbas.

text.KJV: Therefore when they were gathered together, Pilate said unto them, Whom will ye that I release unto you? Barabbas, or Jesus which is called Christ?
text.ASV: When therefore they were gathered together, Pilate said unto them, Whom will ye that I release unto you? Barabbas, or Jesus who is called Christ?
text.WEB: When therefore they were gathered together, Pilate said to them, “Whom do you want me to release to you? Barabbas, or Jesus, who is called Christ?”

text.KJV: For he knew that for envy they had delivered him.
text.ASV: For he knew that for envy they had delivered him up.
text.WEB: For he knew that because of envy they had delivered him up.

text.KJV: When he was set down on the judgment seat, his wife sent unto him, saying, Have thou nothing to do with that just man: for I have suffered many things this day in a dream because of him.
text.ASV: And while he was sitting on the judgment-seat, his wife sent unto him, saying, Have thou nothing to do with that righteous man; for I have suffered many things this day in a dream because of him.
text.WEB: While he was sitting on the judgment seat, his wife sent to him, saying, “Have nothing to do with that righteous man, for I have suffered many things today in a dream because of him.”

text.KJV: But the chief priests and elders persuaded the multitude that they should ask Barabbas, and destroy Jesus.
text.ASV: Now the chief priests and the elders persuaded the multitudes that they should ask for Barabbas, and destroy Jesus.
text.WEB: Now the chief priests and the elders persuaded the multitudes to ask for Barabbas, and destroy Jesus.

text.KJV: The governor answered and said unto them, Whether of the twain will ye that I release unto you? They said, Barabbas.
text.ASV: But the governor answered and said unto them, Which of the two will ye that I release unto you? And they said, Barabbas.
text.WEB: But the governor answered them, “Which of the two do you want me to release to you?” They said, “Barabbas!”

text.KJV: Pilate saith unto them, What shall I do then with Jesus which is called Christ? They all say unto him, Let him be crucified.
text.ASV: Pilate saith unto them, What then shall I do unto Jesus who is called Christ? They all say, Let him be crucified.
text.WEB: Pilate said to them, “What then shall I do to Jesus, who is called Christ?” They all said to him, “Let him be crucified!”

text.KJV: And the governor said, Why, what evil hath he done? But they cried out the more, saying, Let him be crucified.
text.ASV: And he said, Why, what evil hath he done? But they cried out exceedingly, saying, Let him be crucified.
text.WEB: But the governor said, “Why? What evil has he done?” But they cried out exceedingly, saying, “Let him be crucified!”

text.KJV: When Pilate saw that he could prevail nothing, but that rather a tumult was made, he took water, and washed his hands before the multitude, saying, I am innocent of the blood of this just person: see ye to it.
text.ASV: So when Pilate saw that he prevailed nothing, but rather that a tumult was arising, he took water, and washed his hands before the multitude, saying, I am innocent of the blood of this righteous man; see ye `to it'.
text.WEB: So when Pilate saw that nothing was being gained, but rather that a disturbance was starting, he took water, and washed his hands before the multitude, saying, “I am innocent of the blood of this righteous person. You see to it.”

text.KJV: Then answered all the people, and said, His blood be on us, and on our children.
text.ASV: And all the people answered and said, His blood `be' on us, and on our children.
text.WEB: All the people answered, “May his blood be on us, and on our children!”

text.KJV: Then released he Barabbas unto them: and when he had scourged Jesus, he delivered him to be crucified.
text.ASV: Then released he unto them Barabbas; but Jesus he scourged and delivered to be crucified.
text.WEB: Then he released to them Barabbas, but Jesus he flogged and delivered to be crucified.

text.KJV: Then the soldiers of the governor took Jesus into the common hall, and gathered unto him the whole band of soldiers.
text.ASV: Then the soldiers of the governor took Jesus into the Praetorium, and gathered unto him the whole band.
text.WEB: Then the governor’s soldiers took Jesus into the Praetorium, and gathered the whole garrison together against him.

text.KJV: And they stripped him, and put on him a scarlet robe.
text.ASV: And they stripped him, and put on him a scarlet robe.
text.WEB: They stripped him, and put a scarlet robe on him.

text.KJV: And when they had platted a crown of thorns, they put it upon his head, and a reed in his right hand: and they bowed the knee before him, and mocked him, saying, Hail, King of the Jews!
text.ASV: And they platted a crown of thorns and put it upon his head, and a reed in his right hand; and they kneeled down before him, and mocked him, saying, Hail, King of the Jews!
text.WEB: They braided a crown of thorns and put it on his head, and a reed in his right hand; and they kneeled down before him, and mocked him, saying, “Hail, King of the Jews!”

text.KJV: And they spit upon him, and took the reed, and smote him on the head.
text.ASV: And they spat upon him, and took the reed and smote him on the head.
text.WEB: They spat on him, and took the reed and struck him on the head.

text.KJV: And after that they had mocked him, they took the robe off from him, and put his own raiment on him, and led him away to crucify him.
text.ASV: And when they had mocked him, they took off from him the robe, and put on him his garments, and led him away to crucify him.
text.WEB: When they had mocked him, they took the robe off him, and put his clothes on him, and led him away to crucify him.

text.KJV: And as they came out, they found a man of Cyrene, Simon by name: him they compelled to bear his cross.
text.ASV: And as they came out, they found a man of Cyrene, Simon by name: him they compelled to go `with them', that he might bear his cross.
text.WEB: As they came out, they found a man of Cyrene, Simon by name, and they compelled him to go with them, that he might carry his cross.

text.KJV: And when they were come unto a place called Golgotha, that is to say, a place of a skull,
text.ASV: And they were come unto a place called Golgotha, that is to say, The place of a skull,
text.WEB: When they came to a place called “Golgotha”, that is to say, “The place of a skull,”

text.KJV: They gave him vinegar to drink mingled with gall: and when he had tasted thereof, he would not drink.
text.ASV: they gave him wine to drink mingled with gall: and when he had tasted it, he would not drink.
text.WEB: they gave him sour wine to drink mixed with gall. When he had tasted it, he would not drink.

text.KJV: And they crucified him, and parted his garments, casting lots: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophet, They parted my garments among them, and upon my vesture did they cast lots.
text.ASV: And when they had crucified him, they parted his garments among them, casting lots;
text.WEB: When they had crucified him, they divided his clothing among them, casting lots, and ]

text.KJV: And sitting down they watched him there;
text.ASV: and they sat and watched him there.
text.WEB: and they sat and watched him there.

text.KJV: And set up over his head his accusation written, THIS IS JESUS THE KING OF THE JEWS.
text.ASV: And they set up over his head his accusation written, THIS IS JESUS THE KING OF THE JEWS.
text.WEB: They set up over his head the accusation against him written, “THIS IS JESUS, THE KING OF THE JEWS.”

text.KJV: Then were there two thieves crucified with him, one on the right hand, and another on the left.
text.ASV: Then are there crucified with him two robbers, one on the right hand and one on the left.
text.WEB: Then there were two robbers crucified with him, one on his right hand and one on the left.

text.KJV: And they that passed by reviled him, wagging their heads,
text.ASV: And they that passed by railed on him, wagging their heads,
text.WEB: Those who passed by blasphemed him, wagging their heads,

text.KJV: And saying, Thou that destroyest the temple, and buildest it in three days, save thyself. If thou be the Son of God, come down from the cross.
text.ASV: and saying, Thou that destroyest the temple, and buildest it in three days, save thyself: if thou art the Son of God, come down from the cross.
text.WEB: and saying, “You who destroy the temple, and build it in three days, save yourself! If you are the Son of God, come down from the cross!”

text.KJV: Likewise also the chief priests mocking him, with the scribes and elders, said,
text.ASV: In like manner also the chief priests mocking `him', with the scribes and elders, said,
text.WEB: Likewise the chief priests also mocking, with the scribes, the Pharisees, and the elders, said,

text.KJV: He saved others; himself he cannot save. If he be the King of Israel, let him now come down from the cross, and we will believe him.
text.ASV: He saved others; himself he cannot save. He is the King of Israel; let him now come down from the cross, and we will believe on him.
text.WEB: “He saved others, but he can’t save himself. If he is the King of Israel, let him come down from the cross now, and we will believe in him.

text.KJV: He trusted in God; let him deliver him now, if he will have him: for he said, I am the Son of God.
text.ASV: He trusteth on God; let him deliver him now, if he desireth him: for he said, I am the Son of God.
text.WEB: He trusts in God. Let God deliver him now, if he wants him; for he said, ‘I am the Son of God.’”

text.KJV: The thieves also, which were crucified with him, cast the same in his teeth.
text.ASV: And the robbers also that were crucified with him cast upon him the same reproach.
text.WEB: The robbers also who were crucified with him cast on him the same reproach.

text.KJV: Now from the sixth hour there was darkness over all the land unto the ninth hour.
text.ASV: Now from the sixth hour there was darkness over all the land until the ninth hour.
text.WEB: Now from the sixth hour there was darkness over all the land until the ninth hour.

text.KJV: And about the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, Eli, Eli, lama sabachthani? that is to say, My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me?
text.ASV: And about the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, Eli, Eli, lama sabachthani? that is, My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me?
text.WEB: About the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, “Eli, Eli, lima sabachthani?” That is, “My God, my God, why have you forsaken me?”

text.KJV: Some of them that stood there, when they heard that, said, This man calleth for Elias.
text.ASV: And some of them stood there, when they heard it, said, This man calleth Elijah.
text.WEB: Some of them who stood there, when they heard it, said, “This man is calling Elijah.”

text.KJV: And straightway one of them ran, and took a spunge, and filled it with vinegar, and put it on a reed, and gave him to drink.
text.ASV: And straightway one of them ran, and took a sponge, and filled it with vinegar, and put it on a reed, and gave him to drink.
text.WEB: Immediately one of them ran, and took a sponge, and filled it with vinegar, and put it on a reed, and gave him a drink.

text.KJV: The rest said, Let be, let us see whether Elias will come to save him.
text.ASV: And the rest said, Let be; let us see whether Elijah cometh to save him.
text.WEB: The rest said, “Let him be. Let’s see whether Elijah comes to save him.”

text.KJV: Jesus, when he had cried again with a loud voice, yielded up the ghost.
text.ASV: And Jesus cried again with a loud voice, and yielded up his spirit.
text.WEB: Jesus cried again with a loud voice, and yielded up his spirit.

text.KJV: And, behold, the veil of the temple was rent in twain from the top to the bottom; and the earth did quake, and the rocks rent;
text.ASV: And behold, the veil of the temple was rent in two from the top to the bottom; and the earth did quake; and the rocks were rent;
text.WEB: Behold, the veil of the temple was torn in two from the top to the bottom. The earth quaked and the rocks were split.

text.KJV: And the graves were opened; and many bodies of the saints which slept arose,
text.ASV: and the tombs were opened; and many bodies of the saints that had fallen asleep were raised;
text.WEB: The tombs were opened, and many bodies of the saints who had fallen asleep were raised;

text.KJV: And came out of the graves after his resurrection, and went into the holy city, and appeared unto many.
text.ASV: and coming forth out of the tombs after his resurrection they entered into the holy city and appeared unto many.
text.WEB: and coming out of the tombs after his resurrection, they entered into the holy city and appeared to many.

text.KJV: Now when the centurion, and they that were with him, watching Jesus, saw the earthquake, and those things that were done, they feared greatly, saying, Truly this was the Son of God.
text.ASV: Now the centurion, and they that were with him watching Jesus, when they saw the earthquake, and the things that were done, feared exceedingly, saying, Truly this was the Son of God.
text.WEB: Now the centurion, and those who were with him watching Jesus, when they saw the earthquake, and the things that were done, feared exceedingly, saying, “Truly this was the Son of God.”

text.KJV: And many women were there beholding afar off, which followed Jesus from Galilee, ministering unto him:
text.ASV: And many women were there beholding from afar, who had followed Jesus from Galilee, ministering unto him:
text.WEB: Many women were there watching from afar, who had followed Jesus from Galilee, serving him.

text.KJV: Among which was Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James and Joses, and the mother of Zebedees children.
text.ASV: among whom was Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James and Joses, and the mother of the sons of Zebedee.
text.WEB: Among them were Mary Magdalene, Mary the mother of James and Joses, and the mother of the sons of Zebedee.

text.KJV: When the even was come, there came a rich man of Arimathaea, named Joseph, who also himself was Jesus' disciple:
text.ASV: And when even was come, there came a rich man from Arimathaea, named Joseph, who also himself was Jesus' disciple:
text.WEB: When evening had come, a rich man from Arimathaea, named Joseph, who himself was also Jesus’ disciple came.

text.KJV: He went to Pilate, and begged the body of Jesus. Then Pilate commanded the body to be delivered.
text.ASV: this man went to Pilate, and asked for the body of Jesus. Then Pilate commanded it to be given up.
text.WEB: This man went to Pilate, and asked for Jesus’ body. Then Pilate commanded the body to be given up.

text.KJV: And when Joseph had taken the body, he wrapped it in a clean linen cloth,
text.ASV: And Joseph took the body, and wrapped it in a clean linen cloth,
text.WEB: Joseph took the body, and wrapped it in a clean linen cloth,

text.KJV: And laid it in his own new tomb, which he had hewn out in the rock: and he rolled a great stone to the door of the sepulchre, and departed.
text.ASV: and laid it in his own new tomb, which he had hewn out in the rock: and he rolled a great stone to the door of the tomb, and departed.
text.WEB: and laid it in his own new tomb, which he had cut out in the rock, and he rolled a great stone against the door of the tomb, and departed.

text.KJV: And there was Mary Magdalene, and the other Mary, sitting over against the sepulchre.
text.ASV: And Mary Magdalene was there, and the other Mary, sitting over against the sepulchre.
text.WEB: Mary Magdalene was there, and the other Mary, sitting opposite the tomb.

text.KJV: Now the next day, that followed the day of the preparation, the chief priests and Pharisees came together unto Pilate,
text.ASV: Now on the morrow, which is `the day' after the Preparation, the chief priests and the Pharisees were gathered together unto Pilate,
text.WEB: Now on the next day, which was the day after the Preparation Day, the chief priests and the Pharisees were gathered together to Pilate,

text.KJV: Saying, Sir, we remember that that deceiver said, while he was yet alive, After three days I will rise again.
text.ASV: saying, Sir, we remember that that deceiver said while he was yet alive, After three days I rise again.
text.WEB: saying, “Sir, we remember what that deceiver said while he was still alive: ‘After three days I will rise again.’

text.KJV: Command therefore that the sepulchre be made sure until the third day, lest his disciples come by night, and steal him away, and say unto the people, He is risen from the dead: so the last error shall be worse than the first.
text.ASV: Command therefore that the sepulchre be made sure until the third day, lest haply his disciples come and steal him away, and say unto the people, He is risen from the dead: and the last error will be worse than the first.
text.WEB: Command therefore that the tomb be made secure until the third day, lest perhaps his disciples come at night and steal him away, and tell the people, ‘He is risen from the dead;’ and the last deception will be worse than the first.”

text.KJV: Pilate said unto them, Ye have a watch: go your way, make it as sure as ye can.
text.ASV: Pilate said unto them, Ye have a guard: go, make it `as' sure as ye can.
text.WEB: Pilate said to them, “You have a guard. Go, make it as secure as you can.”

text.KJV: So they went, and made the sepulchre sure, sealing the stone, and setting a watch.
text.ASV: So they went, and made the sepulchre sure, sealing the stone, the guard being with them.
text.WEB: So they went with the guard and made the tomb secure, sealing the stone.

text.KJV: In the end of the sabbath, as it began to dawn toward the first day of the week, came Mary Magdalene and the other Mary to see the sepulchre.
text.ASV: Now late on the sabbath day, as it began to dawn toward the first `day' of the week, came Mary Magdalene and the other Mary to see the sepulchre.
text.WEB: Now after the Sabbath, as it began to dawn on the first day of the week, Mary Magdalene and the other Mary came to see the tomb.

text.KJV: And, behold, there was a great earthquake: for the angel of the Lord descended from heaven, and came and rolled back the stone from the door, and sat upon it.
text.ASV: And behold, there was a great earthquake; for an angel of the Lord descended from heaven, and came and rolled away the stone, and sat upon it.
text.WEB: Behold, there was a great earthquake, for an angel of the Lord descended from the sky, and came and rolled away the stone from the door, and sat on it.

text.KJV: His countenance was like lightning, and his raiment white as snow:
text.ASV: His appearance was as lightning, and his raiment white as snow:
text.WEB: His appearance was like lightning, and his clothing white as snow.

text.KJV: And for fear of him the keepers did shake, and became as dead men.
text.ASV: and for fear of him the watchers did quake, and became as dead men.
text.WEB: For fear of him, the guards shook, and became like dead men.

text.KJV: And the angel answered and said unto the women, Fear not ye: for I know that ye seek Jesus, which was crucified.
text.ASV: And the angel answered and said unto the women, Fear not ye; for I know that ye seek Jesus, who hath been crucified.
text.WEB: The angel answered the women, “Don’t be afraid, for I know that you seek Jesus, who has been crucified.

text.KJV: He is not here: for he is risen, as he said. Come, see the place where the Lord lay.
text.ASV: He is not here; for he is risen, even as he said. Come, see the place where the Lord lay.
text.WEB: He is not here, for he has risen, just like he said. Come, see the place where the Lord was lying.

text.KJV: And go quickly, and tell his disciples that he is risen from the dead; and, behold, he goeth before you into Galilee; there shall ye see him: lo, I have told you.
text.ASV: And go quickly, and tell his disciples, He is risen from the dead; and lo, he goeth before you into Galilee; there shall ye see him: lo, I have told you.
text.WEB: Go quickly and tell his disciples, ‘He has risen from the dead, and behold, he goes before you into Galilee; there you will see him.’ Behold, I have told you.”

text.KJV: And they departed quickly from the sepulchre with fear and great joy; and did run to bring his disciples word.
text.ASV: And they departed quickly from the tomb with fear and great joy, and ran to bring his disciples word.
text.WEB: They departed quickly from the tomb with fear and great joy, and ran to bring his disciples word.

text.KJV: And as they went to tell his disciples, behold, Jesus met them, saying, All hail. And they came and held him by the feet, and worshipped him.
text.ASV: And behold, Jesus met them, saying, All hail. And they came and took hold of his feet, and worshipped him.
text.WEB: As they went to tell his disciples, behold, Jesus met them, saying, “Rejoice!” They came and took hold of his feet, and worshiped him.

text.KJV: Then said Jesus unto them, Be not afraid: go tell my brethren that they go into Galilee, and there shall they see me.
text.ASV: Then saith Jesus unto them, Fear not: go tell my brethren that they depart into Galilee, and there shall they see me.
text.WEB: Then Jesus said to them, “Don’t be afraid. Go tell my brothers that they should go into Galilee, and there they will see me.”

text.KJV: Now when they were going, behold, some of the watch came into the city, and shewed unto the chief priests all the things that were done.
text.ASV: Now while they were going, behold, some of the guard came into the city, and told unto the chief priests all the things that were come to pass.
text.WEB: Now while they were going, behold, some of the guards came into the city, and told the chief priests all the things that had happened.

text.KJV: And when they were assembled with the elders, and had taken counsel, they gave large money unto the soldiers,
text.ASV: And when they were assembled with the elders, and had taken counsel, they gave much money unto the soldiers,
text.WEB: When they were assembled with the elders, and had taken counsel, they gave a large amount of silver to the soldiers,

text.KJV: Saying, Say ye, His disciples came by night, and stole him away while we slept.
text.ASV: saying, Say ye, His disciples came by night, and stole him away while we slept.
text.WEB: saying, “Say that his disciples came by night, and stole him away while we slept.

text.KJV: And if this come to the governor's ears, we will persuade him, and secure you.
text.ASV: And if this come to the governor's ears, we will persuade him, and rid you of care.
text.WEB: If this comes to the governor’s ears, we will persuade him and make you free of worry.”

text.KJV: So they took the money, and did as they were taught: and this saying is commonly reported among the Jews until this day.
text.ASV: So they took the money, and did as they were taught: and this saying was spread abroad among the Jews, `and continueth' until this day.
text.WEB: So they took the money and did as they were told. This saying was spread abroad among the Jews, and continues until today.

text.KJV: Then the eleven disciples went away into Galilee, into a mountain where Jesus had appointed them.
text.ASV: But the eleven disciples went into Galilee, unto the mountain where Jesus had appointed them.
text.WEB: But the eleven disciples went into Galilee, to the mountain where Jesus had sent them.

text.KJV: And when they saw him, they worshipped him: but some doubted.
text.ASV: And when they saw him, they worshipped `him'; but some doubted.
text.WEB: When they saw him, they bowed down to him, but some doubted.

text.KJV: And Jesus came and spake unto them, saying, All power is given unto me in heaven and in earth.
text.ASV: And Jesus came to them and spake unto them, saying, All authority hath been given unto me in heaven and on earth.
text.WEB: Jesus came to them and spoke to them, saying, “All authority has been given to me in heaven and on earth.

text.KJV: Go ye therefore, and teach all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Ghost:
text.ASV: Go ye therefore, and make disciples of all the nations, baptizing them into the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit:
text.WEB: Go and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit,

text.KJV: Teaching them to observe all things whatsoever I have commanded you: and, lo, I am with you alway, even unto the end of the world. Amen.
text.ASV: teaching them to observe all things whatsoever I commanded you: and lo, I am with you always, even unto the end of the world.
text.WEB: teaching them to observe all things that I commanded you. Behold, I am with you always, even to the end of the age.” Amen.
